title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:

title: Senior Marketing Specialist, B2C
description:
**What This Role Is**
A seventeen-year-old in Delhi has just shortlisted four universities in the UK. She found out about Cialfo through a webinar her school never told her about, not through her counselor. She is on WhatsApp constantly. She does not read long emails. Her parents are just as anxious as she is, and they are looking for one thing above all else: proof that whoever guides her from here can be trusted to get her across the finish line. She is not a lead in a CRM. She is a family that is about to make one of the biggest financial and emotional decisions of their lives, and she found her way to us directly, not through a school.
  
  
That direct relationship, student and family reaching out to Manifest brands on their own, without a school in between, is a different business than K12 counseling, and it runs on different instincts. It lives and dies on performance marketing that actually pays for itself: media spend that generates real inquiries, a qualification process that tells a counselor within hours whether a lead is worth a call, and nurture that keeps a family engaged through a decision that can take months. Get any one of those wrong and the funnel leaks money. Get all three right and this becomes one of the highest-margin parts of the business.
  
  
Today, that direct-to-family motion sits inside Student Placements, Cialfo's B2C engine, and it is being built out to work the same way across EduGo Abroad's European corridor and Kaaiser's Australia and New Zealand corridor. Three different destination markets, three different family journeys, and increasingly, one shared marketing engine underneath them: shared performance marketing craft, a shared approach to lead qualification, and one philosophy about what makes a family convert.
  
  
This is the role that owns that engine. You will own performance marketing, lead generation, qualification, and conversion for the direct-to-consumer motion, and you will be one of the people shaping what a consolidated B2C marketing function looks like as it comes together across three brands.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Different**
Most performance marketing roles are judged on cost per lead. This one is judged on cost per enrolment, which is a much harder and much more honest number, because a cheap lead that a counselor can't convert is not a win, it's a cost the business absorbs later. The person who does this well thinks in the full funnel, from the first Meta ad impression to the moment a family pays a deposit, and treats every stage in between as their problem to optimize, not just the top of it.
  
  
The other thing that makes this different is timing. Student Placements, EduGo Abroad, and Kaaiser have each been running their own version of direct-to-family marketing, and Manifest is now consolidating that into a shared B2C capability. That means the playbooks, the media buying leverage, and the qualification logic built in this seat won't stay contained to one brand's India funnel. They'll become the template other corridors adopt. Very few marketers get to build the system rather than inherit one that's already calcified.
  
  
The broader Manifest ecosystem gives this role something a standalone consultancy or agency competitor can't match: three destination corridors, shared university relationships through Explore and Kaaiser, and a K12 pipeline sitting right alongside the B2C one, all generating signal about what actually makes a family choose one destination over another.
  
  
**What You Own**
**Performance marketing and paid acquisition**

* Own paid performance campaigns across Meta, Google, LLMs Ads, from targeting and creative briefs through budget allocation and bid optimization
* Drive down cost per qualified lead without sacrificing lead quality, and be the person accountable for that tradeoff, not just the spend number
* Build and maintain the tracking and attribution that connects ad spend all the way through to enrolment, not just to form fills
* Test new channels and formats as the direct-to-consumer motion expands into new destination markets

**Lead generation and qualification**

* Run the top-of-funnel programme: destination webinars, WhatsApp communities, school and community events, and organic social content that reaches students where they actually are
* Define and refine what a sales-qualified lead looks like for this business, and build the qualification workflow that gets a genuine inquiry in front of a counselor fast
* Work with the counseling and operations teams to close the loop on lead quality, using what happens after handoff to keep improving what happens before it

**Nurture, conversion, and ROI**

* Build and run the nurture sequences, email and WhatsApp, that keep a family engaged across a multi-month decision, and design the visa-support, alternate-destination, and Clearing-period campaigns that push undecided families across the line
* Own conversion rate as a number you're accountable for, not just a number you report on, and treat every drop-off point in the funnel as something to fix
* Report funnel performance and ROI in a way that tells the business what to do next, not just what happened last month

**Cross-brand B2C consolidation**

* Build the shared marketing playbook, systems, and qualification logic that Student Placements' direct channel, EduGo Abroad, and Kaaiser's B2C marketing can all run on, rather than three brands solving the same problem separately
* Identify where consolidated media buying, shared creative testing, or a common martech stack creates real efficiency across corridors, and make the case for it
* Partner with the marketing leads already running B2C for EduGo Abroad and Kaaiser to bring their channels into a shared system without flattening what makes each destination market different

**What Success Looks Like**
The markers below reflect where direct-to-consumer marketing is today across Student Placements. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
  
  
In the first months, you'll have a clear, honest picture of what's working across performance marketing, lead gen, and nurture today, where the funnel leaks the most value, and which levers will move cost per enrolment fastest. You'll have already made a few of the easier fixes.
  
  
By the middle of the first year, qualified lead volume and conversion will both be measurably better, the tracking from ad spend to enrolment will be trustworthy enough that the business plans against it, and the consolidation work with EduGo Abroad and Kaaiser's marketing teams will have a real shape, not just a shared intention.
  
  
Over the long term, you'll have built the direct-to-consumer marketing engine that Manifest's destination brands run on, one that performs on its own economics and that other corridors adopt because it's the best version available, not because they were told to use it.
  
  
The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
  
  
**What You Bring**
You have five to eight years in performance marketing and B2C growth, with real, hands-on depth in Meta and Google Ads. This is non-negotiable for this role: you've built and optimized paid campaigns yourself, you know what good targeting and creative testing look like, and you're not describing work someone else on your team did.
  
  
You're a generalist by design, not by accident. You move comfortably between paid acquisition, lead gen programme design, and lifecycle nurture, and you understand how those pieces have to work together rather than treating each as its own silo. You've probably done this in a B2C business with a real sales cycle, education, fintech, or another category where the customer takes weeks or months to decide, not seconds.
  
  
You are commercially obsessive about ROI. You don't just report cost per lead, you push toward cost per conversion and treat every stage of the funnel as your responsibility, including the parts that happen after your channel handed the lead off. You get uncomfortable when a number looks good in isolation but you can't trace it through to revenue.
  
  
You're a builder more than a maintainer. Consolidating marketing across three brands means some of what you'll be doing doesn't have a playbook yet, and you're energized by that rather than waiting for someone to hand you a finished system. At the same time, you know how to bring other teams along, since this role only works if the marketing leads at EduGo Abroad and Kaaiser want to build with you, not around you.
  
  
Most importantly, you read the description of the family trying to figure out where their child should study, on WhatsApp, anxious, deciding without a school counselor in the room, and your first reaction was: I know exactly how to reach her, qualify her, and earn her trust through to enrolment. That's the person this role is for.
  
  
**Why Manifest**
Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI-powered college counseling, 2,000+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI-powered university outreach, 1,000+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
  
  
For this role specifically, the direct-to-consumer motion is where Manifest talks to a family with nothing in between, no school, no counselor relationship already in place. Getting that conversation right, at the right cost, across every destination corridor Manifest serves, is what turns individual ambition into enrolments the business can count on. This is the seat that builds the engine underneath that.
  
  
Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50+ countries.

title: Marketing Manager - Aperitifs
description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.
  
  
Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns
**25**
plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in
**26**
countries, and employs approximately
**4,700**
people.
  
  
Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.
  
  
**General Description Of The Role**
We are looking for a dynamic, commercially astute professional to bridge marketing strategy with business outcomes. Reporting to the Head of Brands, this role will be the vital connector between brand vision and sales execution—building trust with the sales force, collaborating with CCM managers, and ensuring every initiative drives measurable depletion results.
  
  
As the category’s innovation hub, the individual will continuously engage suppliers, partners, and vendors to co-create impactful activations, sponsorships, and campaigns. With strong market immersion and disciplined monitoring & evaluation (M&E), the role will guarantee that each initiative enhances sales, visibility, and ROI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Brand Thinking & Global Alignment
* Build strategic thinking around the brands in line with the global marketing strategy.
* Drive global brand pillars in local markets by connecting with the global team and adapting content for India as per brand guidelines.
* Create differentiated, innovative, and clutter-breaking campaigns with fresh ideas to strengthen brand health scores in India.
* KPIs: Brand health score uplift, campaign differentiation index, global-to-local content adaptation success.
* Commercial Engagement, On-Ground Execution & Monitoring
* Partner closely with CCM managers and sales teams to design depletion-focused programs.
* Lead category conversations with commercial teams to align priorities and identify growth opportunities.
* Drive flawless execution of trade activations, sponsorships, and vendor-led initiatives.
* Establish robust M&E frameworks to measure ROI, depletion impact, and execution quality.
* KPIs: Depletion uplift %, sales team trust index, execution excellence rating, activity ROI, depletion target achievement.
* Digital Marketing & Funnel Optimization
* Manage paid, owned, and earned digital campaigns with measurable outcomes.
* Build and refine digital funnels (awareness → engagement → conversion → loyalty).
* Partner with agencies to monitor CTR, CPA, conversion rates, and attribution models.
* KPIs: Funnel conversion %, digital ROI, industry benchmark comparison.
* PR & Brand Visibility
* Drive PR initiatives to strengthen category positioning and brand awareness.
* Collaborate with media partners, influencers, and agencies to amplify campaigns.
* KPIs: PR reach, earned media value, brand awareness uplift.
* Consumer Insights & Market Orientation
* Use consumer insights to refine campaigns and activations.
* Track trends, competitor activity, and shopper behavior to inform strategy.
* KPIs: Insight-to-action ratio, consumer engagement metrics, competitor tracking reports.
* Ideation & Partnerships
* Serve as the category’s innovation hub, generating fresh ideas.
* Engage suppliers, partners, and vendors to co-create sponsorships and initiatives.
* KPIs: New initiatives launched, supplier engagement score, innovation ROI.
* Activity Calendar & Reporting
* Maintain detailed activity calendars with milestones and responsibilities.
* Provide structured reporting on execution, budget utilization, and ROI.
* KPIs: Calendar compliance, reporting accuracy, activity completion %.
* Market Immersion
* Dedicate ≥7 working days/month in market to monitor activations, engage trade partners, and gather insights.
* KPIs: Market immersion compliance, trade partner trust index, activation quality score.
* Market Research & Consumer Studies
* Partner with research agencies to design and execute consumer studies (U&A, shopper behavior, segmentation).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for campaigns, activations, and category growth.
* Continuously monitor competitor research and industry benchmarks.
* KPIs: Research-to-strategy conversion %, consumer insight adoption rate, competitor intelligence reports.

**Capabilities Required**

* Strong commercial acumen and ability to build trust with sales teams.
* Expertise in digital marketing, funnel management, and performance metrics.
* PR and media relations skills to enhance brand visibility.
* Analytical rigor in M&E, ROI tracking, and consumer insights.
* Experience in working with research agencies and applying consumer insights, including understanding consumer behavior, usage & attitudes (U&A), and translating findings into actionable strategies.
* Creative ideation to drive category innovation.
* Relationship-building with suppliers, partners, and vendors.
* Market orientation with continuous immersion and feedback loops.

**Experience Required**

* 4–7 years in mix of AlcoBev + FMCG, ideally with startup exposure for agility and innovation.
* Proven success in depletion-focused initiatives and commercial team engagement.
* Experience in digital performance marketing, funnel optimization, and PR campaigns.
* Demonstrated ability to track and report ROI at campaign and activity levels.
* Hands-on experience in market activations, sponsorships, and vendor partnerships.
* Exposure to consumer insights and ability to translate them into actionable strategies.
* Experience in leveraging consumer research and U&A studies to shape marketing and commercial strategies.

**Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:**
At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Campari Group believes that fair compensation and equal opportunities are crucial for employees’ well-being, empowerment, and engagement. Our efforts to ensure fair pay have earned us the Fair Pay Certification by Fair Pay Workplace, an independent organization dedicated to dismantling pay disparities based on gender, race and their intersection.
  
  
Note to applicants:
  
  
Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.
  
  
Notice to third party agencies:
  
  
Please refrain from cold-calling or emailing our executive leadership team or the HR community directly. The Talent Acquisition department manages centralized recruiting operations globally, including the selection and management of external suppliers. Currently, our preferred supplier list is at full capacity. To ensure we have your information on file for future consideration, we kindly request that you complete the online form provided here.

title: Influencer Marketing Fresher

* 5. Marketplace & Quick Commerce Synergies (Added Advantage)Omnichannel Visibility: Track how direct-to-consumer paid media drives brand searches and sales across Amazon, Flipkart, and Quick Commerce platforms.
* Retail Media Scaling: Optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and platform keywords to improve organic search ranking and shelf placement.

Hands-on experience scaling monthly spends of ₹20L-₹1Cr+ (25k-120k+) on Meta & Google Ads with verifiable proof of scale.

Analytics & Data Deep proficiency in GA4, BigQuery/Looker Studio, Shopify Analytics, and custom UTM parameter governance.

Tracking Stack Practical configuration experience with GTM (Web & Server-side), CAPI gateways / Stape.io, and event deduplication.

CRO Toolkit Experience with Hotjar/Microsoft Clarity, A/B testing tools, and rapid landing page builders.

(Bonus) Working knowledge of Amazon Ads Console and Quick Commerce visibility mechanics (Zepto/Blinkit ad networks).

**Non-Negotiable Mindset:**

Critical Thinking & Extreme Ownership, Root-Cause Ownership: Never blame platform algorithms; diagnose performance dips across Cost Per Mille, creative fatigue, landing page speed, and payment failures.

First-Principles Thinking: Approach growth mathematically, understanding how Average Order Value, Cost Per Click, Conversion Rate, and Repeat Purchase Rate work together to drive scalable acquisition.

Speed & Autonomy: Move fast without dependency on agencies or development teams-identify issues, develop solutions, and launch fresh tests within 24 hours.

title: Marketing Manager (B2B)
description:
**Informa**
is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis Group**
produces high quality, peer reviewed books and journals. We produce unique, trusted content by expert authors, spreading knowledge and promoting discovery globally. We aim to broaden thinking and advance understanding, providing academics and professionals with a platform to share ideas and realise their individual potential.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

**What we offer in return :**

* 30 days annual leave
* 4 volunteering days annually
* Day off for your birthday
* Pension contributions
* Medical insurance for self and dependents; life cover and personal accident cover for self
* Seasonal social and charitable events
* Training and development

**Job Description**

Lead and execute B2B marketing initiatives with a primary focus on lead funnel activation, demand generation, and revenue growth. This role is responsible for developing data-driven marketing strategies that generate qualified leads, optimize the customer journey, and collaborate with commercial teams to convert opportunities into closed business.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, you will manage end-to-end campaign execution across digital channels, leverage SFDC and CRM analytics to inform decision-making, and ensure alignment between marketing and sales to achieve the division's commercial revenue targets.

We are looking for a passionate B2B marketer with deep expertise in lead generation and funnel management, who thrives in a data-driven environment, understands complex buyer journeys, and can translate insights into high-impact marketing programs that drive measurable business outcomes.

Applications will close on 20th October 2026.

**Key Accountabilities**

* **Lead Funnel Activation:**
  Design and execute integrated demand generation campaigns to drive qualified leads through the funnel, owning performance metrics including MQLs, SQLs, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.
* **Sales & Commercial Partnership:**
  Collaborate with commercial and sales teams to align on lead qualification, optimize handoff processes, and support conversion strategies that directly contribute to revenue targets.
* **Account-Based Marketing (ABM):**
  Develop and implement targeted ABM strategies for high-value accounts and strategic prospects, creating personalised campaigns and coordinating with sales to drive engagement and accelerate deal closure.
* **CRM & Analytics Management:**
  Leverage Salesforce (SFDC) and marketing automation platforms to track campaign performance, lead attribution, and ROI, using data insights to optimize targeting and personalization strategies.
* **Multi-Channel Campaign Execution:**
  Plan and execute B2B marketing campaigns across email, paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), content syndication, and webinars to maximize reach and engagement with target audiences.
* **Content & Messaging Strategy:**
  Develop compelling content and value propositions tailored to key personas and buyer journey stages, ensuring consistent messaging that educates, engages, and converts prospects.
* **Team Collaboration & Development:**
  Contribute to a high-performance marketing culture by collaborating cross-functionally, sharing best practices, and taking accountability for personal growth and skills development.

**Qualifications**

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* B2B Marketing Expertise: Proven experience in B2B marketing with a strong track record in demand generation, lead funnel management, and pipeline contribution
* CRM & Marketing Automation Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua, Pardot, etc.)
* Data Analytics & Reporting: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, build reports, and derive actionable insights to optimize marketing performance
* Digital Marketing Channels: Demonstrated expertise across digital channels including email marketing, SEO, SEM, paid social (LinkedIn Ads), content marketing, and webinars
* Lead Generation & Conversion: Deep understanding of lead generation tactics, lead scoring, nurture strategies, and conversion optimization
* Sales Collaboration: Experience working closely with sales teams to align on lead management, qualification criteria, and revenue goals

**Skills and Behaviours Required**

* Critical and analytical ability
* Budget management
* Commercial and customer focus
* Communication excellence
* Results driven
* Agility & Adaptability

**Additional Information**

**Location:**

* You must have the right to work and live in India.
* The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our
  **New Delhi**
  office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a
  **minimum of 3 days per week in-person time**
  .
* We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

We want all our candidates to shine in our recruitment process. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you are able to show us your best self. This could include having the application form in a different format, more time for questions, or anything else – please ask us, we are happy to be flexible! Please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk

title: Senior Marketing Manager – Academic & Government Affairs

**Informa**
is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis Group**
produces high quality, peer reviewed books and journals. We produce unique, trusted content by expert authors, spreading knowledge and promoting discovery globally. We aim to broaden thinking and advance understanding, providing academics and professionals with a platform to share ideas and realise their individual potential.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. * 4 volunteering days annually

* Pension contributions

* Seasonal social and charitable events
* Training and development

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager – Academic & Government Affairs to lead institutional activation across strategic accounts in identified markets.

This senior individual-contributor role will convert institutional access into sustained journals usage, researcher engagement, publishing participation and renewal evidence. You will build relationships with institutional stakeholders, government bodies, research funders and academic societies; address access and adoption barriers; represent Taylor & Francis at conferences and working groups; and lead integrated field and digital programmes that demonstrate measurable impact.

Working across Marketing, Sales, Editorial, Customer Experience, Product and external partners, you will bring strategic thinking, data-led decision-making, strong stakeholder communication and independent programme ownership to protect and grow Taylor & Francis's regional revenue streams in books and journals.

**Key responsibility areas**

4. **Marketing Programme Ownership**

5. **Sub-Saharan Africa Partnership Activation**

6. **Performance, Budget & Cross-Functional Delivery**

**Qualifications**

* Substantial experience in institutional B2B marketing, academic publishing, research engagement, higher education or EdTech
* Strong digital marketing capability including CRM, conversion measurement and dashboards
* Excellent English with strong facilitation and presentation skills
* Experience in matrix environments and willingness to travel regularly

* **Data-led judgement:**
  uses evidence to prioritise, stop low-value activity, test interventions and recommend investment decisions.
* **Executive communication and matrix leadership:**
  communicates decision-ready recommendations, orchestrates specialist contributors and establishes accountability without unnecessary hierarchy.
* **Operational discipline, adaptability and resilience:**
  prioritises effectively, escalates risks early, learns quickly and maintains consistently high, ethical and inclusive standards.
* **Shared Commitments:**
  Leads innovative solutions with clear goals, uses diverse evidence, manages performance with discipline and prioritises strategically. Balances stakeholder needs with organisational objectives, collaborates across departments and empowers specialist expertise within an ethical and inclusive culture.

title: Content creator & Social Media Management
description:
*essbees*
is looking for its first storyteller.

**A blank Instagram grid. A brand in the making. A story waiting to be told**

ABOUT US

*essbees*
is a new social wellness club coming to Defence Colony, New Delhi.

Three spaces, one roof: a Lagree studio, a recovery zone with saunas and ice plunges, and a Japanese-inspired restaurant and bar.

A place to move, recover, eat, and stay a little longer.

We’re still putting the finishing touches on the space. The machines are on their way, the team is coming together, and our Instagram has exactly zero posts.

That’s where YOU come in.

THE ROLE

**Content & Social Media Intern**

Most internships hand you a brand that’s already built. This one gives you the opportunity to help build one.

You’ll be part of the \_essbees\_ journey from day zero, documenting everything from the behind-the-scenes chaos to the first Lagree class, the first matcha, and the first guests through our doors.

Your job? Make people curious about essbees before they’ve even stepped inside.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

\* Create and edit reels, stories, and posts that bring the essbees world to life.

\* Capture the build-out, the people, the details, and everything happening behind the scenes.

\* Help shape our content calendar, from pre-launch teasers to launch week and beyond.

\* Write captions with personality. Warm, witty, sharp. Never forced.

\* Engage with our community through DMs, comments, and conversations.

\* Spot emerging trends, bring fresh ideas, and experiment with new formats.

\* Assist on shoots with photographers, creators, and the founding team.

\* Track content performance and help us understand what resonates.

YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF…

\* You’re already creating content, whether for yourself, a brand, or just for fun.

\* You know your way around CapCut, Canva, Lightroom, or similar tools.

\* You have a strong visual eye and a natural instinct for good storytelling.

\* You understand the difference between having taste and trying too hard.

\* You’re interested in wellness, movement, food, design, or culture.

\* You’re proactive, curious, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus points if you know Delhi’s creator, café, and wellness scene, or already know a thing or two about Lagree.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

\* A chance to shape a brand’s identity from its very first post.

\* Hands-on experience launching a new concept in Delhi.

\* Direct mentorship and the opportunity to work closely with the founding team.

\* Access to the essbees experience, from Lagree to recovery and dining.

\* An internship certificate, a recommendation, and the possibility of a full-time role.

Most importantly, you’ll have the creative freedom to make something you’re genuinely proud to put your name on.

THE DETAILS

Role: Content & Social Media Intern

Location: Okhla, New Delhi (on-site)

Duration: 2 months

Paid Internship

Start date: Immediate

HOW TO APPLY

Show us what you’ve got.

Apply here and share three pieces of content you’ve created. Reels, edits, a page you manage, or a personal project. We care more about your eye for content than your CV.

Show us your taste. We’ll take it from there.

Not a gym. Not a club. A culture.

Come build it with us.

hello@essbees.club

About the job

**About the Company**

MSM Unify is a global education marketplace connecting students, recruitment partners, and institutions on one platform. With a growing international presence, we are building a technology-driven education ecosystem focused on business expansion, innovation, and creating opportunities across global markets.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic, analytical, and results-driven Performance Marketing professional to drive digital growth, customer acquisition, and revenue generation across MSM Unify's expanding business portfolio.

The role will be responsible for developing and executing high-impact digital marketing strategies, managing performance-driven campaigns, optimizing acquisition funnels, and maximizing return on marketing investments. The ideal candidate should bring a strong combination of strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and data-driven decision-making, with the ability to identify growth opportunities and scale marketing initiatives across domestic and international markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute end-to-end performance marketing strategies to drive lead generation, customer acquisition, conversions, and business growth.
* Plan, manage, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Own performance marketing budgets and ensure efficient allocation of marketing investments to maximize ROI and campaign effectiveness.
* Drive high-quality lead generation while optimizing key metrics including CPL, CAC, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rates.
* Analyze customer acquisition funnels, identify conversion gaps, and implement strategies to improve overall marketing efficiency.
* Lead A/B testing, audience segmentation, remarketing initiatives, and landing page optimization to improve campaign performance.
* Identify new digital acquisition channels, emerging market opportunities, and scalable growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with Sales, Admissions, Product, and Business teams to align marketing initiatives with business objectives and revenue targets.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer behavior to strengthen digital acquisition strategies.
* Build performance dashboards, track campaign effectiveness, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to leadership.

**Required skils & Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of relevant experience in Performance Marketing, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* **Candidates with prior experience in the EdTech industry will be preferred**
  , particularly in Higher Education, Online Education, Study Abroad, or student acquisition businesses.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale performance marketing campaigns and delivering measurable business growth.
* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and other performance marketing tools.
* Demonstrated ability to drive high-volume lead generation, improve conversion rates, and optimize acquisition costs.
* Strong understanding of CPL, CAC, CPA, ROAS, LTV, marketing attribution, and conversion funnel optimization.
* Experience managing substantial digital marketing budgets and scaling campaigns across multiple channels.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation, lead management systems, and performance reporting tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth business environment with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Key Performance Indicators

* Lead generation volume and quality.
* Cost per Lead (CPL) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Lead-to-conversion and enrollment conversion rates.
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and marketing ROI.
* Campaign scalability and budget utilization.
* Revenue contribution through digital acquisition channels.

**What We Are Looking For**

A growth-focused marketing professional who can combine strategic vision with strong execution capabilities, challenge conventional approaches, and identify opportunities to accelerate business growth.

**Someone who understands that performance marketing is not just about generating leads, but about creating measurable business impact, driving conversions, and delivering sustainable growth.**

title: Marketing Manager
description:

title: Performance Marketing
description:
**We're Hiring: Performance Marketing Specialist**

1. D2C Growth | Clothing • Jewellery • Astrology
2. Company: Aakriti's Healverse
3. Experience: 3 - 5 Years Preferred
4. Employment Type: Full-Time
5. Work Mode: Work From Office (Mandatory)
6. Working Days: 6 Days a Week

**About the Role**

Aakriti's Healverse is looking for a highly driven, analytical, and results-oriented Performance Marketing Specialist to independently manage and scale the complete performance marketing function across our businesses in clothing, jewellery, astrology, numerology, and occult products.

We are seeking a hands-on professional with proven expertise in Meta Ads, Google Ads, D2C e-commerce advertising, lead generation, webinar marketing, and conversion funnel optimization.

The ideal candidate should understand how to translate advertising investments into measurable business outcomes, including online sales, qualified leads, webinar registrations, consultation bookings, customer acquisition, and profitable revenue growth.

This role requires complete end-to-end ownership of performance marketing, from strategy and campaign setup to execution, budget management, tracking, optimization, reporting, and scaling.

We are looking for someone who personally executes campaigns, takes initiative, solves problems, and is accountable for measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising**

* Independently plan, set up, launch, manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, and other relevant performance marketing platforms.
* Execute Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube advertising campaigns.
* Develop and implement full-funnel advertising strategies covering customer acquisition, retargeting, remarketing, and conversions.
* Personally handle campaign structuring, audience research, targeting, bidding strategies, budget allocation, creative testing, and ongoing optimization.
* Conduct A/B testing of advertising creatives, messaging, audiences, placements, and campaign structures.
* Continuously improve Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), and conversion rates.
* Identify and test new advertising opportunities to drive profitable growth.

**2. Multi-Brand D2C Growth & E-Commerce Sales**

* Independently develop and execute performance marketing strategies across clothing, jewellery, astrology, numerology, and occult product categories.
* Drive qualified website traffic, customer acquisition, online sales, and profitable revenue growth.
* Create category-specific advertising strategies based on customer behaviour, product positioning, and purchasing intent.
* Plan and execute paid campaigns for new product launches, festive collections, promotional events, seasonal offers, and special campaigns.
* Manage prospecting, retargeting, abandoned-cart recovery, and customer re-engagement campaigns.
* Optimize e-commerce advertising funnels to improve conversion rates, average order value, and customer acquisition efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns while maintaining profitability.

**3. Lead Generation, Webinar Marketing & Conversion Funnels**

* Independently plan, launch, manage, and optimize lead generation campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant platforms.
* Generate qualified leads for astrology, numerology, spiritual consultations, workshops, webinars, masterclasses, and related offerings.
* Execute paid advertising campaigns to drive webinar registrations, workshop sign-ups, consultation bookings, and event participation.
* Build, manage, and optimize lead generation funnels, including landing pages, lead forms, registration pages, and conversion journeys.
* Handle WhatsApp-based lead generation campaigns and set up relevant WhatsApp, email, and CRM integrations for lead nurturing.
* Execute retargeting and remarketing campaigns to convert interested audiences into webinar attendees, consultation bookings, and paying customers.
* Monitor and optimize Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Registration, Lead Quality, Webinar Attendance Rate, Lead-to-Customer Conversion Rate, and CAC.
* Track the complete customer journey from advertisement to lead generation, registration, attendance, and final conversion.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support timely lead follow-ups and improve conversions.

**4. Analytics, Tracking & Conversion Optimization**

* Independently set up, manage, and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4, and relevant integrations.
* Monitor and analyse key performance indicators, including ROAS, CAC, CPA, CPL, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, advertising expenditure, and revenue generated.
* Ensure accurate tracking of website purchases, leads, registrations, bookings, and other conversion events.
* Conduct A/B testing of advertising creatives, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.
* Identify performance gaps, tracking issues, and conversion bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
* Optimize landing pages, lead forms, and customer journeys to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Maintain performance dashboards and prepare regular reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

**5. Creative Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the social media, graphic design, content, and video editing teams to develop high-performing advertising creatives.
* Provide clear creative briefs based on campaign objectives, target audiences, and performance insights.
* Collaborate on product advertisements, reels, promotional videos, webinar creatives, and lead generation campaigns.
* Identify winning creatives, advertising hooks, messaging approaches, and content formats through continuous testing.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product launches, festive campaigns, webinars, and promotional activities.
* Ensure all advertising creatives and campaigns align with each brand's positioning and business objectives.

**6. Complete Ownership, Budget Management & Founder Reporting**

* Take complete responsibility for the planning, execution, optimization, and results of performance marketing activities across all assigned brands.
* Independently manage advertising budgets and allocate spending based on performance and business priorities.
* Monitor campaign performance daily and proactively implement improvements.
* Identify new opportunities for customer acquisition, lead generation, webinar registrations, online sales, and revenue growth.
* Stay updated with advertising platform changes, algorithms, emerging tools, and D2C performance marketing trends.
* Report directly to the Founder, providing regular updates on advertising spend, campaign performance, lead generation, revenue, and growth opportunities.
* Recommend and execute data-driven strategies to improve advertising profitability and overall business performance.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience preferred.
* Prior experience working with D2C or e-commerce brands is mandatory.
* Experience in clothing, fashion, jewellery, astrology, numerology, occult, crystals, spiritual wellness, or related consumer categories is highly preferred.
* Strong practical expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube campaigns.
* Proven experience independently setting up, executing, managing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns.
* Demonstrated ability to generate online sales, qualified leads, webinar registrations, and measurable business results.
* Experience running lead generation campaigns for webinars, workshops, masterclasses, or consultation-based services.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels, retargeting, remarketing, conversion optimization, and attribution.
* Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion tracking, and relevant analytics tools.
* Familiarity with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms, Google Merchant Center, and product-feed advertising.
* Practical understanding of landing page creation and optimization, WhatsApp marketing, CRM integrations, and lead nurturing funnels.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and independently improve campaign performance.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, campaigns, advertising budgets, and business objectives simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Who We're Looking for someone who**

* Is a hands-on performance marketing professional capable of independently managing the entire performance marketing function.
* Has personally executed, managed, and optimized Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Understands the difference between generating traffic and generating profitable business.
* Has experience driving both D2C e-commerce sales and qualified lead generation.
* Understands how to build, execute, and optimize webinar registration and conversion funnels.
* Can develop distinct advertising strategies for different brands, products, and customer segments.
* Is comfortable managing advertising budgets, analysing performance, and taking complete accountability for results.
* Is proactive, resourceful, analytical, and capable of independently solving campaign-related challenges.
* Works effectively with social media, content, graphic design, and video editing teams.
* Is comfortable working directly with the Founder and contributing to business growth decisions.

**Work Arrangement**

* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Work Mode: Strictly Work From Office
* Working Days: 6 Days a Week
* This is a full-time, office-based position requiring close collaboration with internal teams. Remote and hybrid working arrangements are not available.

**Why Join Aakriti's Healverse?**

Own performance marketing across growing clothing, jewellery, and occult brands. Work directly with the Founder, drive innovative campaigns, and contribute to business growth. If you're passionate about generating sales, qualified leads, and measurable results, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Job Description: Social Media Manager**

**Company:**
Ember Foundry

**Role:**
Social Media Manager – Ember Foundry & Client Accounts

**Location:**
Gurgaon / Delhi NCR

**Experience:**
2–4 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Details**

* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time
* **Work Arrangement:**
  Hybrid — 4 days a week in office and 1 day working from home
* **Working Hours:**
  10:30 AM – 6:30 PM
* **Compensation:**
  ₹4.5 LPA (₹4,50,000 per annum)
* **Location:**
  Gurgaon / Delhi NCR

This is a full-time, hands-on role that requires regular in-office collaboration with the Ember Foundry team, clients and creative partners. The role combines content strategy, content creation, production coordination, agency management and day-to-day social media execution across Ember Foundry and its client accounts.

**About EF**

Ember Foundry is a research and strategy studio that helps Indian promoters make sharper business and brand decisions. We work at the intersection of human insight, business strategy, brand building and growth.

We are looking for a proactive, execution-oriented Social Media Manager to manage Ember Foundry's digital presence and social media for our client portfolio. This person will own the entire content lifecycle — from strategy and ideation to production, editing, publishing and performance tracking.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Social Media Strategy & Account Management

* Develop social media strategies aligned with the business objectives, brand positioning and target audiences of Ember Foundry and its clients.
* Build and manage monthly content calendars across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Establish content pillars, recurring formats, campaign ideas and platform-specific strategies.
* Manage multiple social media accounts simultaneously, ensuring consistency, quality and timely execution.
* Stay updated on platform developments, audience behaviour, relevant trends and emerging content formats.

2. Content Ideation & Creation

* Generate original content ideas, campaigns, reels, carousels, static posts, stories and thought leadership content.
* Research brands, industries, competitors and target audiences to develop relevant and differentiated content.
* Write copy, captions, scripts, hooks, headlines and creative briefs.
* Create content hands-on when required, using tools such as Canva and other content creation platforms.
* Develop founder-led content, interviews, case studies, behind-the-scenes stories and educational content.
* Translate complex business and strategic ideas into engaging, accessible social media content.

3. End-to-End Content Production & Editing

* Take ownership of the complete content production process, from initial idea to final publication.
* Develop clear briefs for designers, video editors, photographers, production agencies and other creative partners.
* Coordinate shoots, interviews, content capture, asset collection and production schedules.
* Work closely with editors to ensure videos, reels and other assets meet the creative brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Review first cuts, provide consolidated feedback, manage revisions and ensure final assets are delivered to the required standard.
* Proofread and quality-check all content, including copy, visuals, subtitles, transitions, branding and formatting, before publication.
* Maintain a structured workflow for content creation, feedback, approvals, version control and delivery.
* Ensure content is delivered on time and that production bottlenecks are resolved proactively.

4. Agency & Vendor Management

* Manage external creative, social media, video production and design agencies wherever engaged.
* Act as the central point of coordination between Ember Foundry, its clients and external partners.
* Brief agencies clearly on objectives, deliverables, timelines, budgets and quality expectations.
* Track deliverables, follow up on deadlines and ensure agencies meet agreed scopes of work.
* Review agency outputs critically and ensure they align with brand strategy and the original brief.
* Consolidate feedback from internal stakeholders and clients, communicate revisions and drive projects to closure.
* Monitor production costs, timelines and resource utilisation where relevant.
* Identify gaps in agency performance and recommend improvements or alternative partners when necessary.

5. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Understand client objectives, brand guidelines, target audiences and campaign requirements.
* Coordinate content approvals, feedback cycles and deliverables across multiple accounts.
* Present content calendars, creative ideas and recommendations to clients confidently.
* Manage client expectations and communicate delays, dependencies and changes proactively.
* Build strong working relationships with clients, internal teams, freelancers and external agencies.

6. Building Ember Foundry's Brand

* Build Ember Foundry's presence as an insight-led research and strategy studio.
* Develop content around consumer behaviour, business challenges, brand strategy, market insights and growth.
* Convert research, frameworks, case studies and project learnings into compelling content.
* Strengthen founder-led thought leadership and the studio's LinkedIn presence.
* Establish distinctive content formats that reflect Ember Foundry's point of view and expertise.

7. Publishing, Analytics & Optimisation

* Manage scheduling, publishing and day-to-day account operations.
* Track reach, engagement, saves, shares, video views, clicks, follower growth and other relevant metrics.
* Prepare monthly performance reports with clear insights and recommendations.
* Identify successful content formats and opportunities to improve performance.
* Evaluate content against its intended business and communication objectives.

**Skills & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in social media management, content marketing or digital communications.
* Experience managing multiple brands or client accounts, preferably in an agency environment.
* Strong writing, ideation, storytelling and communication skills.
* Hands-on experience managing content production, including coordination with designers and video editors.
* Preferred digital mkting or content creation backgrounds
* Experience managing external agencies, freelancers or creative vendors.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage several deadlines simultaneously.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram, Canva, Meta Business Suite and social media analytics.
* Good visual judgement, attention to detail and an understanding of brand consistency.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and follow through without constant supervision.

**What success looks like**

* Content moves smoothly from ideation to publication with minimal delays.
* Agencies, editors and designers are briefed effectively and deliver quality work on time.
* Content calendars are consistently executed across Ember Foundry and client accounts.
* Content quality reflects each brand's positioning and objectives.
* Clients receive proactive communication, reliable delivery and thoughtful recommendations.
* Social media performance improves through regular analysis and optimisation.

Application

Please share your CV and a portfolio of social media accounts managed, content created, campaigns executed and examples of work coordinated with external agencies or creative teams.

* **We are looking for someone who can own the process end to end — from the first idea to the final published asset.**

title: Category Growth Manager, Experiences (Middle East)
description:
**Alike.io**



is a passionate bunch of people, working hard to make it easy for everyone to travel like the people they like. We are the world’s first unified AI social travel platform: travel content creators share their travel stories from their personal travel studios, and Eia, our AI travel companion, turns that social content into trip ideas, then plans and books the entire holiday – from hotels, experiences, visas and commute to eSIMs – all in one place, supporting travellers before, during and after their trip with real human experts.

We are looking for enthusiastic folks with a get-it-done mindset to join us in this mission. For us, hard work is important, but even more important is keeping our promises, delivering on our commitments. Being a hero is good at Alike but being a team player is priceless. And finally, making the right choice usually means going the difficult path, and that is the Alike way.

**The role**

As a Growth Manager, Experiences (Middle East), you will own the customer-facing side of our Experiences business in the Middle East, with a key focus on UAE. You will be the revenue owner for the geography, responsible for the user journey, website conversion, pricing, promotions and propositions that turn demand into bookings. You will report to the Director, Experiences and work in close partnership with the Supply Manager, Middle East, who owns supplier sourcing and contracting, as well as with the marketing, digital commerce, product, operations and finance teams.

You will take a data led approach to test and improve the customer journey and propositions across channels and customer segments and will be the in-market expert on what travelers want to do and experience in the region.

.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the revenue and margin targets for Experiences in the Middle East, with a focus on UAE – plan, forecast and deliver against them.
* Develop and execute the category strategy and roadmap for the Middle East, aligned with the global Experiences strategy and informed by customer insights, market research and competitor analysis.
* Own the end-to-end user journey for Middle East experiences, from discovery and search through to booking and post-booking, identifying and removing friction at every step.
* Drive conversion rate optimisation (CRO) on the website – define and run A/B tests, and optimise listing pages, content and checkout in collaboration with the product, digital and design teams.
* Manage the end-to-end proposition lifecycle, from ideation and validation to launch and optimisation, ensuring that propositions across attractions, tours, activities and curated experiences are customer-focused, differentiated and profitable.
* Develop and implement pricing strategies, aware of the seasonality, events and festivals, booking window, demand fluctuations and competitor pricing.
* Plan and run promotions, offers and campaigns with the marketing team, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and margin.
* Partner with the Supply Manager, Middle East and cross-functional stakeholders, including marketing, digital commerce, product, operations, finance and customer support, translating customer demand and performance data into supply priorities and delivering propositions that meet customer expectations and business goals.
* Monitor and report on funnel and commercial performance using data and customer feedback and contribute to the global Experiences playbook by sharing learnings with the other geographies.

.

**Key requirements for the role**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* A deep understanding of the UAE market dynamics and trends is a must.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering successful and innovative propositions that meet customer needs and drive revenue and margin growth.
* Use AI-powered dashboards, analytics and experimentation tools to monitor funnel and commercial performance in near real time, and to inform pricing, promotions and conversion decisions.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Creative and customer-oriented mindset, with a passion for travel and creating memorable experiences.
* Highly motivated, self-driven and results-oriented, able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

 

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Private medical insurance
* Family friendly work environment, we understand what’s important in people’s lives
* A supportive and ambitious team to help you grow

description:
**Job Description: Chief of Staff**

Join the dynamic team at Wholsum Foods and be part of an extraordinary movement! Our mission is simple: to change the world's eats. With brands like Slurrp Farm and Mille, we offer healthy and delicious alternatives to the junk food epidemic. It's time to rediscover the nutritious traditions of our ancestors and embrace the power of millets like Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, and Foxtail Millet.

Led by founders - Shauravi Malik and Meghana Narayan, we are food enthusiasts, entrepreneurs, and mothers committed to making a difference. We're expanding globally and seeking talented individuals who thrive in a collaborative, innovative, and high-growth environment. Join us and embark on a rewarding journey where you can grow professionally while having a blast!

At Wholsum Foods, we celebrate diversity and unity, all driven by a shared mission to revolutionize the way we eat. Our team is our greatest asset, and our core values—Relationship First, Dependable, Passionate, and Growth Mindset—bring out the best in each team member. We take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace, embracing individuals regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Together, we will redefine the future of food!

**We are also Great Place to Work Certified.**

**ROLE OVERVIEW:**

We’re looking for a
**Chief of Staff**
to work directly with the leadership team to launch new business verticals from the ground up. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role designed for someone who wants to get their hands dirty and learn what it takes to build new businesses inside our fast-growing FMCG company.

**0→1 Execution**

* Own and execute new growth projects from scratch—market sizing, opportunity analysis, go-to-market plans.
* Lead pilot launches, track early performance, and rapidly iterate based on data and feedback.

**Customer & Market Research**

* Drive deep user research to understand customer needs, pain points, and behaviors.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking and identify whitespace opportunities.

**Sales & Revenue Focus**

* Set up early sales channels (online/offline), build distribution strategy, and close initial partnerships or accounts.
* Hit early revenue milestones while laying the groundwork for scale.

**Cross-Functional Hustle**

* Collaborate across Product, Ops, Marketing, and Finance to build full-stack solutions.
* Act as a connector between teams to move fast and stay aligned.

* Prepare insights, presentations, and updates for internal and external stakeholders.

?**

* Strong analytical skills, structured thinking, and a bias for action.
* A creative mindset with the ability to work with products and content.
* A background in literature or related fields is preferred.
* Passionate about building new things and learning by doing.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Hungry to grow, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited about consumer brands.

?**

* A front-row seat to scale a purpose-led FMCG brand with a fast-paced professional growth and ownership
* Mentorship from creative and strategic leaders with a creative environment that values experimentation and bold thinking
* Shape Wholsum Foods' next phase of innovation - “from kids foods” to the next category disruptor.
* Real ownership. Real impact. Real learning.

**Starting Date: Immediately**

**Location: Gurgaon**

title: Director - Field Marketing India
description:
**Who We Are**
We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.
  
  
Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.
  
  
**What We’ll Need**
As Director, Field Marketing India, you will be the marketing leader responsible for establishing Wingstop in one of our priority international growth markets. Partnering closely with the VP & Managing Director, India, our Brand Partner, Operations and cross-functional GSC teams, you will build the brand strategy and go-to-market approach for India, beginning with our first restaurant opening in Bangalore.
  
  

* You will translate Wingstop’s global brand DNA into a locally relevant, culturally resonant proposition for Indian consumers, creating the foundation for awareness, trial, traffic, sales and long-term brand affinity as the business scales across the market.
* Partner closely with the VP & Managing Director, India, Brand Partner, Operations and International Marketing to develop and execute the India marketing strategy and launch roadmap.
* Own Wingstop’s brand strategy and positioning for India, ensuring our global brand DNA is translated with local cultural relevance and a clear point of difference in market.
* Lead the end-to-end go-to-market plan for our first Bangalore restaurant opening, including audience strategy, creative, media, digital and social, PR, influencers, partnerships, local activation and launch execution.
* Build an India marketing plan and investment framework that supports market entry, restaurant growth and future expansion, with clear objectives, priorities, budgets and measurement.
* Develop a scalable market-entry and new restaurant opening playbook that can be applied as Wingstop expands beyond Bangalore into additional cities.
* Lead local consumer, cultural, category and competitive insight work to identify the audiences, occasions and behaviors that can accelerate awareness, trial and repeat.
* Establish and lead the local agency ecosystem, including RFPs, agency selection, briefing, creative development and performance management across key marketing disciplines. Work with relevant teams to build and grow ordering through brand owned digital channels, improve conversions, repeat orders and AUV.
* Partner in creating CRM and Loyalty roadmap to eventually build a robust, data-driven customer ecosystem.
* Develop National level, State level and Hyperlocal relationships that help in traffic generation, including partnering closely with DSPs to maximize brand visibility though business planning and targeted promotions.
* Guide localization of global campaigns and creative assets while protecting Wingstop brand standards, tone of voice and visual identity.
* Act as a strategic marketing advisor to the Brand Partner, influencing marketing investment, local market priorities and long-term brand-building decisions.
* Collaborate with Regional Marketing Directors continuously optimize activity based on data and learning.
* Identify and activate culturally relevant partnerships, influencers, events and local moments that can build fame and make Wingstop meaningful to Indian consumers.
* Work cross-functionally with Operations, Development, Culinary, Supply Chain and other teams to ensure the guest proposition, menu storytelling and launch experience are aligned to the brand strategy.
* Manage marketing programs within budget targets, maximize return on investment, and prepare regular performance updates and strategic recommendations for India and GSC leadership.
* Proactively introduce new ideas, test-and-learn initiatives and scalable solutions, sharing learnings and best practices with the wider Wingstop international team.

**What You’ll Need**

* Minimum 8 years marketing experience, with significant experience in field, brand or market-entry marketing
* A track record of turning consumer and cultural insight into strong brand strategy and measurable commercial outcomes
* BS/BA in Marketing or related field
* Experience across brand strategy, integrated marketing, media, digital and social
* Experience leading agencies and complex cross-functional stakeholder groups
* Experience building brands in India and/or launching into new markets strongly preferred
* High stamina to travel up to 50%, work extended hours as needed, including nights, weekends and holidays.

**Who You Are**
No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.
  
  
You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.
  
  
You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.
  
  
You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.
  
  
You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Wingstop provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law.

* Own the APAC events calendar, including Material-hosted flagship events, executive roundtables and dinners, sponsored industry conferences and partner-led events
* Set objectives, target audience and budget for each event, and run it end to end: venue, agenda, speakers, invitations, on-site delivery and follow-up
* Work with revenue teams before each event to build the invite list from target accounts and open opportunities, and after each event to make sure every lead and meeting is logged and followed up in Salesforce
* Measure each event against pipeline created, meetings booked and cost per opportunity, and use the results to decide what to repeat, change or drop
* Manage event agencies, venues and vendors across the region

**PR and Communications**

* Build and run the APAC PR program, working with the global communications team and regional PR agencies
* Secure media, analyst and industry coverage for Material's work, leaders and point of view in priority APAC markets
* Identify speaking slots and awards for Material's regional leaders and manage the submissions
* Prepare regional spokespeople with messaging, briefing documents and media training
* Adapt global announcements and thought leadership for APAC audiences and local press

**Partner Marketing**

* Own the regional marketing relationship with Material's technology and channel partners, working with the global Partner team
* Build joint marketing plans with priority partners: co-hosted events, co-authored content, joint campaigns and shared pipeline goals
* Secure partner marketing funds and co-marketing commitments for APAC, and track how they are used
* Coordinate partner-sourced leads and joint opportunities with the revenue team so they are tracked and followed up

**Regional Planning and Measurement**

* Build the annual APAC marketing plan and budget with the VP, Marketing and the regional revenue leader
* Report monthly on pipeline influenced, coverage secured and partner activity
* Give the global marketing team regular feedback on what is and is not working in the region
* Make sure all APAC activity follows Material's brand and messaging standards

**Must Have's**

* 10+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 3 years leading events, PR or partner marketing in APAC
* A record of running events that produced pipeline, not just attendance
* Existing relationships with business and trade media, agencies and partner marketing teams in the region
* Deep understanding of Material's service offerings, or the ability to build it quickly
* Experience in Salesforce and/or other CRM tools
* Experience managing agencies and a regional marketing budget
* Comfortable working across time zones with a global team and a regional sales team
* Works in a self-directed manner to achieve critical time-dependent milestones on time and with high quality
* Ability to multitask and handle multiple simultaneous projects

PREWAL Studio Private Limited is a garment manufacturing and export company based in Gurugram.
