title: Griffin Club - Brand and Communications Lead
description:
Inc42 is India’s
**#1 startup media & intelligence platform**
that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated Events & Conferences & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.
  
  
Since launching in
**January 2015**
and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India’s startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. We also track over
**10,000+ startups**
and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and Events for startup & business leaders across India.
  
  
**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
* Published more than 55,000 stories
* Successfully conducted 125+ events
* Launched 100+ research reports
* Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
* Worked with 350+ brands

**Griffin**
is a private, invitation-only club that
**unites India’s top tech founders**
through
**curated experiences, strategic learning, and peer-driven growth**
. Designed for
**India’s unicorn and soonicorn founders**
– building at scale, Griffin offers a
**trusted space**
where founders don’t just network–they
**forge deep, meaningful relationships, share unfiltered insights, and collaborate to shape India’s next chapter of innovation**
.
  
  
From intimate salons and high-trust retreats to access to capital and exclusive opportunities, Griffin offers a
**curated path to clarity, collaboration, and personal growth**
. More than a community, it’s the inner circle powering the next wave of industry-shaping leaders.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Griffin is Inc42's most valuable brand and the one it has marketed least, on purpose. There are no ads, no "join now", no discounts and no always-on feed, because scarcity of content is part of the scarcity of the club. What Griffin has instead is a room, a bar for who gets in, a set of moments that members rearrange their year for, and a voice that has never had a single owner.
  
  
We are hiring that owner. At Griffin, brand marketing
*is*
communication: how the outside learns about the bar without ever being sold a seat; how a member is spoken to on a Tuesday; how a Retreat becomes news without a single member being named; how the object a founder takes home says what the club is. You will own all of it, at both cadences, the daily and the defining.
  
  
**Your Impact In This Role and what you’ll own:**

* Griffin's voice, in practice: every word to a member, a prospective founder, a speaker, a partner, a minister's office or a listed-company founder, across WhatsApp, email, invitations, briefs, the website and the printed thing on the table. Sharp, sparse, warm, never generic.
* Marketing the door: the curation narrative and the "who gets in" beats; a consented, discreet series on what happens in the room; the waitlist and referral-only mechanic made visible; the founders' own channels; griffin.club and the Retreat site. Demand without a single paid rupee.
* Earned media: the stories that come out of Griffin's rooms, placed in tier-1 media without breaking a confidence. A Retreat, a Salon abroad, a member's milestone: you see the news in it and you know who to call.
* Brand moments: how a Salon arrives, what a Retreat leaves in the hand, the partner activations, the gifting drops and the limited editions. You design them; operations, partnerships and design produce them to your brief.
* The referral ask: designed so that being asked to refer feels like status, with the club's owner.
* The systems: message banks, invitation formats, briefing structures, a follow-up tracker, so quality does not depend on last-minute drafting. AI used intelligently for speed; human judgment on every send.
* The leading indicators: qualified applications, waitlist depth, the share of members who joined by referral, earned-media hits, and how the club is recalled by the founders who are not yet in it.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Brand Positioning
* Own Griffin's positioning, narrative, tone of voice and communication principles across all touchpoints.
* Maintain a consistent and distinctive brand identity that reflects Griffin's exclusivity, discretion and founder-first philosophy.
* Lead brand storytelling across Griffin's website, brochures, institutional presentations, event collateral and other brand assets.
* Work closely with design and creative teams to ensure that both visual identity and written communication reflect Griffin's positioning.
* Develop thoughtful organic initiatives that build brand recall, desirability and qualified interest among relevant founders.
* Founder & Member Communications
* Own communication across the member journey — prospect outreach, introductions, onboarding, ongoing engagement, important milestones and renewals.
* Develop personalised communication for founders, members and senior stakeholders through WhatsApp, email, invitations, briefs and other formats.
* Translate Griffin's work, member experiences and key moments into compelling, discreet and founder-first narratives.
* Design communication around referrals, member advocacy and Griffin's curated membership approach.
* Ensure every member interaction feels considered, personal and consistent with the stature of the collective.
* Brand Marketing, PR & Earned Media
* Identify and develop compelling stories emerging from Griffin's Salons, Retreats, institutional engagements and member milestones.
* Build relationships with relevant editors, journalists and media platforms to generate meaningful earned coverage.
* Drive Griffin's organic brand presence through its website, founder channels, selective storytelling and other relevant platforms.
* Build visibility without compromising member confidentiality, private conversations or the discretion expected of Griffin.
* Track qualified founder interest, referrals, earned media and brand visibility indicators.
* Brand Experiences & Event Communication
* Own the brand and communication experience across Griffin Salons, Retreats, private dinners, international delegations and institutional gatherings.
* Lead communication across the event journey — save-the-dates, invitations, speaker communication, agenda narratives, attendee updates and post-event engagement.
* Conceptualise brand moments including gifting, limited-edition keepsakes, welcome experiences and partner-led activations.
* Translate concepts into clear creative briefs and work with design, operations and partnerships teams to bring them to life.
* Ensure every Griffin experience reinforces the brand's premium, thoughtful and understated character.
* Government, Institutional & Strategic Communications
* Develop high-quality communication for government leadership, embassies, regulators, institutional investors, global organisations and strategic partners.
* Support Griffin leadership with institutional decks, briefing notes, formal correspondence, introductions and follow-up communication.
* Position Griffin as a credible collective representing India's leading technology founders.
* Maintain the diplomatic judgment, accuracy and discretion required when engaging with senior stakeholders in India and internationally.
* Brand & Communication Infrastructure
* Build and maintain Griffin's communication repository, including message banks, invitation formats, brand guidelines, founder introduction templates and briefing structures.
* Establish communication calendars, review processes, outreach trackers and follow-up mechanisms.
* Work cross-functionally with design, events, partnerships and Griffin leadership to ensure timely execution.
* Use AI tools intelligently to improve research, drafting and execution speed while retaining human judgment and brand consistency.

**Who You Are**

* You write with restraint. You know the difference between premium and verbose, and you know what not to say. You have a piece you did not publish and you can explain why.
* You have run communications for a senior audience: in luxury or hospitality, private banking or wealth, a premium members' organisation, or as an editor or senior journalist who became a communications lead. Not corporate press-release volume; considered communication for people who are hard to impress.
* You can make news without naming anyone. You have placed stories, you know editors, and you understand that discretion is what makes the story worth telling.
* You have designed a moment, a launch, an arrival, an object, a room, where the brand did the talking and the budget was real.
* You have taste and a bias for action: strong first drafts, the right questions, things pushed to closure without being chased.
* You are discreet by instinct and diplomatic by training. You can write to a founder, a minister and a member in the same hour and get all three right.
* Five to eight years. Ecosystem fluency, or genuine curiosity about India's founders, capital markets and policy, is a strong advantage.

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

* Strong strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
* Genuine interest in marketing, distribution, growth, or business strategy.
* Ability to move from ideas to execution and learn from experiments.
* Curiosity about user behaviour, learning, and community building.
* Initiative, ownership, consistency, and comfort with early-stage uncertainty.
* Willingness to collaborate, challenge assumptions constructively, and make decisions together.
* A genuine interest in building a venture over the long term.

Previous startup or growth experience is valuable, but we are open to candidates who can demonstrate strong thinking, initiative, and execution through projects or practical ideas.

A large personal following is not a requirement.

What this opportunity offers

* A genuine opportunity to help build BookVidya from an early stage.
* Shared strategic responsibility for growth and distribution.
* The opportunity to shape the venture's direction alongside the founding team.
* A founding partnership with equity and responsibilities to be discussed transparently and agreed upon.

**Important:**
This is an early-stage co-founder opportunity, not a guaranteed salaried position. Compensation, equity, time commitment, and other founding arrangements will be discussed with suitable candidates before any commitment is made.

How to express interest

Please share a brief introduction, relevant experience or projects, why BookVidya interests you, and how you would approach acquiring our first 100 genuinely engaged learners.

We are looking for a thoughtful partner who wants to build, experiment, and grow with us over the long term.

title: Senior Manager / AVP – Growth (International)
description:
**Take Stefto global. Build the international business from the ground up, with a direct line to the CEO.**

**About Stefto**

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Gurugram, Stefto is a technology-enabled Business Process Management (BPM) company delivering customer care, engagement and debt management solutions at scale. We run inbound and outbound support, sales and retention programs for leading brands, and manage collections and debt resolution for India’s largest banks and Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs). Powered by AI, automation and analytics, we help clients deliver faster, smarter and more personalised customer experiences. With a strong presence across major Indian cities, Stefto is now taking its proven model to international markets.

**The Opportunity**

This is a builder’s role. You’ll own Stefto’s international revenue agenda end to end: choosing the markets, opening the doors, closing the deals and growing the accounts, backed by a delivery engine that already serves India’s top banks and ARCs.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and execute the international growth strategy across priority markets (US, UK, Middle East, APAC)
* Win new clients for Stefto’s customer care, CX, collections and debt management services

title: Manager - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.
  
  
BCG’s PIPE Practice Area works with the world’s largest investment firms, serving six client asset classes: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Infrastructure & Real Estate Funds, Family Offices, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Pension Plans. Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required; 6-10+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
  
  
Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

**Additional Information**
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
***Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)***

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)***

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

***Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)***

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Coordinate with internal departments and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of projects, training programs, events, sales activities, and client requirements.

Manage and utilize organizational software, CRM systems, data management platforms,

and other digital tools to improve operational efficiency and streamline processes.

**Business Development Initiatives:**

Drive initiatives aimed at expanding the organization's client base, increasing training registrations, developing partnerships, and exploring new markets and opportunities.

**External Representation & Partnerships:**

Represent the organization at government meetings, conferences, training programs, exhibitions, promotional events, and other external engagements while fostering partnerships and strengthening the organization's brand presence.

**Travel & Field Engagement:**

Be willing to travel extensively across different states as required for business development, training promotion, client meetings, government coordination, events, and sales activities.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong client relationship and negotiation skills.

Sales and business development mindset.

Ability to communicate training and certification programs effectively.

Comfortable with extensive interstate travel and field sales.

Government/client coordination experience.

Good data management and analytical skills.

Proficiency in CRM, MS Excel, and business software.

Strong follow-up and lead-conversion abilities.

Event and training coordination skills.

Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams.

Professional presentation and networking skills.

The primary objective of this role is to strengthen client and government relationships, drive business growth, promote Fostac Training & Certification programs across different states, generate and convert sales opportunities, and ensure smooth execution of organizational projects and training initiatives.

title: Account Technology
description:
**Overview**
Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership in PSU / Government space, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team.
  
  
Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid- to long-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives.
  
  
Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities.
  
  
Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross-industry resources, and partners with line-of-business leader or senior executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions.
  
  
Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings.
  
  
Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning.
  
  
Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Customer and Industry Insights
  
  
Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) and thought leadership to identify and inform the development of the right Industry Sales Kits and industry partners within the customer's vertical industry. Articulates and understands specific industry-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry. Leverages industry trends from other industries to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries. Applies industry knowledge to support customers in solving issues.
  
  
Synthesizes and combines various business and industry insights from their team, global best practices, proof points from experience/case studies with countries and/or regions, and deep industry expertise (e.g., level 200) related to customers and their competitors to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts and subsidiary planning. Ensures that all levels of the organization challenge customers to consider alternatives and adapt strategies, plans, business models, and solutions to insights. Orchestrates cross-regional teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Oversees technical teams for driving opportunities with others, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
  
  
Differentiated Value Proposition
  
  
Partners with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization to articulate how complex Microsoft technology/services will meet future business needs better than the competition and will enable the achievement of long-term growth and success. Provides an outside-in view around existing and emerging compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
  
  
Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization senior leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Develops extended relationships beyond core customers, advises on solutions, and aligns Microsoft capabilities with customer needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, collaboration, AI). Leads customer business transformations through digital technologies for assigned accounts to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers by understanding customer industry and position to provide guidance and to challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction, and proactively involves corporate and cross-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write-ups) as reference for scale, and represents the face of the business during public relations events for significant business wins.
  
  
Education and Thought Leadership
  
  
Leads customer technology engagement by engaging and influencing technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams.
  
  
Uses existing and new readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans for large and high-stakes customers, and all-up Microsoft business. Drives innovations to help customers meet capacity and capability goals, maximize reach, and impact and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform, and influences large customers to see and adopt the strategic value. Drives customer skilling initiatives and execution.
  
  
Mapping and Account Planning
  
  
Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery for large, critical, and/or strategic accounts. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
  
  
Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business or end users. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan, and builds out an execution framework across multiple Rooms of the House of the customer.
  
  
Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
  
  
Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
  
  
Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.
  
  
Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Leverages expertise of current technology landscape and understanding of AI and Industrial Metaverse capabilities to plot the foundational elements on the technology roadmap that need to be in place to realize value for the customer. Builds a mid-term strategy for AI and metaverse projects as well as an immediate opportunity pipeline and orchestrates execution through the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) and with appropriate Partners
  
  
Creates, develops, and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to create and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Leverages experience and strategic foresight to lead technical teams by driving opportunities with Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Leads efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses advanced technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
  
  
Technology Strategy Formulation
  
  
Creates mid- and long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) multi-horizon technology and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
  
  
Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end-to-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
  
  
Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation, and driving technology adoption.
  
  
Trusted Advisor
  
  
Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
  
  
Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
  
  
Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
  
  
Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker [TDM]/business decision maker [BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 12+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
6+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
  
  
6+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.

title: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)
description:
Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)

Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time 

About Voice Arena

Voice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.

We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.

Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:

* Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.
* Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.
* Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.
* A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.

About the role

Voice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.

We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.

The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?

This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.

In this role, you will

The work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:

1. Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.
2. Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.
3. Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.
4. Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.
5. Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.
6. Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.

In a typical week, you might:

* Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same day
* Plan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research team
* Build a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach them
* Brief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their posts
* Look at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's plan

What matters most

Everything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.

1. Reaching the right people

Reach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:

* Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.
* Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.
* Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.
* Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.

2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systems

Today a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:

* Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.
* Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.
* Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.
* Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.
* Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.

What we offer

* High ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.
* A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.
* Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.
* Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.

Minimum qualifications

* 2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused company
* A track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourself
* Strong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart caption
* Comfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on it
* Genuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluated
* High ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the details

Preferred qualifications

*You don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.*

* Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI company
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targeting
* An existing network among AI researchers, builders or creators
* Experience running creator or influencer campaigns
* Basic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)
* Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move faster

Why join Voice Arena

* Shape how voice AI gets built. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.
* See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across languages, often before most of the field has tried them.
* Grow something with substance. You'll be growing a brand built on real research: papers at Interspeech 2026, a Hugging Face partnership and benchmarks the field checks.
* Reach the whole world's speech. Our data and evals reach far beyond English, across the wider Global South, so the audience is global.
* Join early. Join a small, talent-dense team early, and shape the product, the team and how we grow.

How to apply

Send your CV, a short note and links to accounts, posts or campaigns you've grown to amritansh@voicearena.com.

title: Key Account Manager, Offline
description:
Job description:
  
  

**Key Account Manager, Offline**

**Glanbia**

**Join this dynamic team focused on delivering better nutrition for every step of life’s journey**

**The Opportunity**

The Key Account Manager is responsible for driving profitable growth across assigned strategic accounts by building strong customer partnerships, delivering revenue and margin targets, and executing joint business plans.

The role is the primary commercial interface between Glanbia and key customers, ensuring excellence in assortment, availability, visibility, promotions, inventory management, service, and customer profitability. The KAM will work closely with Marketing, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Finance, and Customer Service to deliver sustainable growth and strengthen Glanbia’s position across priority offline channel

**Responsibilities**

**Account Management & Business Growth**

* Own end-to-end business delivery for assigned key accounts, including revenue, volume, NSV, gross profit, and market share objectives.
* Develop annual and quarterly account plans aligned with company and customer priorities.
* Identify growth opportunities through assortment expansion, improved distribution, new product launches, premiumization, and customer-specific programs.
* Build strong relationships with buyers, category teams, commercial stakeholders, and senior customer leadership.
* Lead annual Joint Business Planning discussions and translate agreed priorities into clear initiatives, targets, owners, and timelines.
* Track delivery against the JBP and initiate corrective actions where performance is off plan.

**Commercial Negotiation & Trade Investment**

* Lead negotiations on annual trade terms, pricing, margins, promotions, listings, visibility, and commercial agreements.

**Sales Performance & Analytics**

* Monitor sell-in, sell-out, inventory, distribution, assortment, and promotional performance by customer and SKU.
* Use customer and market data to identify gaps, risks, and growth opportunities, and convert insights into actions.
* Maintain accurate account forecasts and provide customer inputs for business planning and S&OP reviews.
* Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment, and in-store execution.

**Demand, Supply & Service Management**

* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to ensure product availability and healthy inventory.
* Minimize stock-outs, excess inventory, aged stock, short supplies, and order fulfilment issues.
* Coordinate timely order processing and drive improvement in customer service levels and OTIF.

**Execution Excellence**

* Ensure agreed assortment, availability, visibility, pricing, planograms, and promotional plans are executed across customer outlets.
* Drive high-quality launch execution for new products and track post-launch performance.
* Undertake periodic market visits to assess execution standards, shopper experience, and competitor activity.

**KPIs & Success Metrics**

* Annual Business Revenue, Margins, and market share delivery
* Account profitability and trade spend ROI
* JBP achievement and growth initiative delivery
* Sell-out growth, distribution, assortment, availability, and visibility
* Forecast accuracy, inventory health, service level, and OTIF

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* 6+ years of experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, sports nutrition, consumer goods, Modern Trade, Pharmacy, or related channels with at least 3+ years of experience in Key Account management.
* Demonstrated experience managing strategic national or regional accounts and commercial negotiations.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint;

**Where and how you will work**

The opportunity will be based in
**Gurgaon, India**
with hybrid working arrangements available which offer you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.

**What we would like to offer you!**

The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, generous family leave policy, health & dental plan and competitive salary.

**About Glanbia**

Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. Collectively and with our partners we offer an incredible breadth of expertise in nutrition. We employ a team of 5800 people, work with global food and beverage companies, and sell our award-winning and market-leading brands and ingredients in more than 100 countries worldwide

At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a variety of candidates, we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

At Glanbia, our culture celebrates individuality, knowing that together we are more.

title: Category Lead
description:
About Lenskart.com

Lenskart is one of the world's fastest-growing eyewear brands 3,00+ stores and counting across India and a fast-expanding international footprint. Behind every store, every shelf, and every campaign sits a single question: what do we put in front of the customer, and why? That's the question this role owns.

**The opportunity**

As the brand scales across India and into new markets, we're looking for a Category Head to own its most important asset: the product.

This is a category-leadership role with real ownership. You'll decide what sells each season, how it's priced, how it's planned, and how it performs owning the category from the first sketch with the design team to the sell-through report at quarter-end. You'll balance a designer's eye for what's beautiful with a merchant's instinct for what sells, and you'll be measured on both the desirability of the range and the health of the P&L.

If you want to shape a brand's identity through its product and own the commercial outcome of those choices this is that role.

**What you'll own**

* **Category strategy & P&L.**
  Own the assortment and commercial performance of the category frames, sunglasses, and premium ranges driving revenue, margin, and full-price sell-through against clear targets.
* **Range & assortment architecture.**
  Define the seasonal range and good-better-best structure: hero products, newness, price tiers, and the breadth-versus-depth calls that keep the brand both premium and commercial.
* **Buying & merchandise planning.**
  Own open-to-buy, range planning, allocation, and inventory health the right product, in the right store and channel, in the right quantity, at the right time, with disciplined markdown management.
* **Pricing & margin.**
  Set the pricing architecture and promotional strategy that protects the brand's premium positioning while delivering category profitability.
* **Product lifecycle & launches.**
  Partner with Product and Design to brief, build, and launch new collections managing the full lifecycle from introduction and ramp-up to refresh and exit.
* **Cross-functional partnership.**
  Work hand-in-hand with Design, Marketing, Retail, Visual Merchandising, and Supply Chain to bring the range to life in-store and online and turn launches into commercial moments.
* **Data-led decisions.**
  Use sell-through, conversion, attach rate, and customer data to sharpen every assortment, pricing, and planning call and to course-correct fast.
* **Team leadership.**
  Build, lead, and mentor a category team of buyers, merchandisers, and planners as the brand scales.

**What you bring**

* Deep category management, buying, or merchandising experience in fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail, ideally with category P&L ownership.
* The rare blend of product instinct and commercial rigour an eye for what's desirable and the numbers to back what sells.
* Strong financial fluency: OTB, margin, markdown, and inventory planning are second nature.
* A feel for premium and brand-led product you understand how assortment choices build (or dilute) a brand.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership across Design, Marketing, Retail, and Supply Chain.
* The energy and structure to scale a category in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Merchandising, Retail Management, Business, Fashion, or a related field.
* 10–15+ years in category management, buying, or merchandise planning, including team leadership.
* Experience owning a category or range for a multi-store retail brand strongly preferred.
* Background in eyewear, fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail is a strong plus.

description:
**About Nory For You:**

**Nory For You (Nory**
) is a high-growth women's healthcare brand simplifying reproductive wellness and home fertility care. From doctor-designed At-Home Self-Insemination (IVI) Kits to advanced Ovulation (LH) and Pregnancy tracking solutions, Nory empowers women and couples across India to navigate their family planning journey with privacy, dignity, and scientific confidence.

**Core Mandate:**
**Scale Creator Operations**

This is an operational leadership role, not a manual campaign coordination position. You will architect and run Nory's programmatic creator engine, scaling from targeted partnerships to hundreds of active creator collaborations per month across medical, wellness, parenting, and lifestyle segments.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Scaled Pipeline & Sourcing Architecture: Build automated creator acquisition funnels across micro, macro, parenting, lifestyle, and Healthcare Professional (HCP/Doctor) cohorts to maintain a continuous, high-volume pipeline.
* Outreach, Negotiations & Contracting: Lead high-volume creator outreach, barter/paid commercial negotiations, contract execution, and usage rights acquisition (including Meta/YouTube whitelisting rights).
* Briefing & Execution Discipline: Develop empathetic, medically compliant content briefs for sensitive health topics; enforce strict execution timelines from product dispatch to live content QA.
* Performance Attribution & ROI: Track performance against hard commercial metrics (UTMs, promo code conversions, CPA, ROAS, Amazon search lift) and double down on winning content formats.
* Process Automation & Leadership: Transition operations from spreadsheets to automated creator tools/CRMs; build, lead, and direct a high-output influencer team as campaign volumes grow.

**Essential Qualifications & Experience :**

* Experience: 5 to 8 years in Influencer Marketing, Creator Partnerships, or Brand Growth in a scaled D2C brand (Beauty, Personal Care, FMCG, Health) or top-tier Influencer Agency.
* Proven High-Volume Track Record: Hands-on experience scaling creator operations to 100+ active creators per month or managing high-budget performance influencer campaigns.
* Tooling & CRM Proficiency: Practical expertise with influencer platforms (e.g., Modash, GRIN, Aspire, Phyllo) and CRM/project trackers (Airtable, Notion, Excel).
* Commercial & Legal Acumen: Strong contract negotiation skills with explicit knowledge of usage rights, whitelisting, exclusivity clauses, and ASCI advertising guidelines.
* Category Awareness: Experience or comfort in managing sensitive consumer/health categories (women's hygiene, wellness, OTC, or parenting) with clinical tact and tone.

**Core Behavioral Competencies :**

* Operational Rigor: Relentless execution mindset focused strictly on live content volume, attribution, and customer conversion.
* Category Sensitivity: Ability to handle delicate fertility and women's health topics with genuine empathy and medical compliance.
* High Sense of Ownership: Self-starter capable of building repeatable SOPs from scratch and leading junior coordinators.

**Why Nory For You?**

At Nory, you will have complete autonomy to build India's largest, most trusted creator-led women's health network. You will bridge authentic educational storytelling with data-driven performance marketing to transform home reproductive care nationwide.

Nory For You (Nory Health Pvt. Ltd.) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Hiring decisions are based on merit, competence, and business needs.

title: Associate – PPC (Digital Marketing)
description:
**Job Title: Associate – PPC (Digital Marketing)**

**Department: Performance Marketing / Digital Marketing**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Location: Delhi**

Role Overview

We are seeking a data-driven, analytical, and highly proactive Associate – PPC to own and scale our paid marketing initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for strategy, execution, and continuous optimization of pay-per-click (PPC) advertising campaigns across paid search, display, shopping, and paid social channels.

As an Associate, you are beyond the entry-level tactical execution stage. You will bridge the gap between creative marketing strategy and hardcore data analysis, directly influencing our customer acquisition costs (CAC) and return on ad spend (ROAS).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**
: Plan, build, and scale end-to-end PPC campaigns across channels like Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, Shopping, YouTube), Microsoft/Bing Ads, and Paid Social (Meta, LinkedIn, or platform-specific networks).

**Optimization & Bid Management:**
Continuously optimize live campaigns using advanced bidding models (Target CPA, Target ROAS). Conduct regular keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and negative keyword filtering.

**A/B Testing & Creative Direction:**
Collaborate with creative and content teams to conceptualize high-converting ad copy, landing pages, and visual assets. Run structured A/B tests on creatives and extensions to systematically boost Click-Through Rates (CTR) and Conversion Rates (CVR).

**Data Analysis & Reporting**
: Monitor daily/weekly performance metrics. Build and maintain transparent reporting dashboards (using Looker Studio, Tableau, or Excel) to deliver actionable insights on key metrics like CPC, CPA, ROAS, and Quality Score.

**Budget & Attribution Management:**
Manage significant ad budgets with meticulous control against overspend/underspend. Track multi-touch attribution funnels to understand cross-channel user behavior.

**Technical Implementation:**
Partner with web development teams to deploy and troubleshoot tracking tags via Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform pixels.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

Experience: 2–5 years of hands-on experience managing medium-to-large budget PPC campaigns (either agency-side or in-house).

**Platform Expertise**
: Expert-level mastery of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager is mandatory. Strong understanding of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

**Data-Driven Mindset:**
Excellent command over Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs are second nature).

**Analytical Rigor:**
Ability to turn complex, massive data sets into clear executive summaries and operational roadmaps.

**Certifications**
: Active Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications are highly preferred.

**Soft Skills:**
Strong time management skills, an eye for technical detail, and a proactive attitude toward staying up-to-date with shifts in privacy standards (cookie-less tracking) and platform automation.

**Core Objective**

We are not looking for a dashboard operator or a campaign launcher. We are hiring a Performance Marketing Lead with extreme analytical rigor and deep technical ownership to manage, optimize, and aggressively scale paid customer acquisition.

You will own the end-to-end performance engine: from server-side tracking integrity and creative iteration pipelines to bottom-of-funnel conversion rate optimization (CRO) and unit economics (CAC, MER, Blended ROAS, First-Time Contribution Margin).

* Google Ads: Manage Performance Max, Google Search, Google Shopping, and Demand Generation campaigns while minimizing brand cannibalization.
* Budget & Optimization: Allocate spend based on Customer Acquisition Cost and Marketing Efficiency Ratio, while optimizing Return on Ad Spend and overall unit economics.

* 2. Technical Infrastructure, CAPI & MeasurementConversion Tracking: Manage end-to-end tracking across Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, and Meta Conversions API, ensuring reliable server-side tracking.
* Event Optimization: Maintain strong Event Match Quality by passing enriched user parameters such as email, phone, external ID, fbp, and fbc.
* Attribution & Feed Audits: Audit postback signals, browser-server deduplication, Google Merchant Center feeds, and offline conversion imports.

* 3. Creative Strategy & The Iteration EngineCreative Performance: Analyze creative fatigue and drop-offs using Thumbstop Rate, Hold Rate, and Outbound Click-Through Rate.
* Creative Testing: Turn performance insights into briefs and systematically test hooks, angles, and formats including User-Generated Content, 2D explainers, Video Sales Letters, and static creatives.

* 4. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Funnel ArchitectureLanding Page Development: Build and optimize high-converting landing pages using Replo, PageFly, or Webflow, tailored to specific traffic angles.
* Funnel Optimization: Analyze drop-offs from Landing Page View to Initiate Checkout and Payment Success, while A/B testing messaging, pricing, social proof, and checkout experience.

* 5. Marketplace & Quick Commerce Synergies (Added Advantage)Omnichannel Visibility: Track how direct-to-consumer paid media drives brand searches and sales across Amazon, Flipkart, and Quick Commerce platforms.
* Retail Media Scaling: Optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and platform keywords to improve organic search ranking and shelf placement.

**Technical & Skill Requirements:**

Hands-on experience scaling monthly spends of ₹20L-₹1Cr+ (25k-120k+) on Meta & Google Ads with verifiable proof of scale.

Analytics & Data Deep proficiency in GA4, BigQuery/Looker Studio, Shopify Analytics, and custom UTM parameter governance.

Tracking Stack Practical configuration experience with GTM (Web & Server-side), CAPI gateways / Stape.io, and event deduplication.

CRO Toolkit Experience with Hotjar/Microsoft Clarity, A/B testing tools, and rapid landing page builders.

(Bonus) Working knowledge of Amazon Ads Console and Quick Commerce visibility mechanics (Zepto/Blinkit ad networks).

**Non-Negotiable Mindset:**

Critical Thinking & Extreme OwnershipRoot-Cause Ownership: Never blame platform algorithms; diagnose performance dips across Cost Per Mille, creative fatigue, landing page speed, and payment failures.

First-Principles Thinking: Approach growth mathematically, understanding how Average Order Value, Cost Per Click, Conversion Rate, and Repeat Purchase Rate work together to drive scalable acquisition.

Speed & Autonomy: Move fast without dependency on agencies or development teams-identify issues, develop solutions, and launch fresh tests within 24 hours.

: Based on experience, proof of work, and ability to own accounts + creative strategy.

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
**Summary**
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.
  
  
**Description**
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Gurgaon team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.
  
  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.
  
  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.
  
  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.
  
  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.
  
  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus
* Minimum 10 years of experience managing a sales team
* Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.
* Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.
* Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.
* A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.
* Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.
* Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.
* Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.
* Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.
* Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: Vendor Performance Manager, SMB Growth
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in operations or business management, and vendor management.
* 7 years of experience using analytics or applying project management tools to address business issues.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing or accelerating sales portfolios across regional/international markets within fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Proven track record of orchestrating portfolio turnarounds, exceeding business generation quotas, and inspiring high-velocity inside sales teams to drive consultative customer value.
* Robust working knowledge of core Google Ads solutions including Search, Performance Max (PMax), and Demand Gen, with a proven ability to map customer-centric business objectives to the optimal product adoption and maturity journey.
* Ability to synthesize complex, high-volume performance data into actionable sales playbooks and executive growth roadmaps.
* Strong command of structured sales methodologies, complex pipeline mechanics, lead-to-opportunity conversions, and objection handling.

**About The Job**
As a Vendor Performance Manager (VPM), you are a sales operations leader operating at the frontline of Google’s scaled growth engine. You will own and steer multi-quarter business delivery across high-velocity sales programs by partnering with vendor sales leadership, guiding consultative sellers, and driving full-funnel sales excellence.
  
  
In this role, you will transition seamlessly between macro-level sales strategy and tactical pipeline acceleration. You will act as an autonomous business owner—analyzing high-volume pipeline dynamics, shaping commercial sales motions, unlocking market opportunities, and driving product adoption across Google Ads, YouTube, and automated solutions. Your leadership ensures our extended sales teams deliver high-touch consultative value, customer return on investment, and consistent, scalable business growth.
  
  
This role is aligned to the AMER market and will require working non standard hours.
  
  
The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver against ambitious quarterly business and product adoption goals. Own the end-to-end commercial performance of a multi-million-dollar portfolio by diagnosing growth drivers, mitigating churn risks, and designing scalable sales strategies.
* Drive rigorous sales pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy. Analyze conversion funnels across customer lifecycle stages to identify bottlenecks, optimize pitch cadence, and maximize business generation per lead.
* Elevate vendor sales leadership and frontline sellers from transactional pitching to high-impact consultative selling. Coach on advanced sales techniques, objection handling, pitch structure, and the Google Ads product suite (e.g., Performance Max, YouTube, Smart Bidding) to maximize customer ROI.
* Lead high-stakes weekly/monthly business reviews with senior vendor sales executives. Effectively coach partners to consistently hit quota.
* Translate quantitative data signals, campaign performance data, and market trends into actionable growth pipelines and scalable go-to-market plays across the region.

* Plan and run integrated campaigns across LinkedIn, email, website, search, webinars, events and PR, so themessage is consistent and each channel reinforces the others.

including budgets, audience targeting, bidding and A/B testing of creative and copy.
  
  

* Own funnel metrics such as CTR, conversion rate, cost per lead and cost per qualified meeting, and reallocate spend toward what performs.

Product Marketing

such as CPOs, CFOs, procurement leaders and PE operating partners.

* Slow weeks → sharp weeks: Sales cycles run long. We use the runway for BD, RFPs, marketing and product, so this role is never idle.
* Build, don’t springboard: We want people looking for a real tenure to build into, not a brand to stack on a résumé before the next move.
