Google Media Lab lead, identifying opportunities and resolving adoption barriers.
  
  

* Partner with Google PMMs and Brand Social stakeholders to extend appropriate WPP AI

solutions across media, creative and non-media Product Area workstreams.
  
  

* Provide senior stakeholders, including local marketing leadership, with clear points of

view and strategic direction on market-level AI initiatives.
  
  

* Act as the AI bridge between MFG, other WPP agencies and relevant external agency

partners to align delivery against shared media AI OKRs.
  
  
Enablement, Campaign Deployment & Adoption
  
  

* Design and deliver localized, hands-on training, workshops and onboarding for

cross-functional teams, supported by market-relevant playbooks and prompt libraries.
  
  

* Advise Tier 1 campaign teams on selecting and deploying verified AI agents and

workflows across the campaign lifecycle.
  
  

* Embed approved solutions into BAU processes, building team confidence and capability

rather than relying on one-off demonstrations.
  
  

* Track active usage, training coverage, workflow migration and WPP Open monthly

active users; use the findings to target further enablement.
  
  
Local Innovation, Governance & Measurement
  
  

* Identify India-specific workflow gaps and architect, localize, pilot and maintain

appropriate AI tools or custom agents using relevant local context and data inputs.
  
  

* Evaluate the quality and consistency of AI outputs and convene media, data, creative

and technology SMEs to improve solutions.
  
  

* Capture successful Speedboat MVPs and market innovations, document learnings and

work with the regional team to graduate scalable solutions into the central repository.
  
  

* Apply regional measurement frameworks to quantify time savings, output quality,

campaign value and business ROI; report progress and recommendations to market and
  
  
regional leadership.
  
  
**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**
**In 3 Months, You Will Have:**

* Established strong relationships with India MFG practice leads, Google Media Lab, PMM

and Brand Social stakeholders, local SMEs and the APAC AI Strategy team.
  
  

* Assessed current AI maturity, Tier 1 campaign opportunities and priority workflow gaps,

producing a focused India adoption roadmap.
  
  

* Established baseline usage, training, compliance and impact reporting.

**In 6 Months, You Will Have:**

* Delivered localized cross-functional enablement and embedded verified AI workflows

into priority live campaigns.
  
  

* Launched at least one India-specific localization or pilot with clear evaluation criteria and

governance controls.
  
  

* Created a dependable feedback loop between India practitioners and the regional

product and transformation teams.
  
  
**In 12 Months, You Will Have:**

* Demonstrated measurable growth in active AI usage, local training coverage and priority

workflows migrated to WPP Open.
  
  

* Produced evidence of campaign-level productivity, quality or business impact from

scaled AI adoption.
  
  

* Graduated successful India-led innovations for wider APAC consideration and

established a sustainable local AI champion network.
  
  
****WHAT YOU WILL NEED****
**Core Experience & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in media, advertising, digital strategy, transformation, marketing

technology or a related field, with substantial senior leadership experience in India.
  
  

* Proven success leading large-scale change, capability building or technology adoption

across cross-functional teams.
  
  

* Deep understanding of India's media and marketing landscape and of end-to-end

campaign strategy, planning and activation.
  
  

* Experience managing senior client stakeholders and influencing teams without direct

authority; Google business experience is a strong advantage.
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills & Knowledge
  
  

* Strong practical fluency in generative AI, AI agents and their application to media,

creative and operational workflows.
  
  

* Hands-on familiarity with WPP Open, Gemini or comparable AI, media and data

platforms.
  
  

* Working knowledge of prompt and context engineering, agent testing and evaluation,

data governance and responsible AI practices.
  
  

* Ability to frame use cases, mobilize technical SMEs and translate adoption and impact

data into executive decisions.
  
  
Leadership & Personal Attributes
  
  

* Market Leadership: Builds credibility quickly and can set a clear transformation agenda

for senior client and agency stakeholders.
  
  

* Enablement: Makes technical concepts accessible and builds lasting practitioner

capability through practical learning.
  
  

* Collaboration: Brings together media, creative, data and technology specialists to solve

operational problems.
  
  

* Commercial & Strategic Judgment: Prioritizes scalable use cases with clear campaign

or business value.
  
  

* Execution & Adaptability: Takes ownership from opportunity identification through

deployment, measurement and iteration in a fast-changing environment

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. title: Events Director
description:
**Organization- India Consultancy Private Limited**
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
The Events Director will lead the regional Events strategy, revenue growth and hotel enablement agenda across India & SWA. The role will act as a strategic regional business partner, providing direction, tactical recommendations and performance insights to improve the financial, commercial and operational performance of Events across all brands.
  
  
The position will translate regional commercial priorities into practical actions for hotel Directors of Events and event teams. It will also serve as the liaison between the region and Global Events, ensuring that global initiatives are effectively localized, regionalized and activated in line with market dynamics, customer preferences and hotel operating realities.
  
  
The role will work closely with F&B, Commercial Performance, Sales, Revenue, Distribution, Analytics, Marketing, Brand and hotel leadership to identify innovative and commercially sound opportunities that improve Events revenue, conversion, profitability, guest satisfaction and customer engagement.
  
  
**Regional Events Strategy and Strategic Leadership**

* Develop and implement the regional Events strategy across India and Southwest Asia.
* Translate regional commercial priorities into practical actions for hotel Directors of Events and event teams.
* Support the growth of Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Events, social events, banquets and F&B-led occasions.
* Assess market demand, customer trends, competitor activity and emerging event opportunities.
* Provide strategic recommendations that strengthen Hyatt’s competitive position and Events contribution.

**Events Revenue, Profitability and Financial Performance**

* Identify opportunities to improve Events revenue, conversion, profitability, yield and space utilization.
* Review pipeline value, lead quality, conversion ratios, lost business, sales cycle, demand periods and booking pace.
* Partner with Sales and Revenue on pricing, packages, availability, displacement analysis and demand generation.
* Review food cost, labour, setup, service and operational complexity as drivers of event profitability.
* Provide input into budgets, forecasts, financial plans and business cases for Events initiatives.

**Events Performance Enablement and Hotel Improvement**

* Analyse Events performance across the region and identify performance gaps and opportunities.
* Support hotels in developing structured improvement plans.
* Establish metrics, dashboards, scorecards and review routines covering revenue, conversion, profitability and customer satisfaction.
* Provide guidance and best practices to improve conversion, profitability, consistency and guest experience.
* Track action owners, timelines, benefits, risks and closure status.

**Event Operating Standards and Operational Excellence**

* Support hotels in developing effective event-sales and event-operations plans.
* Promote consistent event planning, conversion, execution, service delivery and post-event review practices.
* Develop and maintain event playbooks, checklists, toolkits and operating standards.
* Review the complete customer journey from enquiry and proposal through event delivery and follow-up.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, communication and service recovery.
* Monitor event standards and support hotels in resolving operational barriers.

****Commercial Services, Leadership and Key Events****

* Support internal Commercial Services meetings, divisional events and regional leadership forums.
* Coordinate owner events, customer events, showcase events and strategic activations.
* Support major regional launches, customer-engagement programmes and commercial events.
* Ensure strategic events are well planned, commercially relevant, operationally successful and brand aligned.
* Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future planning and execution.

**Talent Management:**
Oversee the recruitment, training, and development of culinary team across the region. This includes working with individual property to identify talent gaps and opportunities for training and development.
  
  
**Brand Standards:**
Ensure that all event spaces in the region meet the brand's quality and service standards. This includes conducting regular audits and inspections, and working with respective hotels to address any issues.
  
  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement:**
Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement across Events operations in the region. This includes staying up-to-date with industry trends and best practices, and working with the food & beverage, culinary and commercial services team to implement new ideas and initiatives.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* Minimum 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel Events, meetings, banqueting, commercial, sales or F&B operations; 10+ years preferred.
* Experience in regional, multi-property or multi-market Events leadership.
* Demonstrated success in improving Events revenue, profitability, conversion and customer satisfaction.
* Strong knowledge of MICE, banqueting, weddings, social events and event-related F&B operations.
* Experience with event pipelines, pricing, packages, availability, space utilization, conversion and profitability.
* Experience developing operating standards, playbooks, toolkits and hotel improvement plans.
* Experience localizing or activating global programmes across multiple markets.
* Strong communication, analytical, project-management and stakeholder-management skills.
* Creative, innovative, organized and results-oriented.

**Education and Expertise (i.e. certificates, licenses, etc.)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Events, Sales, Marketing or a related field.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Event-management, project-management, hotel-management or commercial certifications advantageous.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, reporting tools, collaboration platforms and business-intelligence systems.

title: Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development
description:
Can you lead commercial strategy for complex field developments — and maximize asset value?
  
  
Are you able to drive integration across technical and commercial teams to deliver full‑cycle project success?
  
  
**Be part of a successful team!**
Baker Hughes Integrated Services exist to
**plan, manage, and execute multi‑disciplinary well and field development projects**
through a single accountable team. Their mandate is to deliver predictable outcomes, optimize asset value, and reduce operational risk for operators.
  
  
**Fuel your passion**
The
**Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development**
is responsible for leading complex commercial and proposal activities for integrated upstream field development opportunities. The role develops commercial frameworks, supports customer negotiations, and ensures proposals and agreements deliver shareholder value while addressing technical, operational, financial, and contractual risks.
  
  
This position requires strong E&P business development experience, knowledge of upstream field development practices, and the ability to translate end-to-end technical development plans into fit-for-purpose commercial structures.
  
  
**As an Integrated Commercial Director - Field Development, you will be responsible for:**

* Develop proposals; may negotiate with customers; ensure deals deliver shareholder value; drive competitive pricing. May include compiling and submitting required tender documentation.
* Handle complex products, services, and systems requiring technical knowledge and understanding of the environment where the products or systems will be used. Products and systems are client-specific and require technical analysis and system design to fit client conditions.
* Lead the commercial structuring of integrated field development opportunities, including pricing, scope definition, contracting strategy, risk allocation, and customer value proposition.
* Apply knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines to support technically informed commercial solutions.
* Understand the technical context of end-to-end field development plans and develop accompanying commercial frameworks that support customer and business objectives.
* Manage complex long-term sales processes. Contracts involve pricing and conditions of sales, rental, operation, maintenance, services, integrated solutions, and other field development-related commercial arrangements.
* Support drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements related to E&P business development, including asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, commercial partnerships, and associated liabilities.
* Handle important business unit clients and senior customer interfaces.
* Coordinate sales teams involving engineering, legal, risk, finance, operations, product lines, and leadership.
* Participate in major sales and business development activities involving large, complex, or strategically important opportunities.
* Handle big or highly complex markets with large potential for growth.
* Ensure proposals and negotiated agreements comply with internal governance, risk management, approval processes, and shareholder value expectations.

**To be successful in this role you will:**

* Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
* Have 10+ years of experience working as a commercial advisor in an E&P business development function.
* Have 10+ years of experience drafting commercial agreements and negotiating terms related to asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, and associated liabilities.
* Have strong knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines.
* Have the ability to understand the technical context of an end-to-end field development plan and structure an accompanying commercial framework.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, contractual risk, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve complex problems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs, projects, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation skills with experience managing complex customer discussions and commercial agreements.

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
  
  
  

* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Director - Proposals
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
  
  
Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Channel Manager, D2C
description:
Job description:

At Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN), our mission is to inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! We are a global leader in the performance nutrition industry and have a portfolio of ten brands, including Optimum Nutrition (ON), BSN, ISOPURE.

Our brands, include the top three performance nutrition brands, are sold in more than 100 markets worldwide. With growing global interest in healthy, active lifestyles, our products appeal to a variety of consumers with a wide range of fitness motivations. They demand new product formats and have a growing appetite for healthy snacking and plant-based protein. Increasingly, they shop online for their health and fitness needs. We're an agile business led by brands and inspired by consumers. We have ambitious plans, and as a values-led organization, we're focused on driving sustainable business performance the right way.

Headquartered in Dublin, with a workforce based across multiple locations, including London, Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Dubai, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Melbourne, Illinois, and California. GPN employs more than 2,000 people globally. For this role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Gurgaon, India.

We are seeking a seasoned D2C leader with deep expertise in growth, P&L ownership, and channel management, and the ability to operate in a fast paced and constantly evolving environment. The person will be responsible for the end-to-end P&L, growth, and management of our brands (Optimum Nutrition, BSN, Isopure) on D2C website.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the end-to-end D2C P&L, driving topline and bottom-line targets through sell-through planning, inventory health tracking, and pricing/promotions strategy.
* Lead annual budgeting, planning cycles, and the D2C event calendar - festive periods, platform sale days and align website creative to each cycle.
* Co-own the performance marketing investment across Google and Facebook with marketing to deliver revenue targets
* Co-Own the SEO/GEO charter with marketing for the D2C website, driving organic and AI-led traffic growth.
* Build the retention/growth engine that drives repeat purchase, leveraging 1P data-led re-engagement across email, WhatsApp, and AI-calling.
* Own the platform roadmap (Shopify) and manage key 3rd-party integrations - payment gateway, checkout, martech tools, logistics aggregators, loyalty and OMS
* Co-Own logistics performance with distributor and SCM - TAT adherence, RTO%, and COD/prepaid mix - to optimize delivery cost and customer experience.
* Co-Own CRM performance, monitoring CSAT, FCR, FRT, and SLA adherence to ensure a consistently strong customer experience.
* Lead and mentor D2C growth manager, Product manager and Merchandiser & manage relationships with external agencies and partners across marketing, technology, distributor and logistics.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

**Analytical**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable growth strategies across the full funnel.
* Comfort owning and interpreting P&L, performance marketing, and retention metrics to drive business decisions.

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of Shopify and the broader Martech, payments, and logistics ecosystem.
* In-depth understanding of performance marketing concepts, including ROAS, CAC, and conversion optimization.
* Strong understanding of SEO/GEO best practices and tools.
* Proficient in Microsoft applications - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Proven ability to lead and mentor a team while managing cross-functional and external stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly articulate ideas and drive alignment across marketing, product, tech, and operations.
* Ability to quickly adapt, focus, and deliver results in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

**Education/Experience:**

* MBA from Tier I or Tier II Business schools.
* 10+ years of experience in D2C/e-commerce, with a proven track record of owning P&L and driving channel growth.
* Experience managing teams and external stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

title: Category Manager – Brand & Distribution
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
  
  
This isn't a coordination role -you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
  
  
If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
  
  
**About The Role**

* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority

**About You**

* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

B.Tech / Engineering or a related technical field

**About Us**

Dr. Morepen Home delivers doctor visits, nursing care, vaccinations, IV therapy, diagnostics and ongoing care at home. We also operate institutional health centres.

We are launching a new healthcare category in the coming weeks and need one owner to take it from zero to scale

**The Role**

You will be the business owner of a healthcare category. You own the strategy, launch, growth and P&L, and you answer for the outcomes. This is a builder's role, not a supply, procurement or vendor management role.

**What You Will Own**

* **Category strategy:**
  Define the category vision, target customer, market opportunity and go-to-market plan.
* **Launch and scale:**
  Take the category from launch to scale with a clear roadmap, milestones and rapid iteration on what the market tells you.
* **Revenue and profitability:**
  Own category revenue, contribution margin, pricing and unit economics.
* **Service design:**
  Shape the offering, packages and patient experience, working with clinical, product and tech teams.
* **Customer experience:**
  Own quality, NPS, retention and repeat usage, and fix root causes fast.
* **Process and operating model:**
  Set up the SOPs, metrics and review rhythm the category needs, then drive improvements with central teams.
* **Data-led decisions:**
  Use data and on-ground insight to find problems, run experiments and report progress to leadership.

**Who You Are**

* 1 -3 years in category management, business operations, growth or a similar role.
* A technical or engineering degree.
* A proven builder who has personally launched a category, product or business line and taken it from zero to scale, setting up the processes yourself.
* Able to show numbers for what you have owned: monthly revenue, order volume, contribution margin, repeat rate and the time it took to reach scale.
* Strong analytical and commercial thinking, comfortable with P&L and unit economics.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, speed and accountability for results.
* Hands-on: you go to the ground, understand the real problem and get it solved.
* Healthcare or on-demand services experience is a plus.

**How You Will Be Measured**

* Monthly revenue and order growth
* Contribution margin %
* Customer experience: NPS and repeat rate
* Speed of launch and iteration (time to first order, time to break-even)

**Why Join**

* Build and scale a new healthcare category from scratch.
* Full ownership, with direct access to founders and leadership.
* A fast-moving startup where initiative is rewarded.
* The chance to improve patient care through technology.

**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**

Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.
  
  
India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.
  
  
This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.
  
  
You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**
**What You’ll Do**
Own the India marketing strategy
  
  

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

Build and execute account-based marketing
  
  

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

Create demand that converts
  
  

* Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.
* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.
* Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

Build the India events engine

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:

Founded in 2020, Artemedy Business Innovations LLP is a boutique design and marketing studio primarily specialising in influencer and celebrity marketing. We provide end-to-end campaign management and strategic support to brands across all their influencer marketing requirements.

As a growing startup studio, our strength lies in offering highly personalised solutions rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. **Role Overview**

We are looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to lead influencer campaigns and manage client relationships end to end. The role involves campaign planning and execution, creator coordination, content and script alignment, and guiding associates and interns. The ideal candidate combines strong execution, an understanding of creators and content, confident client communication, and the ability to identify and resolve issues proactively.

**Essential Requirements**

-Graduate from a recognized institution (BJMC/ Marketing background is a plus).

-Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, prioritisation, and client-management skills.

-Comfort with campaign trackers, reporting, commercials, agreements, and deadline-driven coordination.

-Willingness and ability to work onsite in South Delhi. This is a non-negotiable requirement.

title: SVP, Head of Marketing Performance
description:
**About the Company**

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production,transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and transformative SVP, Product to lead the critical capability area of Marketing Performance within the WPP Open platform. This is a truly unique opportunity to define the future of how WPP measures and attributes marketing effectiveness across our vast and diverse agency and client ecosystem.

SVP Product leadership role for the Marketing Performance capability
**-**
the remit is to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for measurement, attribution, reporting, and advanced analytics.

The role must combine two capabilities:

* **Measurement depth:**
  Hands-on understanding of Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), including Bayesian approaches; Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA); incrementality; geo-experimentation; media optimization; marketing data; and reporting.
* **Product leadership:**
  Turning those methods into unified, scalable, AI-enabled products—covering discovery, prioritization, development, launch, adoption, commercial performance, and iteration.

**Responsibilities**

**Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:**

* Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs.
* Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage.
* Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement.
* Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability.

**Product Leadership & Team Transformation:**

* Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers,Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance.
* Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work.

**Commercial Acumen & Growth:**

* Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework.
* In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth.
* Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals,continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities.
* Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively.

**Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:**

* Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery.
* Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations.
* Cultivate and manage high-impact relationships with key internal and external partners, driving collaborative initiatives and maximizing mutual value.

**Product Development & Execution:**

* Oversee the entire product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and post-launch iteration, emphasizing agile and iterative development.
* Prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic impact, client value, technical feasibility, and business objectives, with a relentless focus on driving meaningful adoption and impact.
* Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable products and features that meet defined requirements, performance standards, and the architectural principles of WPP Open.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback.

**Domain Expertise & Innovation:**

* Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM,including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation)
* Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation.
* Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization.

**Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g.SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams.
* Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain.
* Proven track record of successfully bringing complex, data-driven, and AI-enabled products from concept to market, driving significant competitive advantage and exponential growth.
* Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization.

* Experience managing significant operating and capital expenditure budgets and defining commercial models for product portfolios.
* Proven experience in managing global product rollouts and supporting a large, diverse client base (e.g., 1000+clients across multiple markets

Lead the strategic planning efforts for their portfolio to develop a fully detailed portfolio strategy to include stated objectives and action plans, inclusive of the market mapping, identifying potential gaps and exploiting new opportunities to maximise market share

title: Integrated Marketing Coordinator
description:
**Description**
This role keeps Integrated Marketing's engine running so the rest of the team can spend their time on strategy, not upkeep. Based in India, it picks up the recurring, well-defined execution work, building and maintaining campaign-impact dashboards, analyzing data to signal opportunity and insight, keeping the integrated marketing calendar current, and streamlining the content approval process. This isn't a role that manages people or sets direction, it helps make the team more effective.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Content Enablement Pipeline (35%) - Manage and optimize the content curation workflow so it stays aligned with merchandising strategy and priorities, addressing existing lead-time bottlenecks in the review/approval process. Surface timely, high-quality content and trend opportunities to support curation and merchandising decisions.
* Dashboards & Cross-Functional Analysis (25%) - Maintain dashboards tracking cross-functional impact of integrated campaigns and content performance; surface insights and next-step recommendations for scaling what’s working. Support KPI reporting and analysis of engagement, conversion, and content trends.
* Integrated Marketing Calendar Ownership (20%) - Own and maintain the integrated marketing calendar; proactively communicate updates to cross-functional partners, incorporating relevant seasonal, cultural, and content opportunities.
* Team Capacity Support (15%) - Take on recurring, well-scoped tasks (data pulls, report formatting, documentation, calendar upkeep) independently, without requiring live oversight, to increase overall team bandwidth for strategic work.
* Content Discoverability Support (5%) - Support efforts to improve content discoverability through keyword, tag, and listing-metadata optimization, using performance and search insights to identify opportunities to improve relevance.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years in marketing coordination, marketing analytics, or marketing operations
* Proficiency with dashboarding/reporting tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Sigma, or similar) and analysis
* Experience with project/calendar management tools (Asana or similar)
* Strong spreadsheet skills in Google Sheets or Excel, including data manipulation, reporting, and presentation-ready formatting.
* Strong async, written-first communication skills, this role runs with minimal live oversight given the time zone gap
* Comfortable self-directing recurring workflows without close supervision

**Key Attributes For Success**

* High autonomy and reliability- this role is designed to run with minimal oversight
* Detail-oriented and process-minded; catches inefficiencies before they need escalation
* Comfortable as a force-multiplier/support role rather than owning strategic direction
* Clear, proactive communicator who keeps async collaborators aligned across time zones
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, digital content, merchandising, creator platforms, or pop-culture is a plus

title: I&P GN - Song – Marketing- Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
description:
**I&P - MT - Marketing Process Excellence - Consultant**
**Management Level**
9 / Consultant
  
  
**Must Have Skills**
Marketing Process Redesign, Marketing Operating Model Transformation, AI & Automation Integration, Client Consulting
  
  
**Good To Have Skills**
Agent Experience (AX) Design, Process Mapping/Mining, MarTech and AdTech Ecosystems, Data Visualization (Tableau/Power BI)
  
  
**Job Summary**
Practice: I&P | Global Network - SONG | Areas of Work: Marketing Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation, Future-State Marketing Process Design, Marketing Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
  
  
As a Consultant, you will help clients reimagine how marketing work gets done across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, content, media, CRM, social, search, and measurement through process redesign, digital innovation, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered ways of working. Operating at the intersection of customer experience, marketing, analytics, technology, and operations, you will lead workstreams, conduct capability and process assessments, define future-state processes and operating models, shape transformation roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes that improve growth, customer value, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
**You Are**
You are a hands-on marketing transformation leader who can take ownership of a client workstream from diagnostic through future-state design. You combine practical knowledge of how modern marketing functions operate with structured process excellence methods, and you can translate business priorities into clear process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, and adoption requirements.
  
  
You design at the intersection of marketer, AI agent, platform, and process. You apply Agent Experience (AX) Design principles to determine where AI agents can support or automate work, where human judgment is essential, and how roles, controls, escalation, and handoffs should be designed to improve speed, quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
Use AI tools across research, analysis, design, and deliverable creation, and identify opportunities to embed AI and agentic solutions into redesigned marketing processes. As a Consultant, you will be expected to independently lead workstreams, facilitate client discussions, and convert analysis into implementation-ready recommendations. Your responsibilities include:
  
  
**Marketing Transformation & Benchmarking**

* Assess marketing trends, customer and channel shifts, and peer practices to identify process reinvention opportunities across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, campaign planning, content operations, media, CRM/lifecycle marketing, social and influencer marketing, search, marketing operations, and measurement.
* Lead capability and process diagnostics and benchmarking to identify performance gaps, pain points, control issues, duplication, and opportunities to improve productivity, speed-to-market, customer experience, marketing effectiveness, and cost efficiency.
* Build data-driven assessments and executive-ready insights using AI-assisted analysis and visualization tools, translating findings into clear transformation priorities.

**Future-State Marketing Process Design**

* Lead future-state marketing process and operating model design covering AI integration points, workflow automation, decision rights, governance, human-machine interaction, platform enablement, measurement, and workforce adoption.
* Lead client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; facilitate co-creation across marketing, content, media, CRM, analytics, technology, and operations teams; and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
* Connect future-state marketing processes to MarTech/AdTech platforms and delivery realities so that transformation designs are practical, scalable, measurable, and ready for implementation.

**Operating Model, Change & Adoption**

* Develop change-impact assessments covering roles, skills, governance, ways of working, service delivery, and adoption implications created by redesigned marketing processes.
* Build and maintain marketing process playbooks, redesign methods, benchmarks, and reusable assets; contribute to proposals and thought leadership; and coach junior practitioners on marketing process excellence and operating model design.

**AI & AX Design Application**

* Embed Agent Experience (AX) Design principles into marketing process specifications by defining AI agent roles, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, controls, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoffs within redesigned workflows.
* Identify practical agentic use cases across marketing planning, insight generation, content and campaign operations, optimization, measurement, and reporting, with appropriate controls and governance.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* 2-8 years of experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting, with increasing independence across engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead client workstreams, conduct capability and current-state process assessments, facilitate workshops, and present future-state recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of marketing operating models and processes across two or more areas such as campaign management, content operations, media, CRM, social and influencer marketing, search, MarTech, or measurement.
* Working knowledge of how AI, automation, and agentic solutions can be integrated into marketing processes, including operating model and governance implications.
* Experience with process mapping, benchmarking, change-impact analysis, and business case development; ability to translate data into structured, business-ready recommendations.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, and client relationship skills, with the ability to explain complex process, AI, data, and technology choices in business terms.
* Ability to connect customer and growth outcomes with marketing process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, measurement, and adoption requirements.
* Experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments and managing multiple workstreams with client-facing accountability.
* Experience contributing to business development, proposal/RFP development, reusable assets, or thought leadership, and coaching junior practitioners, is preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Experience in consumer-led B2C industries is strongly preferred, including Consumer Goods & Services, Retail, Life Sciences, Automotive, Travel, Communications & Media, or similar sectors with scaled marketing operations.
* Familiarity with process mapping or process mining tools such as Visio, Signavio, ARIS, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
* Exposure to MarTech/AdTech ecosystems such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce, Sprinklr, Google Marketing Platform, or comparable enterprise platforms is desirable.
* Applied knowledge of Agent Experience (AX) Design principles - including agent autonomy, handoffs, escalation, controls, and human oversight - is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to connect process improvements to measurable marketing outcomes such as productivity, speed-to-market, engagement, conversion, ROI, or customer experience.
* Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI, agentic marketing, automation, marketing operating models, and emerging digital marketing practices.

**About Accenture**
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world's largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 774,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives.

title: Sales And Marketing Associate
description:
**Company Description**
Forever Unicare Required
  
marketing and sales state wise
  
  
State-wise marketing and sales job descriptions often focus on regional business growth, local networking, and meeting state-specific targets. Common roles include Regional Sales Managers, State Heads, and Field Marketing Representatives, with high activity in major states like Gujrat, Orissa,West Bengal and Delhi.
  
  
  
Here is a breakdown of common state-wise marketing and sales job descriptions:
  
1. State Head / Regional Sales Manager (Mid-to-Senior)
  
Location Focus: Often Ahemdabad (Gujarat), Bhuneshwar (orissa), Kolkata (W.B) and Delhi, or industrial hubs in specific states.
  
Core Responsibilities:
  
Develop state-level sales strategies, quotas, and budgets.
  
Monitor regional sales results and report to national management.
  
Analyze local market trends and competitor activities.
  
Identify new business opportunities within the assigned state.
  
Liase with local or regional government departments when required.
  
  
2. Field Marketing & Sales Executive (Field-Based)
  
Location Focus: Various districts within a state.
  
Core Responsibilities:
  
Conduct in-person client visits, negotiations, and dealer/distributor management.
  
Gather customer intelligence and feedback for regional reporting.
  
Organize regional promotions and field events.
  
Manage local customer relationship management (CRM) updates.
  
  
3. Retail Sales/Account Executive (State/Branch Level)
  
Location Focus: Retail chains or specific branch locations (e.g., Noida, Ahemdabad).
  
Core Responsibilities:
  
Manage in-store sales operations.
  
Achieve daily/monthly sales targets set by the state head.
  
Ensure product availability and visibility in local stores.
  
  
Key Skills Required (State-Wise Focus)
  
Local Market Knowledge: Understanding the consumer habits in that specific state.
  
Regional Language Proficiency: Crucial for negotiation and field operations in many Indian states.
  
Strategic Planning: Ability to create a sales plan for the entire territory.
  
Relationship Management: Building local networks and dealer relationships.
  
  
Common Job Roles by Location State Head, Regional Sales Manager, Corporate Sales Executive.
  
Bhuneshwar (Orissa): Regional Sales Manager, Area Sales Manager, Retail Head.
  
Delhi/NCR: Commercial Strategy roles, Sales Executive, Business Development Executive.
  
  
These positions are responsible for building brand awareness in specific regions, promoting products, and ensuring the achievement of localized sales targets
  
  
**Role Description**
The Sales and Marketing Associate role is a full-time, hybrid position based in the Greater Delhi Area, with flexibility for some work from home. In this role, the associate will identify and pursue new sales opportunities, build and maintain relationships with NGOs, clinics, and individual customers, and present product packages to meet client needs. Daily responsibilities include conducting market research, supporting marketing campaigns, following up on leads, and preparing basic sales reports. The associate will provide customer service support, address inquiries, and assist in product training sessions or demonstrations for clients and partners. Collaboration with internal teams to align sales activities with marketing strategies and organizational goals is an integral part of the role.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with diverse clients and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales and Sales & Marketing skills to drive revenue growth and support promotional activities.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to conduct product orientations, demonstrations, and basic educational sessions for customers and partners.
* Relevant experience in healthcare, wellness, or social impact sectors is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work in a hybrid environment in the Greater Delhi Area, manage time independently, and meet sales targets.
* Proficiency with basic productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, CRM or lead-tracking systems) is advantageous.

title: Account Manager (Performance Marketing)
description:
We're hiring an Account Manager (Performance Marketing) at Neuroid :)

Type - Hybrid // 4 days WFO // Ghitorni, New Delhi

Must have performance marketing & D2C growth understanding.

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

We’re hiring an Account Manager to own the relationship side of 8 to 10 D2C accounts. You sit between the founder, the media buyers and the client. The buyers run the ads; you run the account - the numbers, the conversation, the next step, and the renewal.

This is not a client-servicing role where you forward emails. You need to read a Meta or Google dashboard yourself, know why ROAS moved, and have the next move ready before the client asks. Ex-media buyers who want to move to the client side are the exact profile.

**What you’ll own**

* Weekly performance reviews with each client: what we spent, what it returned, what changes next week, sent before they ask
* The relationship: you are the first call for every account you hold, and the founder is the escalation, not the default
* Scope and renewals: tracking what was promised, flagging scope creep, running the renewal conversation 30 days before expiry
* Churn prevention: spotting an unhappy account early and fixing it with the buyer, not after the client has already decided
* Creative and content coordination: making sure what the buyer needs from the content team is briefed, dated and delivered
* Upsell: knowing when a client is ready for Google, retention, or a creative mandate, and making the case

**Who this is for**

* 2 to 4 years in performance marketing for D2C or ecommerce - ideally as a media buyer who now wants to own accounts, or an AM at a performance agency who actually understands the ads
* You can open Ads Manager and explain an account’s last 30 days without a buyer in the room
* You know what a healthy D2C P&L looks like: ROAS, CAC, AOV, contribution margin, and why a brand at 2X might be fine and a brand at 4X might not be
* You write clearly, run a meeting without a deck, and are comfortable telling a client something they don’t want to hear
* You’ve managed at least 5 accounts at once and nobody slipped
* In-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), five days a week

**What you get**

* 8 to 10 named accounts from day one, with real authority over how they’re run
* Direct access to the founder, the Head of Ops and the buyers; no layers
* A path to Head of Accounts as the book grows

How to apply

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject “Account Manager”. Tell us in five lines about one account you saved or grew, with numbers. No cover letters.

title: Founder
description:

title: Head of Retail
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are a diversified capital markets and financial services organisation with established capabilities across stock broking, Portfolio Management Services (PMS), algorithmic trading, colocation and high-frequency trading (HFT) platforms.

As part of our growth strategy, we are seeking an experienced Retail Head / President to lead the transformation and scaling of our retail broking and wealth business into a technology-driven, digital-first platform. The role carries end-to-end responsibility for business growth, product strategy, customer experience, technology alignment, and profitability.

The successful candidate will build a differentiated retail investing ecosystem spanning trading, investing, and wealth solutions while driving sustainable business growth and customer engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Business Strategy & P&L Ownership**

* Own the overall strategy, growth, operating performance and profitability of the digital retail broking business.
* Develop a clear roadmap for transitioning from a traditional full-service brokerage model to a scalable, digital-first operating model.
* Drive customer acquisition, active client growth, trading and investing engagement, customer retention and lifetime value.
* Build sustainable and diversified revenue streams across broking, investment products, margin funding where appropriate, subscriptions and other permissible offerings.
* Establish business metrics, budgets, unit economics and operating dashboards, with accountability for revenue, costs, contribution margins and profitability.
* Identify opportunities to leverage the organisation’s existing market infrastructure and capital markets expertise to create a differentiated retail proposition.

**2. Product Vision & Digital Platform Development**

* Define and execute the product vision for a comprehensive retail trading and investing ecosystem across mobile, web and API-led channels.
* Build a differentiated, intuitive and reliable customer experience covering onboarding, KYC, account funding, trading, investing, portfolio tracking and customer servicing.
* Develop a customer-centric product roadmap using market research, customer insights, behavioural analytics and competitive intelligence.
* Oversee the development of advanced trading tools, charting, options analytics, screeners, alerts, watchlists, APIs, strategy tools and intelligent trading workflows.
* Introduce relevant AI-enabled capabilities for research discovery, portfolio insights, customer support, personalisation and operational efficiency, subject to appropriate controls.
* Build a product-led culture that prioritises customer value, usability, reliability, speed and continuous improvement.

**3. Technology & Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the retail technology organisation, including software engineering, mobile and web development, architecture, DevOps, quality engineering, data, cybersecurity and platform reliability.
* Establish a scalable, resilient and secure technology architecture capable of supporting increasing customer volumes and market activity.
* Drive engineering excellence, release velocity, automation, system observability, disaster recovery and business continuity.
* Build high-performing product and engineering teams with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and strong cross-functional collaboration.
* Make strategic decisions on build versus buy, technology partnerships, cloud and infrastructure architecture, and platform modernisation.
* Ensure close alignment between product, engineering, dealing, risk, operations, compliance and customer support.

**4. Customer Acquisition, Experience & Growth**

* Develop a scalable digital distribution strategy encompassing organic acquisition, referrals, partnerships, performance marketing and other appropriate channels.
* Improve conversion across the customer journey, from prospect acquisition and account opening to first transaction, activation and long-term retention.
* Use customer data and analytics to understand cohorts, engagement, churn, customer profitability and opportunities for improvement.
* Build a differentiated service model through responsive digital support, efficient issue resolution and transparent customer communication.
* Strengthen brand positioning and customer trust through product quality, transparent pricing, reliability and responsible financial services practices.

**5. Wealth Platform & Investment Products**

* Develop a roadmap to expand the retail business from transactional broking into a broader investing and wealth ecosystem.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities across mutual funds, ETFs, bonds, fixed-income products, investment baskets, goal-based investing and other suitable investment solutions.
* Evaluate the development or distribution of digital advisory, portfolio solutions and wealth offerings, including PMS access where appropriate to the customer segment and regulatory framework.
* Build customer segmentation and engagement strategies for first-time investors, active traders, long-term investors and affluent customers.
* Establish the product, distribution, technology and service capabilities required to build a scalable wealth business.
* Create a cohesive customer experience that connects trading, investing and wealth needs while maintaining appropriate suitability, disclosures and regulatory separation.

**6. Innovation, Data & Competitive Differentiation**

* Continuously benchmark the business against leading digital brokers, fintech platforms and emerging wealth technology companies.
* Identify opportunities in automation, APIs, intelligent workflows, data-led personalisation and next-generation trading experiences.
* Translate market and technology developments into commercially viable products rather than innovation for its own sake.
* Build a strong product experimentation framework using customer feedback, measurable hypotheses and controlled rollouts.
* Leverage the organisation’s expertise in execution, algorithmic trading and market infrastructure wherever it can create a meaningful retail advantage.

**7. Risk, Governance & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure that products, technology and business processes operate within applicable SEBI, exchange, depository and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Embed risk management, cybersecurity, data privacy, access controls, surveillance, auditability and resilience into product design and platform architecture.
* Work closely with compliance, legal, risk and operations teams to enable innovation within a robust governance framework.
* Ensure appropriate controls for APIs, algorithmic trading, customer communications, investment distribution and any advisory-related activities.

**8. Leadership & Organisational Transformation**

* Lead the cultural shift from a traditional service-led brokerage to a customer-centric, product-led and technology-driven organisation.
* Attract, develop and retain high-calibre product, engineering, data, growth and business talent.
* Build a strong second line of leadership across product, technology, growth, operations and wealth.
* Establish clear decision rights, agile execution practices and accountability for business outcomes.
* Work closely with the promoter and senior leadership team to translate strategic ambition into a practical, measurable transformation programme.

**Job Requirements:**

* 15+ years of leadership experience in retail broking, fintech, wealth management, digital financial services, or related businesses.
* Demonstrated success in leading or materially contributing to the transformation or scaling of a digital brokerage, fintech, investing platform or comparable consumer technology business.
* Strong understanding of Indian capital markets, retail broking economics, trading and investing products, and the regulatory environment.
* Proven ownership of a business P&L, with demonstrated accountability for revenue growth, customer acquisition, operating efficiency and profitability.
* Experience leading product management and technology teams, with the ability to engage deeply on architecture, engineering, reliability and platform strategy.
* Track record of launching successful products, improving customer experience and scaling digital distribution.
* Demonstrated ability to build and lead multidisciplinary teams in a fast-moving, competitive environment.
* Exposure to wealth products, investment platforms, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income or digital investment solutions will be a significant advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, execution orientation, analytical capability and entrepreneurial mindset.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Thinks and acts like a business owner.
* Combines strategic vision with hands-on execution.
* Understands both the customer and the technology behind the product.
* Makes data-driven decisions without losing commercial judgement.
* Builds high-performing teams and creates a culture of ownership.
* Balances growth, customer outcomes, risk and sustainable profitability.

**Measures of Success**

The leader will be evaluated on a balanced scorecard covering:

* Growth in funded accounts, active customers and customer assets.
* Customer acquisition efficiency, activation, retention and lifetime value.
* Revenue growth, contribution margin, cost-to-serve and business profitability.
* Product adoption, customer satisfaction and platform reliability.
* Speed of product development and delivery against the roadmap.
* Successful launch and scaling of wealth and investment offerings.
* Regulatory compliance, cybersecurity and operational resilience.

title: International Expansion GTM Lead
description:
**International Expansion GTM Lead**

**Location:**
Noida, India

**Experience:**
4-8 years

**About the Company**

We are building a growth-oriented organization with ambitions to expand beyond India and establish a meaningful presence in international markets. Our immediate priority is to create a repeatable go-to-market engine across the Americas and Europe, connecting market insight, positioning, partnerships, sales execution, and customer learning into one operating system. The company values ownership, commercial judgment, and practical experimentation over rigid playbooks. This role will work closely with leadership to shape where we compete, how we enter new markets, and which investments can produce sustainable growth. As our international expansion develops, the person in this role will help translate company strengths into relevant regional propositions and measurable commercial outcomes. This is an opportunity to influence market strategy early, build operating discipline, and create the foundations for a scalable global business from our Noida base.

**About the Role**

The International Expansion GTM Lead will own the company’s expansion agenda across the Americas and Europe. You will convert strategic ambition into a focused market-entry plan, defining priority segments, regional positioning, acquisition channels, partnership motions, and revenue milestones. The role combines market discovery with hands-on execution: validating demand, building early pipelines, creating repeatable sales systems, and turning customer feedback into sharper propositions. You will establish the operating cadence that helps leadership understand what is working, where investment should increase, and which markets require a different approach. Success means creating qualified international opportunities, improving conversion through disciplined GTM execution, and building a scalable expansion playbook that can be reused across geographies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own international GTM strategy across the Americas and Europe, translating company goals into market priorities, entry plans, revenue milestones, and accountable execution rhythms.
* Lead market discovery through customer interviews, competitor research, partner conversations, and commercial analysis, converting evidence into clear segment and geography decisions.
* Build regional positioning and messaging with cross-functional teams, ensuring the company’s value proposition is relevant, differentiated, and commercially usable in each priority market.
* Establish pipeline generation across outbound, inbound, partnerships, events, and channel programs, measuring channel productivity and reallocating effort toward scalable sources of demand.
* Develop early international opportunities from qualification through close, improving sales discipline, forecasting quality, conversion rates, and learning from wins and losses.
* Create the international expansion operating system, including dashboards, review cadences, experiments, budgets, and decision criteria that connect activity to revenue and market traction.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Demonstrated experience building or scaling GTM motions across international markets, with practical ownership of segmentation, positioning, demand generation, sales execution, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of market-entry strategy, regional buyer behavior, competitive analysis, partnership development, and the operating differences between the Americas, Europe, and India.
* Commercial fluency across pipeline management, funnel metrics, forecasting, conversion analysis, experimentation, and revenue planning, supported by structured decision-making.
* Excellent customer discovery, storytelling, negotiation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to turn market insight into action across diverse stakeholders.
* Hands-on capability with CRM systems, marketing automation, analytics dashboards, spreadsheets, and productivity tools used to manage international GTM performance.
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, prioritize limited resources, and build repeatable processes without waiting for mature infrastructure or large teams.

**Additional Plus**

* Previous experience in HR technology, recruitment technology, or adjacent workforce software is preferred, particularly where the candidate owned market expansion or complex B2B growth.
* Experience launching an AI-enabled product or business in new countries, especially across the Americas or Europe, with evidence of learning quickly from early commercial signals.
* Background in partnerships, channel sales, international business development, or founder-led growth within a fast-moving company or emerging category.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring four to eight years of experience in go-to-market, business development, sales, partnerships, or international expansion, with evidence of owning outcomes rather than only supporting execution.
* You bring a builder’s mindset: you can move from an unclear opportunity to customer discovery, a tested proposition, a working pipeline, and an informed decision about scaling investment.
* You bring strong commercial judgment, balancing speed with rigor and distinguishing genuine market pull from activity that creates noise without durable revenue potential.
* You bring the ability to work across cultures and time zones, communicate clearly with customers and senior leaders, and adapt the GTM approach without losing strategic focus.
* You bring operational discipline, using data and structured reviews to make performance visible, identify constraints, and create accountability across internal and external contributors.
* You bring resilience and curiosity, treating objections, failed experiments, and competitive pressure as inputs for sharper positioning and better market decisions.

**Why Join Us**

This role offers the chance to shape international growth at a formative stage, with direct visibility into the decisions that determine where and how the company expands. You will not inherit a narrow regional execution brief; you will help define the markets, motions, and systems that become the company’s global growth engine. The work combines strategy with action, giving you ownership from market selection through pipeline creation, customer learning, and repeatable commercial execution. You will partner closely with leadership and influence product, marketing, sales, and operational priorities through evidence from the market. The Americas and Europe provide meaningful complexity and upside, while the Noida base offers the opportunity to build global operating capability from India. If you enjoy creating structure where little exists, learning directly from customers, and seeing your decisions translate into market traction, this role provides a broad platform for impact and career growth.

**What We Offer**

* Significant ownership of international expansion, with the mandate to shape market priorities, GTM systems, partnerships, and commercial outcomes across multiple geographies.
* Close collaboration with company leadership and cross-functional teams, creating visibility into strategic decisions and the opportunity to influence the broader business direction.
* A high-autonomy, learning-oriented environment where disciplined experimentation, customer evidence, and measurable results guide investment and recognition.
