**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.
* Track Record: Proven success in building, scaling, and monetizing digital platforms in mobility, travel, or multi-service marketplaces.

**Must-Have Attributes**

* Hands-on experience with buyer-facing apps in mobility, transit, travel, hospitality, or experience marketplaces (e.g., transit/cab apps, OTAs, activity platforms).
* Deep understanding of the Indian mobility and tourism ecosystem, including urban/rural transit networks, regional travel dynamics, and localized tourism.
* Expertise in yield management, dynamic pricing, route/inventory capacity planning, and user acquisition strategies.
* Solid grasp of agile methodologies and demonstrated skill in working with cross-functional product and tech teams.
* Exceptional negotiation, partner management, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Chief Business Officer -ESR (Electro Slag Remelting) / Forged Steel | Delhi | Exp: 20+ Years
description:
Role Title: Chief Business Officer

Location: New Delhi

Experience: 20+ years within the manufacturing industry, 12-15 years of experience in ESR, steel, forging, special metals, heavy engineering industries and downstream facilities like heat treatment & machining

**OVERALL PURPOSE OF THE ROLE:**

The incumbent will provide strategic and operational leadership for the entire ESR and Forging business with complete accountability for business growth, profitability, manufacturing excellence, customer satisfaction, technology leadership, and sustainable value creation. The role will oversee business strategy, commercial operations, manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, quality, financial performance, and organizational capability while ensuring world-class standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. This role will drive the business towards becoming a preferred supplier of critical forged and ESR products for Defence, Aerospace, Nuclear, Energy, Railways, Oil & Gas, Heavy Engineering, and Industrial markets.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**1) Strategic Business Leadership:**

·      Develop and execute the long-term business strategy for the ESR & Forging Business aligned with the organization's vision and growth objectives.

·      Drive business expansion through capacity enhancement, product diversification, technology upgrades, and market development.

·      Identify emerging opportunities across Defence, Aerospace, Nuclear, Oil & Gas, Railways, Power Generation, Heavy Engineering, Marine, Mining, and Industrial sectors.

·      Evaluate strategic investments, acquisitions, technology collaborations, and partnerships to strengthen competitive positioning.

·      Monitor industry trends, customer requirements, global steel and forging markets, and competitive dynamics to formulate growth strategies.

**2) Business Development & Commercial Excellence:**

·      Develop and implement commercial strategies to achieve revenue, market share, and profitability objectives.

·      Build and strengthen long-term relationships with strategic customers, OEMs, EPC companies, PSUs, Defence organisations, and international clients.

·      Lead the complete business development lifecycle including customer acquisition, tendering, techno-commercial negotiations, contract finalisation, and order execution.

·      Expand export business by identifying new international markets and strategic channel partners.

·      Strengthen key account management and enhance customer retention through superior service delivery.

3)
**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence:**

·      Provide strategic leadership for ESR, melting, forging, heat treatment, machining, testing, and finishing operations.

·      Ensure optimum utilisation of plant capacity, manpower, equipment, and production resources.

·      Drive Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Industry 4.0, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives.

·      Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), productivity, yield, throughput, and delivery performance.

·      Lead plant modernisation, capacity expansion, and manufacturing technology enhancement projects.

4)
**Financial Performance & Business Profitability:**

·      Own the complete Profit & Loss (P&L) responsibility for the business.

·      Develop annual business plans, operating budgets, financial forecasts, and capital expenditure plans.

·      Drive EBITDA improvement through operational efficiencies, cost optimisation, value engineering, and productivity enhancement.

·      Monitor business performance using financial and operational dashboards and implement corrective actions.

·      Optimise working capital, inventory management, cash flow, and return on invested capital.

5)
**Technology, Engineering & Product Development**

·      Drive development of high-value ESR and forged products for critical engineering applications.

·      Lead product innovation and qualification programmes in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, R&D institutions, and certification agencies.

·      Promote adoption of advanced metallurgical processes, simulation technologies, automation, and digital quality systems.

·      Support development of specialised alloys, high-performance steels, and customised forging solutions.

6)
**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

·      Ensure compliance with customer specifications, national and international standards, and statutory regulations.

·      Drive a zero-defect culture through robust Quality Management Systems and continuous process improvement.

·      Ensure adherence to ISO, AS9100, NADCAP (where applicable), PED, API, Defence quality requirements, and other customer-specific certifications.

·      Promote a strong culture of Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) and operational risk management.

**7) Supply Chain & Procurement**

·      Provide strategic direction for procurement, vendor development, logistics, and supply chain operations.

·      Build strategic partnerships with raw material suppliers, alloy manufacturers, machining vendors, and logistics partners.

·      Optimise sourcing strategies, inventory levels, supplier performance, and procurement costs while ensuring uninterrupted production.

**8) Customer & Stakeholder Management**

·      Build trusted relationships with customers, government agencies, certification bodies, consultants, and industry associations.

·      Lead executive customer reviews, strategic business discussions, and contract negotiations.

·      Represent the organisation at industry forums, trade exhibitions, customer audits, and government interactions.

·      Enhance customer satisfaction through reliable delivery, quality excellence, and technical support.

**9) Leadership & Organisation Development**

·      Build and develop a high-performing leadership team focused on accountability, innovation, and business excellence.

·      Drive succession planning, leadership development, capability building, and employee engagement initiatives.

·      Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, operational discipline, and customer-centricity.

Lead organisational transformation and change management initiatives to support long-term growth.

**TECHNICAL COMEPTENCIES**

·      Strong understanding of ESR (Electro Slag Remelting), steelmaking, forging, heat treatment, machining, metallurgy, and critical engineering manufacturing processes.

·      Proven experience in managing integrated manufacturing businesses with full P&L responsibility.

·      Strong knowledge of Defence, Aerospace, Nuclear, Oil & Gas, Power, Railways, Marine, and Heavy Engineering markets.

·      Expertise in strategic planning, business development, contract management, and commercial negotiations.

·      Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, Industry 4.0, and digital manufacturing.

·      Knowledge of metallurgical testing, quality assurance systems, statutory compliance, and international manufacturing standards.

Strong financial acumen with expertise in budgeting, forecasting, business analytics, and capital investment planning.

Job Description: Manager / Assistant Manager – Social Media Marketing

**Company:**
Ferns N Petals (FNP)

**Department:**
Marketing

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Experience:**
3–6 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About FNP

Ferns N Petals (FNP) is a leading gifting and celebration brand, offering flowers, cakes, personalised gifts, and curated products for every occasion. With a strong digital presence and a diverse consumer base, FNP focuses on creating memorable gifting experiences through innovative products, engaging content, and impactful brand campaigns.

Role Overview

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and execution-oriented Social Media Marketing professional to strengthen FNP's social media presence and drive audience engagement through compelling content and innovative campaigns.

The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing social media campaigns, developing content strategies, identifying emerging trends, and creating engaging brand narratives across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant digital channels.

The ideal candidate should combine creativity with a data-driven approach and understand how to translate social media engagement into brand awareness, audience growth, and business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Strategy & Campaign Management

* Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with FNP's brand objectives, marketing priorities, and business goals.
* Plan and manage social media campaigns for key occasions, including Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Raksha Bandhan, Diwali, Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, and other gifting-led events.
* Drive campaigns around flowers, cakes, personalised gifts, celebrations, and seasonal product launches.
* Develop monthly content calendars covering campaigns, brand storytelling, product promotions, trends, and engagement initiatives.
* Manage end-to-end campaign execution, from ideation and briefing to publishing, performance tracking, and optimisation.
* Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across social media platforms.

2. Content Creation & Creative Development

* Conceptualise engaging content formats, including Instagram Reels, short-form videos, carousels, stories, static posts, and interactive content.
* Develop creative ideas and content narratives that resonate with target audiences and reflect FNP's brand personality.
* Write engaging captions, social media copy, hooks, calls to action, and campaign messaging.
* Collaborate with designers, video editors, photographers, copywriters, and internal marketing teams to produce high-quality content.
* Create compelling product-led content that showcases gifting experiences, product benefits, and occasion-based solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage user-generated content, influencer content, and customer stories.

3. Trends, Community & Audience Engagement

* Stay updated on social media trends, viral formats, platform updates, and evolving consumer behaviour.
* Identify relevant trends and translate them into timely, brand-appropriate content opportunities.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience conversations to strengthen community engagement.
* Develop interactive initiatives such as polls, contests, giveaways, and engagement-led campaigns.
* Explore opportunities to increase organic reach, followers, engagement rates, and brand visibility.
* Monitor competitor activity and social media best practices to identify opportunities for differentiation.

4. Influencer & Integrated Campaign Collaboration

* Collaborate with influencer marketing teams on creator-led content, campaign briefs, and social media amplification.
* Coordinate with brand, performance marketing, category, and e-commerce teams to ensure integrated campaign execution.
* Support product launches, festive campaigns, promotional activities, and brand partnerships.
* Ensure social media campaigns align with broader marketing initiatives and commercial priorities.

5. Performance Tracking & Optimisation

* Track and analyse key performance indicators, including reach, impressions, engagement rate, video views, shares, saves, follower growth, and website traffic.
* Prepare regular social media performance reports and provide actionable insights.
* Identify high-performing content formats and recommend improvements to content strategy.
* Conduct experiments with creative formats, content hooks, posting schedules, and messaging to improve performance.
* Use platform analytics and social media management tools to measure campaign effectiveness.
* Evaluate campaign performance against defined objectives and recommend data-backed improvements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Advertising, Journalism, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in social media marketing, content creation, and digital campaign management.
* Demonstrated experience managing social media accounts for consumer brands, lifestyle brands, D2C businesses, e-commerce companies, or agencies.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging social media platforms.
* Experience in developing content calendars, managing campaigns, and coordinating creative production.
* Excellent copywriting, storytelling, and creative ideation skills.
* Strong understanding of social media analytics, engagement metrics, and campaign performance measurement.
* Familiarity with social media management and analytics tools such as Meta Business Suite, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or equivalent platforms.
* Working knowledge of Canva and/or creative collaboration tools is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and deliver within tight timelines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience working with gifting, lifestyle, fashion, beauty, food, retail, or other consumer-focused brands.
* Strong understanding of occasion-led marketing, consumer behaviour, and cultural trends.
* A creative thinker who can turn everyday trends and consumer insights into engaging brand content.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple campaigns and seasonal priorities.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
* A portfolio showcasing social media campaigns, content concepts, and measurable results is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Growth in organic reach, followers, and audience engagement.
* Quality, consistency, and timeliness of social media content.
* Performance of social media campaigns against defined objectives.
* Growth in video views, shares, saves, and meaningful audience interactions.
* Effectiveness of occasion-led campaigns and creative initiatives.
* Improvement in content performance through testing and analytics.
* Contribution to brand awareness, website traffic, and business objectives where measurable.

Why Join FNP?

* Work with an established consumer brand across gifting, celebrations, flowers, and cakes.
* Create campaigns around high-engagement occasions and seasonal marketing moments.
* Opportunity to experiment with new content formats, digital trends, and creative storytelling.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across brand marketing, design, content, and e-commerce.
* Contribute directly to strengthening the brand's digital presence and consumer engagement.

**If you are passionate about social media, creative storytelling, and building campaigns that connect with consumers, we would love to hear from you.**

description:

HULP is a premium, tech-enabled home operating system that helps modern families manage their daily lives effortlessly.

By combining human expertise with intelligent workflows, HULP seamlessly handles home, lifestyle, travel, scheduling, experiences, shopping and coordination needs — giving families a single, trusted layer to manage the complexity of everyday life.

We are looking for a creative, digitally savvy Marketing Associate who understands content, social media, video editing and influencer marketing. This role is for someone who can take an idea from concept to execution — whether that means editing a reel, creating a social media post, coordinating with a creator or helping bring a campaign to life.

You should be comfortable working across content creation, short-form video editing, social media management, influencer collaborations and day-to-day marketing execution. You should know your way around tools such as Canva and CapCut, have a good eye for visual storytelling, and understand the kind of content that captures attention on Instagram and other digital platforms.

We are looking for someone who is creative but practical, organised but resourceful, and willing to get hands-on with the actual work. You should be able to spot a trend, develop a content idea, execute it quickly and contribute to building a consistent, distinctive brand presence for HULP.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Content Creation & Video Editing:**
  Create and edit short-form videos, Instagram Reels, stories, social media posts and other digital content using tools such as Canva, CapCut and similar editing applications.

  Help maintain the monthly content calendar, coordinate upcoming posts and campaigns, and ensure timely delivery of creative assets.
* **Brand Communication:**
  Ensure that content, captions, visuals and creator collaborations align with HULP’s positioning as a premium lifestyle and home operating system.
* **Performance Tracking:**
  Review basic social media and campaign performance, understand what content resonates with the audience, and use those learnings to improve future execution.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Work with internal teams to gather inputs, develop content ideas and support marketing requirements across the business.

  Maintain an organised library of content, raw footage, edited videos, design assets, influencer details and campaign material.

* 1–3 years of experience in digital marketing, social media marketing, content creation, influencer marketing or a related role.

* Understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories, social media formats and current content trends.
* Familiarity with influencer identification, outreach, collaborations and campaign coordination.
* Strong written communication skills, particularly for captions, content briefs and creator communication.
* Good visual sense, attention to detail and an understanding of digital-first brand communication.
* Ability to manage multiple creative tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Willingness to learn, experiment and execute ideas in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Iliana Beauty & Co. is a modern luxury beauty brand that brings high-performance cosmetics and skincare-led formulations together, grounded in intentional design. Founded by sisters Niharika Singh and Nupoor Singh, the brand is built on ethics, inclusivity, and refined elegance. Every product is created to care for the skin while enhancing individual beauty across a wide range of skin tones.

The leadership team brings expertise across commercial finance, strategy, brand building, technology, and product innovation, with a shared focus on sustainable growth and a consumer-centric vision. Our products are cruelty-free and built to globally compliant standards. We are launching direct-to-consumer in India with a curated range of cosmetics, and we are looking for someone who wants to shape how a new luxury brand finds and grows its audience from day one.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Senior Marketing Specialist to own performance marketing, digital marketing, and go-to-market strategy for Iliana. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable building a launch plan, running paid campaigns, and reading the numbers to decide what to do next. You will work closely with our Marketing and content team and the founders, and you will have real ownership over how the brand grows in its first year and beyond.

**What You Will Do**

**Go-to-market strategy**

* Build and execute go-to-market plans for the brand launch and every new product or shade release that follows
* Define target audiences, customer segments, and positioning for each channel, informed by market research and competitor analysis
* Own the promotional and campaign calendar, including launches, seasonal moments, festive periods, and sale events
* Partner with product and sales to plan pricing, bundles, offers, and launch sequencing

**Performance marketing**

* Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta (Instagram and Facebook), Google (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max), and emerging channels
* Manage budgets and pacing against clear targets for ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, and contribution margin
* Run structured creative and audience testing, and turn results into clear next steps for the content team
* Set up and maintain tracking, pixels, conversion events, and attribution across the Shopify storefront and ad platforms

**Digital marketing and retention**

* Grow owned channels including email, WhatsApp, and SMS, with lifecycle journeys such as welcome, browse and cart recovery, post-purchase, and replenishment
* Improve storefront conversion through landing page tests, offer testing, and onsite experience improvements
* Work with the content and social team to keep messaging, storytelling, and brand voice consistent across every touchpoint
* Support influencer and creator programs with tracking, performance analysis, and amplification of top-performing content through paid media

**Measurement and reporting**

* Build weekly and monthly dashboards covering acquisition, retention, and revenue performance
* Translate data into recommendations that the founders and team can act on quickly
* Track market trends, competitor activity, and consumer behaviour in the Indian beauty space, and bring those insights into planning.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of marketing experience, with at least 3 years running performance marketing for a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce brand.
* Proven experience managing meaningful paid media budgets on Meta and Google, with results you can speak to in numbers
* Experience planning and executing a product or brand launch from strategy through to measurement
* Strong working knowledge of Shopify, Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and at least one email or CRM platform such as Zoho, Klaviyo, WebEngage, or MoEngage
* Comfort with data: building reports in spreadsheets or dashboard tools, reading attribution, and running clean tests
* A good eye for creative and an understanding of what makes beauty content perform, especially on Instagram and short-form video
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across creative, product, and sales teams
* Strong organisational skills and comfort managing several priorities in a fast-moving, early-stage environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with luxury, premium, beauty, skincare, or wellness brands
* Familiarity with marketplace marketing on Nykaa, Amazon, or Myntra
* Experience working with influencers and creators at scale
* Understanding of the Indian D2C landscape and regional audience nuances

title: Growth Hacker Intern - SEO/AEO & AI Generated Multimedia Content
description:
**About Surgy Health**

Surgy Health (Surgy Innovation Labs Pvt. Ltd.) builds AI-first software products for hospitals. Our suite — including SurgyCRM, SurgyLearn, SurgyScribe and SurgyFrontdesk — is used by hospital groups across India and the GCC. We are a small, product-led team: what you ship here is in the market within days.

**The role**

You will own Surgy’s organic growth end to end: getting found on Google and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), producing AI-assisted content across formats, and running our presence on the platforms where hospital leaders, healthtech buyers and builders spend their time. SEO and AEO are the core of the role — everything else feeds them.

You will use AI heavily, Claude in particular. The job, though, is the judgement you layer on top: what to publish, what to cut, what is accurate, and which experiment to run next.

**What you’ll do**

**SEO & AEO (core)**

* Research keywords, search intent and buyer questions for hospital software across India, the GCC and other markets.
* Own on-page SEO for surgy.health: titles, meta, internal linking, schema markup, page speed and indexing via Google Search Console.
* Structure content so AI answer engines cite it: Q&A blocks, FAQs, comparison pages, consistent entity information and llms.txt.
* Track Surgy’s visibility in AI answers for priority queries (e.g. “AI-first hospital software”, “hospital CRM India”) and improve it month on month.
* Build backlinks and citations through listings, guest posts, PR mentions and community contributions.

**Content & AI multimedia**

* Write and publish blogs, product explainers, comparison pages and case-study drafts.
* Produce AI-generated images, carousels and short videos (reels, shorts, product snippets) for each channel.
* Help plan and produce a podcast or video series — guest research, scripts, editing, clips and show notes.
* Run the content calendar and repurpose each core piece into channel-native formats.

**Social media & communities**

* Manage Surgy’s handles on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, YouTube and other channels — posting, engagement and reporting.
* Contribute genuinely on Reddit, Quora, Indie Hackers, Product Hunt and healthtech communities — useful answers and discussion, not spam.
* Draft founder-led content for the founders’ personal LinkedIn and X profiles.

**Listings & directories**

* Create and maintain company and product listings on software directories (G2, Capterra, SoftwareSuggest and similar), AI-tool directories, Product Hunt, Crunchbase, Google Business Profile and healthcare-IT marketplaces.
* Keep descriptions, screenshots, categories and reviews current and consistent everywhere.

**Growth experiments & reporting**

* Propose and run small, measurable growth experiments every week; drop what doesn’t work, scale what does.
* Report weekly on traffic, rankings, AI-answer visibility, audience growth, engagement and inbound leads.

**How you’ll work with AI**

* **Advanced Claude usage.**
  Projects loaded with brand and product context, reusable prompts and skills, research and analysis workflows, multi-step content pipelines — not one-off chat prompts.
* **Multi-tool production.**
  Combine Claude with image, video and audio generation tools to ship polished multimedia quickly.
* **Human judgement at every step.**
  Fact-check every claim, keep Surgy’s voice consistent, and decide what is worth publishing at all.
* **Healthcare guardrails.**
  No unverified clinical claims, no patient data, and no customer names or logos without approval.
* **Reusable playbooks.**
  Document the workflows that work so the team can run them without you.

**What you bringMust-have**

* Hands-on SEO experience (personal projects count) and a working understanding of AEO / generative engine optimisation.
* Strong written English — clear, specific, no fluff.
* Daily, advanced use of Claude and comfort with other AI tools. Be ready to show us your workflows.
* Experience creating AI-generated images and short videos.
* Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4 and at least one SEO tool (Ahrefs, Semrush, Ubersuggest or similar).
* An experimenter’s habit: form a hypothesis, test it, read the numbers, decide.
* Based in Delhi NCR, or able to attend in-person meetings there when required.

**Nice to have**

* A blog, newsletter, channel or social handle you have grown yourself.
* Interest in healthcare, healthtech or B2B SaaS.
* Basic HTML/CSS or CMS experience; comfort with no-code and automation tools.
* Podcast or video editing experience.

**What success looks like**

* **First 30 days:**
  SEO and AEO audit of surgy.health; tracking set up (Search Console, GA4, AI-answer visibility tracker); core listings live; content calendar published.
* **By 90 days:**
  consistent weekly publishing across blog and social; measurable gains in organic traffic, AI-answer citations and inbound enquiries; a documented library of Claude workflows.
* **By 6 months:**
  a repeatable growth engine with clear channel-level metrics, and a plan for what you would own as a full-time hire.

**Conversion to full-time**

Strong performers will be offered a full-time role (e.g. Growth Marketing Associate — SEO/AEO) at the end of the internship. The decision rests on measurable results, ownership and the quality of your judgement — not on time served.

**What you get**

* Direct work with the founders on a live B2B healthtech product sold in India and the GCC.
* Real ownership: your work goes live, and you see its impact in the numbers.
* Access to the AI tools the role needs.
* Remote-first, flexible working.
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation on completion.

description:
**About Growify Digital**

Growify Digital is a results-driven digital marketing agency specializing in scaling luxury fashion brands. We craft data-backed strategies to help businesses grow sustainably and build impactful online experiences.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and creative
**Email Marketing Specialist**
to
**manage and execute**
email marketing campaigns from strategy to delivery. The ideal candidate will be passionate about customer engagement, have a strong grasp of segmentation and automation, and possess the ability to create campaigns that drive measurable results.

**What You'll Do**

**Plan the strategy:**

* Build a monthly retention calendar for each brand covering launches, sales, festive drops and newsletters.
* Segment customers by purchase behaviour, browsing activity, location and lifecycle stage (new, repeat, VIP, lapsed).
* Pick the right channel for each message so customers hear from us at the right time without being over-messaged.

**Build and run campaigns:**

* Set up and maintain automated flows: welcome series, browse and cart abandonment, post-purchase, back-in-stock, win-back and birthday.
* Run promotional, launch and newsletter campaigns end to end, from brief to send.
* Write subject lines, copy and CTAs in each brand's voice, and brief designers on creatives.

**Measure and improve:**

* Track open rate, click-through rate, conversions, revenue per send and unsubscribes for every campaign and flow.
* A/B test subject lines, content, offers, layouts and send times, then roll the winners into future campaigns.
* Share a monthly performance report for each brand with clear next steps.

**Keep lists healthy and compliant:**

* Clean lists regularly, manage bounces and inactive subscribers, and protect sender reputation and deliverability.
* Follow consent and opt-out rules. These include India's DPDP Act, TRAI DLT registration for SMS, WhatsApp Business policies, and GDPR for international customers.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years in email, CRM, retention or lifecycle marketing, ideally for D2C or eCommerce brands.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of Klaviyo, Mailchimp, BiteSpeed or Interakt.
* Strong English copywriting, with an ear for brand tone.
* Clear understanding of email and WhatsApp metrics, funnels and customer journeys.
* Comfort with numbers: reading dashboards and building simple reports in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, campaigns and deadlines without missing details.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Shopify stores and their apps and integrations.
* Background in fashion, luxury or lifestyle brands.
* Basic HTML for editing email templates.

title: Lead, Creator Marketing
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a
**Lead, Creator Marketing**
to build Atlys' creator engine from zero - the playbook, the creator network, and the team that turns creator-led content into visa applications. You'll run this at real volume: a hundred-plus videos a month across everything from nano creators telling their own visa story to celebrity partnerships, and tens of millions of views behind them. Almost none of it exists yet. What you build in the first six months is what this function runs on for years.
  
  
**The Job**

* Build and own the creator playbook across platforms and creator tiers, deciding where every rupee goes, which tiers earn more of it, and why.
* Own the channel P&L end to end, setting the budget split across creator tiers and destinations and defending it on cost per visit and cost per application, not views.
* Negotiate and close the highest-value creator and celebrity partnerships personally, setting the commercial standard the rest of the team works to.
* Hire, ramp and lead a small pod across sourcing, creative and operations, and build the process that lets it run at volume without quality falling over.
* Report the channel honestly to leadership every week, what worked, what didn't, what you're changing and hand the winning creative to paid amplification.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 6–7 years in creator or influencer marketing, including real time owning a budget and a number rather than executing someone else's plan.
* Are equally at home in a spreadsheet and a creative review, and can tell whether a piece of content is good before the data comes in.
* Are process-driven by instinct, and have built systems that let a team scale output without you personally touching every deal.
* Can hold your own commercially with talent managers and agencies, and know what a creator is actually worth versus what they're asking for.
* Have built something from zero before, and want the ambiguity, pace and personal accountability that comes with it.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

**The Role**

JoVE is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Marketing Operations Specialist. This role combines email marketing, marketing automation, CRM/database management, and marketing analytics to ensure our campaigns are delivered efficiently, reach the right audiences, and generate measurable business results.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Google Analytics and can translate marketing objectives into reliable segmentation, automated journeys, and actionable reporting. They independently identify root causes, recommend practical solutions, and implement improvements that deliver measurable results.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain automated lifecycle journeys, including entry and exit criteria, behavioral triggers, sales handoffs and return-to-nurture rules. Support campaign execution through reusable workflows and templates.
* Perform quality assurance (QA) to ensure campaigns are error-free and delivered successfully.
* Diagnose and improve email delivery, inbox placement and engagement. Monitor sender reputation, bounces, complaints and audience health, coordinating technical fixes with RevOps.
* Design and evaluate campaign A/B tests using clear hypotheses and success metrics, including downstream conversion.
* Maintain and improve the marketing database through enrichment, validation, duplicate controls and documented data-quality checks.
* Own marketing data-quality monitoring and audience usability. Partner with RevOps, Sales, and Product on shared CRM definitions, field mappings, and data integrity.
* Build and maintain dashboards across Salesforce, HubSpot, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Track marketing KPIs, campaign performance, lead generation, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
* Analyze marketing performance and provide actionable insights to optimize campaigns and support strategic decision-making.
* Develop and validate lead and account scoring using profile and behavioral signals. Agree handoff thresholds with Sales and refine scoring based on progression and feedback.
* Evaluate and introduce tools, including AI, that expand marketing capabilities, and enable the team to use them effectively through enablement and practical guidance.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of relevant experience, including independent ownership of Marketing Operations improvements beyond campaign execution.

* Advanced HubSpot experience in workflows, dynamic segmentation and data management.
* Ability to evaluate behavioral signals, explain performance and deliver measurable improvements.
* Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and marketing automation.
* Experience with marketing attribution and funnel analysis.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, CRM management and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Experience managing marketing databases, segmentation, and data hygiene.
* Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate and timely execution of global email campaigns, with reduced turnaround time and manual effort.
* A reliable marketing database with effective audience segmentation and fewer recurring data errors.
* Reliable dashboards and reporting that support business decisions.
* Improved lead qualification, funnel progression and Sales handoff quality.
* Adoption of reusable processes, automation and tools that improve team productivity and reduce workflow errors.
* Measurable improvements in campaign performance and contribution to pipeline generation.

**Benefits**

* A competitive compensation package

* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Global Digital Marketing Senior Specialist - SEO/AEO/GEO
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We're seeking an SEO/GEO/AEO Specialist to support our global SEO and discoverability strategy. You'll execute across keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and modern search discoverability research and implementation (including AI-driven and zero-click experiences) — working directly with our Digital Content Strategy team to ensure content is findable, well-structured, and aligned to how today’s users search and find content online.
  
  
Day-to-day, this means producing keyword research, answering stakeholder questions about SEO and discoverability platforms, running site audits, implementing on-page optimizations, and supporting actionable performance reporting that can be used to inform optimizations. You’ll use tools like Semrush, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, and more. You'll coordinate with editorial teams to translate SEO guidance into action, and flag gaps and opportunities as you find them. You’ll also identify opportunities to improve how our content is structured and understood by search engines and AI systems (e.g., extractability, internal linking, and structured data). Where relevant, you’ll adapt content to increase visibility in features like snippets, AI summaries, and other zero-click surfaces. This includes optimizing content for visibility in answer engines and AI-powered search experiences, not just traditional rankings.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with exposure to both content and technical workstreams
* Ability to read content with an SEO lens — identifying structural, intent, or keyword issues at the page level
* Ability to triage a site audit and prioritize fixes by business impact, not just severity
* Experience executing SEO requests and documenting optimizations in a structured, trackable way
* Demonstrated ability to execute on-page optimizations and keyword research independently
* Experience producing SEO reports with plain-language context for non-SEO stakeholders, not raw data pulls
* Experience measuring performance beyond rankings (e.g., impressions, snippet capture, zero-click impact)
* Familiarity with how AI-driven search experiences (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) are changing content discoverability
* Curiosity about emerging search paradigms, including generative/LLM-driven discovery
* Working proficiency with Semrush, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics or comparable platforms
* Strong written English communication skills for interfacing with a global team

**Preferred**

* Prior experience in a B2B or large-scale content environment
* Familiarity with site crawl tools such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb
* A portfolio of past SEO work — demonstrated results matter more than credentials

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Working independently and delivering against defined milestones without needing close oversight — you take ownership of your workstream and follow through
* Communicating clearly across teams — you can explain SEO concepts to non-technical stakeholders without losing them in jargon
* Understanding how search behavior is evolving beyond traditional rankings (e.g., AI-generated answers, zero-click results) and adapting accordingly
* Connecting keyword intent to broader user journeys, not just individual queries
* Reading a piece of content and diagnosing why it may not be performing — thin coverage, intent mismatch, poor structure — and knowing how to fix
* Structuring content so it is easily interpreted, extracted, and surfaced by search engines and AI systems
* Staying detail-oriented under competing priorities — you're thorough in execution and know when to escalate versus when to move forward
* Spotting patterns in data and turning them into clear, actionable recommendations
* Adapting quickly in a global, fast-paced environment where priorities can shift

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Senior Category Manager

Category Management

6–10 years

Gurugram, Haryana

E-commerce, D2C, Retail, FMCG, Lifestyle, or Consumer Products

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a commercially driven
**Senior Category Manager with strong experience in private-label strategy, product development, and category P&L management**
. The individual will be responsible for building and scaling private-label portfolios, identifying new product opportunities, managing product assortment, driving profitability, and developing differentiated offerings aligned with consumer demand and business objectives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in the end-to-end private-label lifecycle, including market research, product conceptualisation, vendor development, sourcing, pricing, launch execution, and performance optimisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Private Label Strategy & Product Development**

* Develop and execute strategies to build, expand, and scale private-label product portfolios.
* Identify market gaps, emerging trends, and consumer needs to develop new product opportunities.
* Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept development and sourcing to launch and performance tracking.
* Drive product differentiation through quality, design, packaging, features, and competitive pricing.
* Evaluate product performance and identify opportunities for portfolio expansion and SKU rationalisation.

**2. Category Management & P&L Ownership**

* Drive category revenue, gross margins, profitability, and overall business growth.
* Develop category strategies, annual business plans, sales forecasts, and growth initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through pricing optimisation, sourcing efficiencies, and product mix enhancement.
* Monitor category performance and implement corrective actions to achieve business targets.

**3. Sourcing & Vendor Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturers and suppliers for private-label products.
* Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, minimum order quantities, payment terms, and lead times.
* Build strategic vendor relationships to ensure cost competitiveness, consistent quality, and timely delivery.
* Collaborate with procurement and quality teams to establish product specifications and quality standards.

**4. Assortment & Inventory Management**

* Develop category assortment plans, pricing architecture, and product portfolio strategies.
* Monitor inventory availability, sell-through, stock ageing, and replenishment requirements.
* Optimise inventory turnover while minimising stock-outs, excess inventory, and obsolete stock.
* Analyse SKU-level performance to improve assortment productivity and working capital efficiency.

**5. Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights**

* Conduct competitor benchmarking, market research, and pricing analysis.
* Identify emerging consumer preferences, market trends, and potential category opportunities.
* Translate market insights and customer feedback into commercially viable product propositions.

**6. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with design, marketing, procurement, supply chain, quality, and sales teams to execute category plans.
* Drive new product launches, promotional initiatives, and seasonal assortment planning.
* Ensure alignment across teams for product readiness, availability, quality, and go-to-market execution.

**7. Business Analytics & Reporting**

* Track key category metrics, including revenue growth, gross margins, contribution margins, inventory turnover, and SKU productivity.
* Prepare regular business reviews and provide actionable recommendations to senior management.
* Use data-driven insights to identify risks, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate growth.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 6–10 years of experience in category management, private-label management, product management, merchandising, or buying.
* Demonstrated experience in
  **private-label product development and scaling**
  , including sourcing, vendor management, pricing, and product launches.
* Experience managing category-level revenue, margins, and commercial performance.
* Strong understanding of consumer products, retail, e-commerce, or D2C business models.
* Proven experience working with manufacturers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, commercial, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and business reporting tools.
* MBA in Marketing, Retail Management, Supply Chain, or a related discipline is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

* Category revenue growth and profitability.
* Gross margin and contribution margin improvement.
* Private-label portfolio growth and sales contribution.
* New product launch performance and SKU productivity.
* Inventory turnover, sell-through, and stock ageing.
* Sourcing cost optimisation and vendor performance.
* Product quality and customer satisfaction.

title: Technical Chief of Staff
description:
**About Castler**

Castler provides compliance-grade trust infrastructure for both money and software. We help enterprises and financial institutions govern mission-critical assets through independent, rules-based escrow frameworks, so that financial flows and software dependencies are not left solely in the hands of a counterparty. Built on bank-grade security standards, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, we are trusted by technology and risk teams across the country. We are hiring a Technical Chief of Staff who works alongside leadership to drive our most important priorities and owns processes end to end, from building on our product tech stack to architecting and optimising our go-to-market motion. This role sits at the intersection of technology, revenue, operations, and execution. Your job is to build scalable systems that turn our Ideal Customer Profile into predictable revenue. It is a hands-on engineering role as much as a strategic one; you will write code and present to leadership in the same week.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Hands-on expertise with AI and automation tools, prompt engineering, and building scalable workflows.
* Strong analytical skills and a data-first approach to decisions.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* A background in revenue operations, growth, or similar technical GTM roles is a strong plus.

**Ideal Candidate Traits**

* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid experimentation.
* A data-driven decision maker with creative problem-solving ability.
* Strong business acumen with a focus on cost-effective solutions.
* Able to influence and align stakeholders across functions.
* An engineer at heart with an owner’s mindset, equally comfortable writing code and presenting to leadership.

**Location**

Delhi. This is a 100% work-from-office role.

To apply, use the link below or write to hr@castler.com.

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description: About VoyVoy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.About The SpaceGLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.Strategy & Operations - Role OverviewThe S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.If this sounds like you, and you have 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles. Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'Then let’s chat!

▪ Taking Self-initiatives to transform business/ process & enhance performance; creative and developing innovative solutions to business problems
  
  
▪ Being a team player, supportive to other team members and collaborative across functions
  
  
FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Head of Retail
description:
**LENSKART**

*Job Description*

**Retail Leader**

**Mission Brief**

Lenskart's offline retail network is one of the largest and fastest-scaling in the world — thousands of stores across metros, Tier 2/3 India, and international markets, staffed by tens of thousands of frontline team members. This role owns a defined slice of that network.

You will build the operating discipline that lets every store under your charge deliver a consistent, premium, tech-enabled customer experience, while driving revenue and profitability with rigor. This is a P&L-owning, people-leading, systems-thinking role — for leaders who see retail not as a set of stores but as a network that gets smarter with every data point.

**Core Mandate**

**1. P&L Ownership & Revenue Growth**

* **Revenue Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end P&L for the assigned store network — revenue, margin, and store-level profitability across company-owned and franchise stores.
* **Planning:**
  Build and execute the network's strategic business plan, Annual Operating Plan, and financial forecasts, aligned to the broader retail strategy.
* **Performance Management:**
  Track footfall conversion, ATV, ABS, NPS, repeat rate, and store-level profitability through real-time dashboards to drive decisions at speed.
* **Turnaround:**
  Diagnose underperforming stores, identify root causes, and drive rapid turnaround plans — including restructuring or exits where required.
* **Growth:**
  Identify and execute expansion opportunities within the network — new store openings, mall/high-street partnerships, and franchise collaborations.

**2. Retail Operations & Customer Experience**

* **Operational Excellence:**
  Establish and drive best-in-class store operating standards — opening/closing SOPs, visual merchandising, inventory management, and customer service protocols.
* **Experience Ownership:**
  Be the single point of accountability for how every store in the network feels — ensuring a consistent, premium brand experience across metros, Tier 2, and Tier 3 markets.
* **Tech-Enabled Retail:**
  Drive adoption of Lenskart's retail technology stack — virtual try-on, AI-powered lens recommendations, computer vision-based eye testing, and omnichannel (online-to-offline, BOPIS) — to make every store visit smarter and more personalized.
* **Eye Test Quality:**
  Ensure eye tests across the network meet the highest standards of accuracy, patient care, and regulatory compliance.
* **Insight-Led Iteration:**
  Act on customer feedback, mystery shopping audits, and real-time NPS data to continuously elevate the in-store experience.

**3. Cost & Efficiency Management**

* **Cost Discipline:**
  Maintain operational costs within budget while optimizing manpower costs across the network.
* **Inventory Control:**
  Implement inventory control mechanisms to minimize shrinkage and pilferage.
* **Automation:**
  Champion process automation — POS optimization, AI-driven CRM, smart queue management — to boost in-store efficiency.

**4. People Leadership & Culture**

* **Talent Development:**
  Lead, mentor, and develop Area/Cluster/Zonal Managers, Store Managers, and frontline teams — building a leadership pipeline and succession bench.
* **Hiring & Retention:**
  Build a world-class retail talent pipeline through structured hiring, onboarding, L&D, and career pathing that retains top performers.
* **Culture:**
  Foster a high-performance, customer-first culture with clear accountability, recognition frameworks, and incentive structures; reduce attrition through strong ground-level connect.
* **Alignment:**
  Embed the Lenskart Way into every aspect of retail execution — agility, ownership, and customer obsession — while aligning network-level goals to the broader retail strategy.

**5. Cross-Functional Impact**

* **Cross-Functional Partnership:**
  Partner with Marketing on hyperlocal campaigns and store activations; collaborate with Product, Tech, and Supply Chain to ensure inventory availability, assortment planning, and in-store tech deployment.
* **Representation:**
  Represent the retail network in leadership reviews and, at senior scope, in broader business discussions.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:**
  7+ years of progressive leadership experience in offline/physical retail, with direct P&L accountability — multi-unit, multi-city (and ideally multi-geography) operations. Seniority and scope expand with the size of the portfolio.
* **Technical Fluency:**
  Strong comfort with data, real-time dashboards, and tech-enabled retail operations; ability to think in systems and demand data-driven outcomes from teams.
* **Leadership:**
  Strong P&L management, people leadership, and the ability to translate broader business strategy into ground-level execution.
* **Mindset:**
  Customer-centric mindset, agility in a fast-paced high-growth environment, and willingness to travel extensively across the assigned network.
* **Education:**
  MBA from a Tier 1 institution preferred. Backgrounds in organized retail, D2C, QSR, fashion, or lifestyle brands are a strong plus.

**Why Join Us?**

Lead a critical piece of one of India's largest and fastest-growing offline retail networks, at the intersection of physical retail and AI-driven technology. Lenskart is a founder-led, newly-listed (NSE: LENSKART) company with a bias for speed and impact — decisions move fast here, and so does your career. Whether the mandate is a single circle or a national portfolio, you will be building the system that makes retail smarter, store by store.

**Location:**

Chhatarpur, New Delhi

Work From Office

https://zooplive.com

**About Zoop**

Zoop is a live commerce platform where shoppers discover and buy trendy and branded lifestyle products through live drops and auctions. It's shopping that feels like an event, not a catalogue scroll.

Zoop is backed by Peak XV and Lumikai and built by a founding team obsessed with how India shops. Our vision is to build India's defining live shopping destination: a platform where the best deals feel like entertainment.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a customer-obsessed Growth Marketeer to own how Zoop finds, wins and keeps its first wave of loyal shoppers. You'll use consumer insight and user psychology to drive signups, live viewership, conversion and repeat purchase. You'll test fast across paid, community, creator and organic channels and turn what works into a repeatable growth engine. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role that works directly with the founders, and it can grow into owning the revenue and P&L.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop a deep understanding of who our shoppers are, what makes them tune into a live drop, and what makes them bid and buy.
* Run customer research such as calls, surveys and live-session behaviour analysis, and turn it into sharper positioning, messaging and offers.
* Own acquisition across Meta ads, creator and UGC programs, Reddit and Whatsapp channels, and improve CAC and ROAS over time.
* Build the funnel end to end, from first touch to signup, app install, first live, first purchase and repeat.
* Drive initiatives that lift live concurrency, conversion rates, average order value and customer lifetime value.
* Analyse campaign performance, cohorts and funnel metrics (we use PostHog) to make fast, evidence-based decisions.
* Work with product, content, creators and the live-ops team to design campaigns.
* Work with founders to set growth targets, prioritise experiments and shape the buyer-side strategy.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* 3–6 years of experience in Growth, Performance, Consumer or Brand Marketing.
* Experience at a consumer app, marketplace, D2C brand, social commerce platform or high-growth startup.
* Strong grasp of consumer psychology and the behaviour of Indian shoppers, especially in fashion or deals.
* Hands-on with Meta ads and comfortable running creator, community or WhatsApp-led growth.
* A data-driven mindset and comfort with funnels, cohorts and experiment design.
* Clear communication and the ability to work across functions.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and a hunger to own outcomes, not just tasks.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A steadily growing base of engaged shoppers who show up for lives.
* Better CAC, ROAS and signup-to-purchase conversion.
* Clear understanding of our core customer segments and what drives them to buy and come back.
* Strong repeat-purchase and retention cohorts.
* A scalable, documented growth playbook that the team can build on.

**Why This Is a Rare 0→1 Opportunity**

Most growth roles hand you a mature funnel and ask you to squeeze out a few more percentage points. This one doesn't. Zoop is at the stage where the playbook hasn't been written yet, and you'll be the one writing it.

* **You'll shape a new category in India.**

  Live shopping is already huge in China and the US but still early here. You get to define how India discovers, trusts and buys through live commerce.
* **You'll build from zero to one.**

  You'll help find our first truly loyal customers, crack our core acquisition channels and turn early traction into a repeatable growth engine.

**Why Join Us?**

* Help build the next big consumer platform in India from the ground up.
* Work closely with the founders and leadership, backed by top-tier investors (Peak XV, Lumikai).
* Long-term wealth creation through ESOP participation.
* A high-ownership, high-impact role in a fast-moving team.
