title: VP - Public Policy & Government Affairs
description:
**Vice President - Public Policy & Government Affairs**
**Company**
: CoinDCX
  
  
**Location**
: Delhi, India
  
  
**About CoinDCX:**
Established in 2018, CoinDCX is India’s largest Virtual Digital Asset (VDA) exchange platform and a foundational force in the global Web3 ecosystem. Trusted by over 2 crore registered users, we have invested in 15+ Web3 projects and startups globally.
  
  
As a compliance-first organization, CoinDCX was the first Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) to register with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in India. With licensed operations spanning the UAE and Bahrain, our mission is to democratize investment in VDAs, provide seamless access to Web3 experiences, and relentlessly protect user interests.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an exceptionally credentialed Vice President - Public Policy & Government Affairs to spearhead our strategic advocacy efforts, shaping forward-looking regulatory frameworks for the Web3 and crypto industry across India and global markets.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Chief Public Policy Officer, you will lead a dedicated team of policy professionals and work closely with the executive management team. You will design and execute 360-degree policy strategies, drive public-facing advocacy, build strategic alliances, and serve as a crucial liaison between CoinDCX and regulatory bodies, government entities, and industry associations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Advocacy & Public Policy:
* Policy Strategy Formulation: Develop and execute proactive, high-impact policy advocacy strategies to support the sustainable growth of the Web3 and digital asset ecosystem in India and internationally.
* 360-Degree Advocacy Plans: Collaborate with the Chief Public Policy Officer and executive leadership to align policy research, external representations, and internal business objectives.
* Public Policy Communications: Lead the strategy for public-facing policy artifacts—including white papers, official representations, research reports, and opinion pieces—working alongside Legal, Compliance, PR, Marketing, and external vendors.
* Policy Intelligence: Continuously monitor, analyze, and forecast regulatory trends and policy developments, delivering actionable guidance on potential risks and proactive engagement opportunities.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Ecosystem Alliances:
* Government & Regulatory Relations: Cultivate and sustain deep, trusted relationships with key government officials, financial regulators, law enforcement agencies, academia, and civil society.
* Industry Leadership: Represent CoinDCX in global and regional Web3, fintech, and trade associations to drive collaborative industry alignment and self-regulatory initiatives.
* Thought Leadership: Serve as a primary spokesperson for the company at high-level industry forums, roundtables, and policy summits.
* Cross-Functional Advisory & Team Leadership:
* Internal Strategic Counsel: Provide clear, business-enabling regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams—including Legal, Compliance, Product, and Engineering—on emerging legislative requirements.
* Team Development: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of government affairs and policy professionals, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

**Key Requirements:**

* Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership in public policy, government affairs, or regulatory strategy, ideally within the technology, fintech, or digital asset sectors.
* Regulatory Expertise: Deep understanding of the Indian regulatory ecosystem, parliamentary processes, financial regulatory bodies, and law enforcement frameworks, combined with global regulatory exposure (e.g., UAE, Bahrain, international markets).
* Track Record: Demonstrated success in conceptualizing and delivering impactful policy advocacy campaigns that yielded tangible regulatory or industry outcomes.
* Stakeholder Network: Proven experience building high-trust relationships across government entities, regulatory authorities, trade bodies, and policy think tanks.
* Leadership Skills: Proven capacity to manage, mentor, and scale team members while coordinating effectively across internal business units.
* Communication: Outstanding oral, written, and narrative-building skills, with the ability to translate complex technical/financial Web3 concepts into compelling policy positions.
* Education: Advanced degree (Master’s or equivalent) in Public Policy, Law, Economics, International Relations, or a related field preferred.

**Core Skills**

* Government engagement and stakeholder management.
* Policy analysis, advocacy, and drafting.
* Strategic communications and executive advisory.
* Regulatory risk assessment and issue anticipation.
* Cross-functional leadership and alignment.
* High-quality writing, structured thinking, and attention to detail.
* Strong credibility, discretion, and judgment under pressure.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The company is consistently represented as a credible, constructive, and informed voice in policy discussions relevant to Crypto and Web3 in India.
* The leadership team receive timely, high-quality advice on policy developments, stakeholder engagement, and reputational risks.
* The company’s policy priorities are clearly articulated in external forums and reflected in stronger stakeholder relationships and better-informed regulatory dialogue.
* Internal teams are equipped with actionable policy intelligence that supports business continuity, compliance readiness, and strategic decision-making.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You**
At CoinDCX, this role is central to shaping how India’s crypto and Web3 ecosystem evolves. You will work closely with leadership, regulators, and policymakers to help drive constructive regulation, industry credibility, and long-term growth for the sector.
  
  

* Opportunity to influence one of India’s most dynamic and high-impact sectors.
* Direct exposure to the CEO and strategic decision-making.
* Lead policy conversations with top government and regulatory stakeholders.
* Build institutional influence in a fast-evolving industry at national scale.

**Hiring Process**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving

* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best

**Where We Work**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Delhi Office**
, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Head Strategic Partnerships
description:
***About Us***

We believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future. Everyday, millions of children walk into government school classrooms with the same curiosity, dreams and potential as children anywhere else.

But as technology and AI rapidly reshape how we learn, work and solve problems, access to the skills and opportunities needed to thrive remains deeply unequal.

We exist to change that.

At Muskaan Dreams, our work begins with children and teachers. We spend time in classrooms, listen deeply to teachers, understand the realities of government schools, and design solutions that can work in the real world, not just in pilots.

We don't believe change can be created by building parallel systems. We believe in strengthening the public education system itself. That means working alongside teachers, school leaders, district administrations and state governments so that solutions can be adopted, sustained and eventually reach millions of children.

Over the last decade, this belief has taken us from working with a handful of schools to reaching nearly 1 million children, 5000+ government schools and 15000+ teachers across six states.

But for us, scale is not simply a number.

* Scale means a teacher feels more confident in her classroom.
* It means a child in a government school beginning to see herself as a problem-solver and creator.
* It means an education system becoming capable of sustaining change long after a programme or funder has exited.

Our ambition is to ensure that children in India's government schools are not simply consumers of technology but become confident problem solvers, critical thinkers, creators and future-ready citizens.

***Our Flagship Initiatives***

***Digital Shaala***

Digital Shaala transforms government school classrooms into engaging, technology-enabled learning environments. Through Smart Classrooms, curriculum-aligned digital content, teacher capacity building, and academic mentoring, the programme improves learning outcomes in Science and Mathematics while nurturing students' curiosity, confidence, and interest in STEM education and careers.

***AI-Saksham***

AI-Saksham prepares students and teachers for an AI-enabled world. Through experiential, classroom-integrated learning, students develop foundational AI literacy, computational thinking, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

The programme empowers young people with the skills and confidence needed to thrive in the future of work while enabling teachers to integrate AI meaningfully into classroom teaching.

As India prepares millions of young people for an AI-driven economy, we believe government schools must become the foundation of this transformation and not be left behind.

***Our Next Chapter***

Muskaan Dreams is entering a defining phase of growth.

Today, we manage an annual budget of approximately ₹20 crores, supported by leading corporations, foundations, philanthropies, and ecosystem partners.

Over the next 2–3 years, we aim to grow this into a ₹50 crore annual portfolio through a diversified and sustainable fundraising strategy built on long-term institutional partnerships rather than transactional grants.

Our larger ambition is to reach and impact 10 million children over the next five years while building one of India's leading organisations working at the intersection of AI, education, and government system transformation.

Achieving this will require more than funding. It will require a coalition of corporations, foundations, philanthropists, governments, technologists, educators, and leaders who share our belief that every child deserves the opportunity to thrive in an AI-enabled future.

***That is where you come in.***

***About the Role***

This is not simply a fundraising leadership role. It is an opportunity to help build the partnerships that could shape how millions of children experience education in an AI-enabled India.

As Director – Strategic Partnerships, you will work closely with the Founder & CEO and Leadership Team to bring together corporations, foundations, philanthropists, family offices, governments, and ecosystem leaders around a shared ambition: ensuring that children in India's government schools are not left behind as the world becomes increasingly technology and AI-driven.

You will lead Muskaan Dreams' institutional fundraising strategy, but your role will go far beyond raising capital.

You will help partners understand the problem deeply, imagine what is possible, and co-create long-term partnerships that combine philanthropic capital, technology, expertise, government systems, and on-ground execution to create sustainable change.

You will also build the team, systems, relationships, and institutional capabilities required to take Muskaan Dreams from a ₹20 crore organisation towards ₹50 crore in next 2-3 years and from reaching nearly 1 million children today towards 10 million over the next five years.

We believe the strongest partnerships are not transactions. They are built on trust, shared purpose, evidence, and a long-term belief in what is possible together.

***Key Areas of Focus***

***50%***
***– Corporate CSR Partnerships & Revenue Growth***

Lead Muskaan Dreams' corporate fundraising strategy by building long-term partnerships with leading Indian and global corporations.

Develop a strong pipeline of high-value opportunities, engage senior CSR leaders, and secure multi-year partnerships that enable sustainable organisational growth.

***30% – Foundations, Philanthropy & Institutional Grants***

Build and deepen relationships with Indian and international foundations, philanthropists, family offices, bilateral agencies, and institutional donors.

Lead grant strategy, proposal development, stewardship, renewals, and portfolio diversification while identifying funders aligned with Muskaan Dreams' long-term mission.

***20% – Strategy, Leadership & Institutional Growth***

Work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape Muskaan Dreams' long-term fundraising strategy, strengthen systems and processes, mentor the partnerships team, represent the organisation nationally, and identify new opportunities that strengthen institutional credibility and sustainability.

***What You Will Do***

You will build and manage relationships with some of India's most influential corporations, CSR leaders, philanthropies, foundations, family offices, and ecosystem partners aligned with Muskaan Dreams' mission.

You will own the complete partnership lifecycle from identifying opportunities and initiating conversations to proposal development, budgeting, presentations, negotiations, contracting, onboarding, stewardship, reporting, and partnership expansion.

You will engage senior decision-makers to understand both their business priorities and social impact goals, translating Muskaan Dreams' work into compelling partnership opportunities that create measurable impact for children while delivering strategic value to partners.

**Co-creating Partnerships for Scale**

This role goes beyond fundraising. You will work closely with our Program, Government Partnerships, Product, Finance, Communications, and Leadership teams to translate India's most pressing education challenges into ambitious, fundable, and scalable partnerships.

You will have the opportunity to bring together philanthropic capital, technology, government systems, and Muskaan Dreams' on-ground capabilities to help millions of students and teachers become future-ready.

These partnerships will span:

* AI Literacy, Computational Thinking & Future Readiness
* STEM Learning & Innovation
* Teacher Capacity Building & Leadership
* Government System Strengthening & Education Transformation
* 21st Century Skills, Life Skills & Student Agency

The ambition is not simply to fund programmes, but to build partnerships that demonstrate what works, create meaningful change for children and teachers, and scale sustainably through government systems.

You will also identify opportunities for consortium funding, strategic collaborations, innovation partnerships, employee engagement, technology partnerships, and ecosystem alliances that unlock long-term institutional growth and impact.

**Team Leadership & Institution Building**

You will lead and inspire a team of strategic partnerships professionals by setting ambitious goals, building strong execution systems, and creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, excellence, and continuous learning.

You will coach team members to independently build relationships, develop compelling proposals, manage donor portfolios, negotiate partnerships, and close meaningful opportunities — while developing future fundraising leaders within the organisation.

You will institutionalise strong forecasting systems, dashboards, review mechanisms, CRM discipline, proposal processes, partner stewardship, and fundraising governance that improve productivity, predictability, and decision-making across the function.

The goal is not only to deliver today's fundraising targets, but to build a partnership function capable of powering Muskaan Dreams' growth for the next decade.

***What Success Looks Like***

***Success in this role will mean:***

1. Fundraising Growth

Drive sustained year-on-year institutional fundraising growth, contributing significantly to Muskaan Dreams' journey from a ₹20 crore to ₹50 crore annual portfolio within 2–3 years.

2. A Predictable Fundraising Pipeline

Build and maintain a high-quality, qualified fundraising pipeline of at least 3–4× the annual fundraising target, providing strong visibility on conversions, renewals, and future revenue.

3. Strategic & Multi-Year Partnerships

Secure and grow multiple large, multi-year CSR and foundation partnerships while maintaining a strong 80%+ partner renewal/retention rate.

Success will be measured not simply by the number of partnerships but by their quality, longevity, scale, and potential to deepen over time.

4. Diversification & Strategic Value

Build a diversified funding portfolio that reduces dependency on a small number of funders while deepening important relationships beyond grants into government collaboration, technology, employee volunteering, knowledge, innovation, and ecosystem partnerships.

5. Team & Fundraising Systems

Build a high-performing partnerships team and institutionalise strong CRM, forecasting, proposal development, stewardship, reporting, and governance systems, enabling team members to independently manage a significant share of Muskaan Dreams' fundraising portfolio.

***Who We're Looking For***

We are looking for a leader who combines the relationship orientation of a partnership builder, the ambition of an entrepreneur, and the discipline of an institution builder. Someone who can sit across the table from a CEO, CSR Head, Foundation Director, philanthropist, or government leader and have a thoughtful conversation about not simply funding a programme, but what it will take to create lasting change at scale.

***Experience***

* 10–15+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, institutional fundraising, CSR, business development, consulting, enterprise sales, or corporate engagement.
* Demonstrated success in securing and managing high-value CSR and philanthropic partnerships.
* Experience engaging with CXOs, CSR Heads, Foundation Directors, Trustees, Family Offices, and other senior decision-makers.
* Proven experience leading high-performing teams and contributing to organisational growth.
* Experience in education, technology, development, or social impact will be an advantage.

***Capabilities***

* Exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong
  **storytelling, proposal writing, presentation, and negotiation**
  abilities.
* Ability to translate complex education and technology challenges into compelling partnership opportunities.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability.
* Ability to connect
  **mission, impact, evidence, and partner priorities**
  into a compelling narrative.
* Comfortable engaging with senior government officials, corporate leaders, philanthropists, educators, and ecosystem partners.
* Strong commercial acumen with a
  **partnership-first mindset**
  .
* Ability to build systems, processes, teams, and capabilities in a fast-growing organisation.

***Personal Attributes***

* **Deep commitment to educational equity and creating opportunities for every child.**
* Genuine respect for teachers and belief in their role as the most important agents of sustainable classroom change.
* Belief in working with and strengthening
  **government education systems to achieve scale and sustainability**
  .
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build from first principles.
* High integrity, humility, empathy, and professionalism.
* Resilient and persistent in navigating long and complex partnership cycles.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and working in a fast-growing, evolving organisation.
* Passionate about building institutions that create lasting social impact.
* Motivated by both
  **ambitious outcomes and the human stories behind those outcomes.**

***This Role May Not Be Right For You If***

* You are more comfortable managing existing grants than building new strategic relationships.
* You see fundraising primarily as a transaction or a numbers game.
* You prefer short-term funding conversations over building relationships that may take months or years to mature.
* You thrive only in highly structured environments and are uncomfortable building new systems.
* You are unwilling to travel extensively or spend time understanding our work with children, teachers, schools, and government partners.
* You are looking for a role focused only on fundraising targets rather than
  **institution building and national-level impact**
  .

***Build the Future with Us***

There are fundraising roles where success is measured by the size of the portfolio you build.

We believe this role can be about something bigger. It is about finding people and institutions who believe that a child's future should not be limited by the school they attend. It is about helping a teacher feel more confident using technology in her classroom.

It is about enabling a child who may never have imagined herself working with technology to become a problem-solver, critical thinker, and creator. It is about bringing together philanthropy, technology, government, and educators to solve problems that no organisation can solve alone.

And ultimately, it is about ensuring that as AI transforms the world, millions of children and teachers in India's government schools have the skills, confidence, and opportunity to be part of that future.

If you want to build more than a fundraising portfolio — if you want to help build an institution, a movement of partners, and a more equitable future for millions of children — we would love to build it with you.

***Important note:***

**Location: Mumbai/Delhi | Hybrid | Travel across India and internationally, as required**

**Reports to: Founder & CEO**

**Member of: Leadership Team**

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We’re looking for a highly creative, entrepreneurial, and organized Manager, Startup Marketing to expand MongoDB’s AI-native marketing strategy and strengthen our presence across the startup and AI/Digital-Native ecosystem in India. The role reports to the Head of India Marketing and will be part of the International Marketing organisation.
  
  
This role combines strategy and execution, with a focus on ecosystem engagement, community building, and scalable startup programming. You will help strengthen MongoDB’s presence among high-growth, venture-backed startups across India by building relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities. In partnership with the broader marketing team, you will design and execute programs, events, and partnerships that increase awareness, adoption, and long-term affinity for MongoDB. As a regional representative for MongoDB, you will support the planning and delivery of startup-focused initiatives such as hackathons, demo nights, founder dinners, and conference-adjacent activations. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, community, events, regional marketing, and content, and requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping ideas and driving hands-on execution.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position Expectations
  
  
Serve as one of the MongoDB representatives within the India startup ecosystem: Build and maintain strong relationships across the India startup community, including founders, operators, VCs, accelerators, and key ecosystem partnersDrive high-value startup acquisition: Develop and execute a targeted strategy to engage and convert high-potential startups in the region into the MongoDB for Startups programExpand MongoDB’s physical presence in India: In partnership with broader India marketing team, develop and execute a regional event strategy focused on high-impact founder programming, including VC-partnered events, demo days, hackathons, founder dinners, and other community activationsPartner with startups to highlight success: Work with internal teams and startup customers to surface and develop compelling stories showcasing startups building on MongoDB
  
  

* Own cross-functional alignment for the regional startup audience: Collaborate with teams such as MongoDB Ventures, Regional Marketing, Strategic Events, Sales, and Builder Relations to integrate startup-focused programming and ensure regional initiatives effectively reach founders and developers
* Measure impact and continuously optimize: Monitor and track success metrics for startup engagement, such as attendance quality, funded-founder participation, and program applications, and use insights to refine strategy and programming

The right candidate for this role will be:
  
  

* Have 4+ years of experience in marketing, community, ecosystem, or events roles focused on startups, developers, or technical founders
* Have experience leading projects or programs and collaborating across teams, with the ability to drive initiatives from strategy through execution
* Possess familiarity with the Indian startup ecosystem, ideally with relationships across founders, VCs, accelerators, and key founder communities
* Have experience working in or closely with startups or venture capital firms, with a solid understanding of how early-stage companies operate and grow
* Thrive in fast-moving environments, helping build and scale programs, partnerships, and community initiatives
* Be highly organized and execution-oriented, able to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders while delivering high-quality programs
* Be data-driven, able to track key engagement metrics and communicate the impact of regional initiatives
* Communicate clearly and confidently with founders, investors, and senior internal stakeholders
* Operate with a high degree of ownership and initiative, collaborating with a globally distributed team while maintaining an active presence within the India AI startup ecosystem

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

This leadership role is accountable for supporting and constructively challenging the Franchise organization to translate enterprise and OU commercial strategy into market-level, executable actions across Independent Bottlers. The role acts as a strategic integrator across Franchise, Integrated Operations (IB), Bottlers, and OU Leadership, ensuring end-to-end alignment, disciplined execution, and continuous learning to drive sustainable growth.

* Translate insights into clear, actionable commercial levers that can be executed at the bottler and frontline levels.
* Use a fact-based, hypothesis-driven approach to challenge assumptions and sharpen local commercial strategies.

* Strong analytical orientation combined with practical, execution-focused thinking.

* Demonstrated ability to tailor messaging to different audiences, balancing strategic depth with operational clarity.

**Growth Behavior**

* Growth Mindset: Demonstrates Curiosity. Welcomes failure as a learning opportunity.

title: Senior Manager, Strategy, India
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****About The Role:****
The Strategy group is focused on unlocking client business growth by developing audience, category, market and media insights. Key responsibilities include using audience and media tools to identify insights, translating them into media strategy and go-to-market recommendations, and working closely with planning and activation teams to develop responses to campaign and business briefs.
  
  
This will be a dedicated strategy role for one of WPP Media’s top global clients: Google. The role will independently lead strategy for an assigned business, while also contributing to larger brand, cross-business and portfolio-level strategic projects in partnership with the wider strategy team.
  
  
Reporting of the role:
  
  
This role reports to the Director/Sr. Director (Google)
  
  
****3 Best Things About The Job:****

* You would be working in one of the most exciting agencies and with a team of energetic and diverse individuals
* Opportunity to work across a wide spectrum of strategic assignments including audience strategy, integrated media planning, annual planning, category analysis and emerging media opportunities.
* Opportunity to work across traditional, digital and emerging media for one of the world's leading technology brands

Measures of success:
  
  
****In Three Months:****

* Demonstrate hands-on ability to use tools such as TGI, WPP internal platforms and GWI to analyse audiences, media behaviour, affinities and consumption patterns and translate the findings into actionable strategic implications.
* You would meet the key client on your independent brand and have a 1:1 rapport when it comes to strategic requirements
* Understand how a strategy moves from audience and business insight into planning to buying to partnership to activation and so on, and proactively identify where strategic inputs can improve the final media recommendation

****In Six Months:****

* Independently manage defined strategic assignments and develop strategic responses to client requirements and briefs, with senior strategy guidance where required.
* Contribute meaningfully to Brand AOPs, quarterly planning and campaign strategy by bringing together audience data, category dynamics, competitive activity and media behaviour
* Demonstrate the ability to create integrated channel recommendations across digital and offline media rather than independently planning channels in silos.
* Develop point-of-view documents and strategic narratives on relevant audience, category, platform and media trends
* Partner with various teams to ensure the strategic recommendation is reflected consistently in channel architecture, media roles and campaign execution.

****In Twelve Months:****

* Be visible as key POC of your team within the agency as well as with clients
* Drive annual, half-yearly and quarterly planning ensuring above benchmark scores for strategy on client feedback
* Drive award-winning strategy work through innovative approaches, new emerging platform test and learns, use of AI on business problems, etc
* Build reusable strategic frameworks and learnings that can improve planning across multiple campaigns and businesses rather than approaching every brief from scratch
* Contribute original thinking to broader Google strategy projects, including new audience opportunities, emerging platforms, evolving media behaviour and category shifts

****Skills And Experience****

* Hands on expertise in tools like TGI, GWI, Comscore. The candidate should be able to independently work with the tools, extract relevant data, identify meaningful patterns and translate the output into strategic audience and media recommendations
* Strong understanding of audience segmentation, media consumption analysis, affinity analysis, reach/penetration analysis and the ability to use these to build differentiated audience strategies
* Proven contribution to Brand AOPs, quarterly business reviews with senior client stakeholders; working on pitches will be a bonus
* Ability to work with multiple data sources and reconcile different signals into one clear strategic recommendation rather than presenting data points in isolation
* Ability to articulate the role of media platforms differently based on tasks – eg: launch brands vs challenger brands vs brands looking at premium audiences vs small town India
* Strong depth of understanding on media platforms and tactics – TV vs. CTV vs. Sharechat vs Instagram
* Strong communication, presentation and strategic storytelling skills; comfortable developing clear, insight-led presentations and presenting recommendations to internal teams and client stakeholders
* Ability to simplify complex research, media and audience information into a sharp strategic narrative with a clear ‘so what’ and recommended action
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to convert an ambiguous business or marketing challenge into a structured media strategy problem.

**Mandatories**

* 4-6 years relevant experience in a media agency with atleast one exposure on tech/smartphone category
* Hands-on working knowledge of TGI and GWI is mandatory. Candidate should have personally used these tools for audience/media analysis rather than only consumed outputs prepared by research or planning teams
* Ability to clearly articulate the role of both online and offline media channels and how they can work together within an integrated media strategy.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: Category Manager
description:
**Role**

Responsible for driving category growth and profitability through effective assortment planning, pricing, and promotional strategies. Manages Brand P&L, builds strong Brand/Vendor relationships, and leads Onboarding of New Brands. Oversees product lifecycle, ensures optimal inventory and merchandising execution, and collaborates cross-functionally with supply chain, marketing, finance, and operations. Uses data insights and market trends to deliver sales, margin, and customer satisfaction targets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Category, Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and execute category strategies aligned with overall business goals and customer needs.
* Conduct market analysis, trend spotting, and competitor benchmarking to identify opportunities.
* Define assortment strategies (breadth, depth, product mix) to maximize sales, profit, and customer experience.
* Collaborate with marketing and supply chain to align promotions and availability.

**Assortment & Product Lifecycle**

* Select and curate product ranges to meet customer demand and profitability targets.
* Oversee product lifecycle management – from new product introduction to end-of-life decisions.
* Ensure balance between core, seasonal, and innovative product lines.
* Monitor performance of SKUs and recommend rationalization where needed.

**Vendor & Supplier Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.
* Negotiate costs, terms, and service-level agreements to optimize margins.
* Work with suppliers to co-create promotions, exclusive launches, and marketing campaigns.
* Manage supplier performance, compliance, and quality standards.

**Pricing, Promotion & Profitability**

* Develop pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin, and brand positioning.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to design promotional plans (campaigns, discounts, bundles).
* Track category performance against sales, margin, and profitability targets.
* Analyze ROI of promotions and adjust strategies accordingly.

**Data Analytics & Insights**

* Use sales data, market research, and customer insights to guide decision-making.
* Monitor category KPIs (sell-through, GMROI, margin %, inventory turnover).
* Identify gaps in assortment, pricing, or supply chain and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular performance reports to senior management.
* Manage full brand/category P&L, ensuring delivery of sales, margin, and profitability targets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and brand partners.
* Lead brand onboarding process — including due diligence, contract negotiation, and commercial terms setup.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with supply chain on demand planning, inventory management, and replenishment.
* Work with store operations/e-commerce teams to ensure effective product placement and presentation.
* Collaborate with marketing on campaigns, merchandising guidelines, and category storytelling.
* Align with finance on forecasting, budgeting, and margin targets.

**Customer-Centric Merchandising**

* Continuously assess customer needs and feedback to refine assortment and merchandising approach.
* Implement visual merchandising guidelines to enhance in-store and online shopping experience.
* Drive innovation in category offerings to stay relevant and competitive.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong commercial & P&L management skills
* Expertise in category planning & assortment management
* Brand/vendor management & negotiation skills
* Analytical, data-driven decision-making
* Excellent collaboration & communication

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Min Graduate degree any related field, luxury retail courses.
* Min 5 years of experience in Luxury retail, fashion, or a related industry.

*Bring your passion. Master your craft.*

title: Head of Customer Expansion
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data the teams run on, the GTM execution that turns them into demand, closed deals, and retention, and the AI that makes the whole engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally, and we start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. Most companies buy these three pieces from three different vendors, then wonder why nothing connects. We run them as one.
  
  
**The problem we want to solve**
Our account managers and delivery leads own our client relationships today, and they do it well. But those relationships are built around the service the client hired us for, often CRM / RevOps work.
  
  
OneMetric now does more than CRM / RevOps. We also do go-to-market (GTM) strategy, consulting, web experiences, and AI transformation. Most clients don’t know that, because we haven’t built relationships with their senior leaders, like the CMO or CRO, or gone deep on their revenue problems.
  
  
We need someone to build on the trust our delivery teams have earned. Your job is to get closer to the C-suite, understand what’s holding back their revenue, and show where we can help beyond the original project.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
***Own the strategy***

* Set the plan for how we keep and grow our clients. Your goals are net revenue retention (NRR) in a few customers and client lifetime value (LTV), in many of them.
* Decide which accounts to grow, how, and in what order.

***Own the relationships***

* Be the main contact for senior leaders in our largest accounts.
* Act as a trusted advisor to their C-suite. Learn their revenue goals and problems, and talk in business terms, not tool terms.
* Work with account managers and delivery leads to map each account: who we know, who we don’t, and who matters.
* Build new relationships beyond our current champion, both up and across the client’s leadership team.
* Keep in regular touch with your accounts to learn what they need next and fix concerns early.

***Grow revenue***

* Work with Sales to sell more of what we do: GTM strategy, consulting, web experiences, and AI transformation.
* Add value in our customer marketing programs, like case studies and client stories, so strong relationships turn into visible proof.
* Spot churn risks early, and have a plan ready for each one.
* Build the process for taking new services to existing clients.

***Build & Lead the team***

* Build the team of customer success managers
* Lead, coach, and develop them.
* Teach account managers and delivery leads how to grow accounts the way you do.
* Plan who can step up next, so the team keeps growing.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10 to 12 years in a similar role at a services company.
* US-based clients with contracts worth $100K or more a year.
* Strong B2B marketing basics. You can hold a real conversation with a CMO or CRO about pipeline and growth.
* Proven experience growing inside an account, not just up. For example, you started with a head of martech and built the relationship until you were working with the CMO.
* Experience leading and coaching a team.
* Strongly preferred: experience at a digital, marketing, martech, RevOps, Salesforce, or HubSpot agency.

title: Senior Brand Account Manager
description:
**About the Role**

Faym is looking for a Senior Brand Account Manager to own and grow key client accounts across e-commerce platforms, D2C brands, and brand partnerships. You’ll lead client relationships, drive campaigns end-to-end, and turn insights into cross-sell and upsell wins.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the relationship: Be the primary point of contact for your accounts, from daily queries to strategic conversations with decision-makers.
* Drive growth: Spot cross-sell and upsell opportunities across influencer, affiliate, and creator solutions. Own revenue targets, renewals and expansion plans.
* Deliver campaigns: Turn briefs into plans and timelines, work with creator, operations and analytics teams, and resolve risks before they reach the client.
* Report with insight: Track GMV, revenue, and ROI, run regular business reviews, and back every recommendation with data.
* Lead and improve: Mentor junior team members, manage escalations, and strengthen our processes and client servicing standards.

**What You Bring**

* 3-5 years in account management, client servicing, customer success, or brand partnerships
* Hands-on experience in influencer, creator, or affiliate marketing (must have)
* Proven record of growing accounts through upsell and cross-sell
* Solid understanding of e-commerce, D2C or digital marketing
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Comfort with data, spreadsheets, and performance reporting
* Ownership mindset and the ability to juggle multiple accounts in a fast-paced setup

Preferred background: E-commerce, marketplace or quick-commerce; creator economy, affiliate commerce or digital marketing; agency or startup client servicing.

title: Vice President Business
description:
**About Faym**

Faym is India's fastest-growing content commerce platform — turning creators into a full-scale commerce engine. Every month, our 150,000+ creators drive over ₹ 250 Cr in GMV.

We've earned the trust of the biggest brands in India like Amazon, Myntra, Meesho, Flipkart, L'Oréal, Samsung and more, all turning influencer-led content into real, trackable sales through Faym.

We've hit product-market fit and we're scaling fast. Now we're looking for someone to lead the next chapter — owning the revenue engine that takes us from where we are to where we're headed next.

**The Opportunity**

This is an entrepreneurial sprint inside an already-successful ecosystem — the chance to own and build a ₹100Cr+ agency business as if it were your own, backed by Faym's scale, brand relationships, and momentum.

You'll sit at the helm of a significant part of Faym's business, with full ownership across the revenue lifecycle — new client acquisition, growth within existing accounts, and retention — leading a team of senior operators and answering directly for the business outcomes.

**What You'll Own**

* Full P&L accountability for the portfolio — revenue, profitability, and cost discipline, end to end.
* The new-business engine: building a strong pipeline and leading pitches and RFPs to win net-new, marquee clients.
* Growth within the existing book — identifying and converting cross-sell and upsell opportunities to expand wallet share and scope.
* Retention and renewals — deep, senior-level relationships that keep marquee clients for years, not quarters.
* CXO-level client relationships — strategic account planning, QBRs, and representing Faym in the room that matters.
* A team of senior leaders — hiring, mentoring, and building the next layer of leadership, including succession planning.
* Cross-functional delivery — partnering with creative, strategy, and media teams to ensure quality execution and resolve escalations.
* Revenue forecasting and pipeline visibility that leadership can steer the business by.
* Faym's market position — bringing competitive intelligence that shapes our positioning and service offerings.

**What We're Looking For**

* A track record of individually owning a ₹100Cr+ client or business portfolio.
* Proven ability to win new business and hit aggressive growth and retention targets.
* Experience leading and mentoring senior leaders — not just managing individual contributors.
* A background in brand solutions, media, marketing/advertising services, or a growth-stage business with real revenue ownership.

**﻿
Good to Have**

* An existing network of CMOs and senior marketing decision-makers.
* Experience scaling a business unit or vertical from the ground up.
* Fluency with AI/automation tools that sharpen business efficiency.

description:

title: Head of Wealth Management
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced Wealth Management business leader to build and scale a new Wealth Management vertical from the ground up. The role will have end-to-end responsibility for business development, client acquisition, AUM and revenue growth, product strategy, digital engagement, business operations and team building across Retail and HNI/UHNI segments. The candidate will work closely with the Senior Leadership Team to establish the business model, operating framework and growth roadmap. Candidates with prior experience in building or scaling a wealth, digital wealth or investment business in a technology-led environment will be preferred.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Build & Scale the Wealth Business**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the Wealth Management business, including business planning, growth strategy, operations, revenue, AUM and profitability.
* Work closely with Senior Leadership to define the business model, target segments, operating structure, growth roadmap and key business metrics.
* Establish the Wealth business, processes and operating framework from the ground up and create a scalable model for future growth.
* Identify new business opportunities and continuously strengthen the Wealth Management proposition based on market and client requirements.

**2. Client Acquisition & Business Development**

* Develop and execute strategies for new client acquisition, client activation, relationship development, cross-sell and retention across Retail, Affluent, HNI and UHNI segments.
* Build scalable acquisition channels through digital engagement, referrals, partnerships, existing customer ecosystems and relationship-led channels.
* Drive key business metrics including AUM, revenue, client acquisition, activation, product penetration and retention.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key HNI/UHNI clients and strategic business partners.

**3. Wealth Products & Investment Proposition**

* Develop and manage a comprehensive wealth proposition covering Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Insurance, Direct Equity/Stock Portfolios and other relevant investment products.
* Work with Product, Research, Technology, Operations and Compliance teams to create effective product funnels and investment journeys.
* Develop client-centric investment solutions aligned with different customer segments, investment objectives and risk profiles.
* Monitor market trends, competitive offerings and customer needs to continuously improve the wealth proposition.

**4. Digital, Technology & Automation**

* Drive a digital first Wealth Management experience, leveraging technology and automation across the client lifecycle.
* Work closely with Product and Technology teams on digital onboarding, KYC, investment journeys, CRM, portfolio tracking, client engagement, reporting and product discovery.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate processes, improve productivity and enhance client experience.
* Translate business requirements into technology/product solutions and ensure their effective adoption across the Wealth business.

**5. Team Building & Leadership**

* Build and scale the Wealth Management team in line with business growth, including Wealth/Relationship Managers, Investment/Product specialists and Business Operations resources.
* Define team structures, responsibilities, targets, KPIs and performance frameworks.
* Develop a high-performance, client-centric culture with strong focus on business ownership, service quality and compliance.
* Mentor and develop team members to build a sustainable Wealth Management organization.

**6. Business Operations, Governance & Compliance**

* Establish robust processes covering client onboarding, investment execution, portfolio servicing, reporting, client engagement and issue resolution.
* Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and other functions to establish a scalable and compliant operating environment.
* Develop business dashboards and MIS covering AUM, revenue, client acquisition, productivity, product penetration, retention and profitability.
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

**Job Requirements:**

* Master’s degree in finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline. CFA or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* 8–15 years of relevant experience in Wealth Management, Private Wealth, Digital Wealth, Stock Broking services businesses.
* Strong experience across Retail, Affluent, HNI and/or UHNI client segments.
* Demonstrated experience in building, launching, scaling or transforming a Wealth Management or investment-led business/vertical.
* Strong understanding of Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Insurance, Direct Equity/Stock Portfolios and other investment products.
* Proven track record in client acquisition, business development, AUM growth, revenue generation and relationship management.
* Strong hands-on exposure to digital wealth platforms, technology-enabled investment journeys, CRM, automation and digital client engagement.
* Experience in building teams, establishing processes and creating operating models from scratch will be highly preferred.
* Strong commercial orientation with the ability to translate business strategy into execution and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working closely with CXOs/Senior Leadership.
* Good understanding of applicable regulatory and compliance requirements within the wealth management/stock broking ecosystem.

KPIs:

* Establish and scale the Wealth Management vertical from the ground up.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of new Retail, Affluent, HNI and UHNI clients.
* Drive AUM, revenue, profitability and client retention Achieve and exceed individual and team sales targets to drive revenuegrowth.
* Increase client retention and satisfaction by providing high-quality investment advice and personalized service.
* Build a differentiated and scalable multi-product wealth proposition.
* Develop digital first and technology-enabled client journeys.
* Build and scale a high-performing Wealth Management team.
* Establish efficient, data-driven and compliant business operations and processes.
* Create a scalable Wealth business capable of sustained long-term growth.
* Maintain a high level of compliance with relevant regulations and internal policiesto ensure that clients' investments are protected.
* Stay up to date with the latest markettrends and news to identifyinvestment opportunities and risks.

**Why This Role?**

This is a build-and-scale opportunity for a senior Wealth Management professional who wants to create and shape a Wealth business rather than manage only an established client book. The role offers an opportunity to work closely with Senior Leadership and influence the business strategy, digital ecosystem, product proposition, team structure and growth journey of the Wealth Management vertical.

description:
**Job Title: Regional Head – International Affairs (Additional Director / Director)**

**Department: International Affairs**

title: SPL – EdTech and AI
description:
**About The Job SPL - EdTech And AI**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI will lead CSF's government adoption, implementation and policy portfolio across EdTech and emerging AI-enabled opportunities in school education.
  
  
The role will translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into government adoption and sustained implementation at scale by:
  
  

* Leading partnerships across 3–4 states, from opportunity identification and programme design through procurement, implementation and institutionalisation.
* Building relationships with senior government stakeholders and supporting states to use technology investments effectively.
* Strengthening implementation systems, including Technical Support Units (TSUs), Programme Management Units (PMUs) and other technical-assistance structures.
* Contributing to CSF's engagement with the Ministry of Education and other central institutions.
* Managing teams, budgets and complex programmes while converting evidence and field insights into policy and system-level action.

The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy, Portfolio Leadership & Growth
* Translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into priorities, workplans and measurable outcomes.
* Lead a portfolio of 3–4 state partnerships, ensuring clear strategies, milestones, ownership, risks and resource plans.
* Identify opportunities for evidence-backed EdTech and AI-enabled interventions and contribute to CSF's thinking on AI in education, digital infrastructure and technology-enabled governance.
* Government Adoption, Implementation & Institutionalisation
* Build demand for evidence-backed EdTech approaches and lead engagements from opportunity identification through scale-up and institutionalisation.
* Support quality-led procurement through programme specifications, technical requirements and implementation frameworks.
* Diagnose implementation bottlenecks using data and field insights, and strengthen government capabilities, ownership, monitoring and sustained usage.
* Government Engagement, Advocacy & Salience Building
* Build trusted relationships with senior state and central government stakeholders.
* Lead engagement with the Ministry of Education and other national institutions on EdTech, AI and digital education.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs, including concept notes, policy memos, guidelines, procurement language and implementation frameworks.
* Programme Management, Governance & Technical Assistance
* Lead programme design, partner selection, contracting, implementation planning, risk management, monitoring and course correction.
* Establish effective governance systems, including workplans, reviews, decision logs and deliverable tracking.
* Design or strengthen TSUs, PMUs and other technical-assistance structures, working with Evidence/M&E, Finance, Communications, State Reform and other CSF teams.
* Evidence, Knowledge & Thought Leadership
* Use evidence, implementation data and field learning to guide programme decisions and recommendations.
* Develop case studies, implementation playbooks, policy notes, frameworks and other knowledge outputs.
* Contribute to CSF's thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, AI in education, technology for governance and public investment in education technology.
* Team Leadership, Budgeting & Organisational Management
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own portfolio planning, budgeting, resource allocation, reporting and decision materials for leadership and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate across CSF teams and contribute to talent reviews, capability building and organisational priorities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent social sectors.
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customised to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words) through the CSF Careers Portal by
**20th September 2026**
.
  
  
Candidates should apply only if they can
**commit to at least a three-year journey**
to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy.

Job Category

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Even Better If...**

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: Marketing Manager – Growth & Performance Marketing

**Company:**
EaseToLearn

**Industry:**
EdTech / Online Education

**Location:**
Delhi

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹13 LPA gross annually, depending on experience and suitability

About EaseToLearn

EaseToLearn operates in the education technology sector, where digital accessibility, learner engagement and effective student acquisition are important to business growth.

We are looking for a results-oriented Marketing Manager who can strengthen our digital presence, attract prospective learners, generate qualified leads and convert marketing efforts into measurable business outcomes.

Role Overview

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning and executing marketing initiatives that support EaseToLearn's business objectives. The role will focus on performance marketing, lead generation, learner acquisition, campaign optimisation and brand development.

The ideal candidate should combine hands-on digital marketing expertise with analytical thinking, an understanding of the education market and the ability to translate marketing data into actionable growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities1. Growth Strategy and Student Acquisition

* Develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with EaseToLearn's business and growth objectives.
* Identify target learner segments and develop campaigns to reach prospective students.
* Build and optimise lead-generation and learner-acquisition strategies.
* Work with relevant teams to improve lead quality and conversion into enrolments or other defined business outcomes.

2. Performance and Digital Marketing

* Plan, execute and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and other relevant digital channels.
* Monitor campaign performance, cost per lead (CPL), customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
* Allocate marketing budgets effectively and identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency.
* Conduct A/B testing of advertisements, landing pages, creatives and campaign messaging.

3. Content, SEO and Brand Development

* Coordinate SEO, content marketing, email marketing and social media initiatives.
* Ensure marketing communications are relevant to target learners and aligned with the company's brand positioning.
* Collaborate with content and design teams to develop effective campaign creatives, landing pages and promotional materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic visibility, audience engagement and brand awareness.

4. Marketing Analytics and Reporting

* Track and analyse campaign performance using Google Analytics and relevant advertising platforms.
* Prepare regular marketing reports covering expenditure, lead generation, conversions and campaign effectiveness.
* Use data to identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and audience research to identify growth opportunities.

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Coordinate with sales, product, content and other relevant teams to align marketing activities with business priorities.
* Establish feedback loops to understand lead quality, learner requirements and conversion challenges.
* Manage multiple marketing initiatives and ensure timely execution.
* Present marketing performance, insights and recommendations to management.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field. An MBA in Marketing will be preferred.
* 4–5 years of relevant marketing experience, with prior experience in EdTech, e-learning, online education or test preparation.
* Demonstrated experience in performance marketing, digital campaigns and lead generation.
* Hands-on proficiency in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and Google Analytics.
* Understanding of marketing funnels, conversion optimisation, CPL, CAC and ROAS.
* Strong analytical, communication, project management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage budgets, coordinate with cross-functional teams and deliver measurable results.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience marketing education products, online learning platforms or test-preparation services.
* A track record of generating qualified leads and improving campaign performance.
* Ability to connect marketing activities with business outcomes rather than focusing solely on reach and engagement.
* A data-driven approach to campaign planning, experimentation and optimisation.
* Willingness to take ownership of marketing execution and continuously improve results.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be evaluated through agreed objectives, which may include:

* Qualified leads generated.
* Cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.
* Lead-to-enrolment conversion rate, where applicable.
* Return on advertising spend and marketing budget utilisation.
* Campaign execution, reporting quality and continuous optimisation.
* Contribution to brand visibility and overall business growth.

Specific targets will be established in line with EaseToLearn's business goals, marketing budget and available resources.

Compensation and Employment

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹13 LPA gross annual salary, depending on experience and suitability.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time.

Application Process

Interested candidates should complete the application form and submit their updated CV.

**Application form:**
https://tally.so/r/J9Nv6z

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their relevant EdTech marketing experience, campaigns managed, budgets handled and measurable business results.

***Role***

to own our performance marketing and lead generation strategy. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Meta Ads, a proven track record in the education industry, and the ability to turn advertising campaigns into qualified student enquiries and admissions conversions.
