title: Brand Communication & Marketing
description:
**Brand Communication & Marketing**

**About Novella**

**Novella is on a mission to become one of the world's most exclusive luxury brands in the wedding industry.**

**We believe brands are not built through advertising alone. They are built through consistency, thoughtful communication and experiences that people remember.**

**We are looking for someone who shares that belief and wants to help shape how Novella is seen, experienced and remembered.**

**About the Role**

**As the Brand Communication & Marketing**
professional, you will work closely with the Founder to strengthen Novella's brand presence across every touchpoint.

This role goes beyond managing social media or creating campaigns. It is about ensuring every piece of communication reflects the philosophy, positioning and standards of the brand.

You will be involved in branding, marketing, communication, content strategy, campaigns, partnerships and client engagement while working across multiple projects and wearing different hats.

**Key Responsibilities**

**• Develop and maintain Novella's brand communication across digital and offline platforms.**

**• Plan and execute marketing campaigns that strengthen brand awareness and generate qualified enquiries.**

**• Create presentations, proposals and brand communication material.**

**• Write thoughtful copy for websites, social media, advertisements and marketing campaigns.**

**• Coordinate with photographers, filmmakers, designers and editors to ensure consistency in communication.**

**• Assist in planning content calendars and campaign launches.**

**• Support Meta Ads, marketing initiatives and performance analysis.**

**• Build relationships with venues, planners, luxury partners and industry associates.**

**• Represent Novella during client meetings, networking events and strategic collaborations.**

**• Work directly with the Founder on new ideas, launches and brand initiatives.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

**We care more about your mindset than your designation.**

**You will probably enjoy this role if you are naturally curious, creative and passionate about branding.**

**You enjoy writing as much as you enjoy presenting ideas.**

**You understand that communication is not just about words but about perception.**

**You are comfortable taking ownership, wearing multiple hats and solving problems without waiting for instructions.**

**Requirements**

**• 2–5 years of experience in Brand Communication, Marketing, Branding or Content.**

**• Exceptional spoken and written English.**

**• Excellent presentation and communication skills.**

**• Strong understanding of branding, storytelling and marketing.**

**• Hands-on experience with Canva and Google Workspace.**

**• Basic understanding of Meta Ads and digital marketing.**

**• Comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment.**

**• Willing to travel whenever required.**

**• Comfortable working 6 days a week with flexible working hours.**

**Who Should Not Apply**

**This role is not for someone looking for a routine corporate job or clearly defined responsibilities.**

* **If you prefer maintaining existing systems over building new ones, this opportunity is probably not the right fit.**

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About UniVisory

UniVisory is a premium global education advisory working with ambitious students and families aspiring to Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Oxbridge and other leading universities worldwide.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Specialist with one primary mandate:

Help UniVisory consistently reach the right students and parents — through Meta Ads and organic social media — and convert that attention into high-quality leads and conversations.

This is not a social-media posting role. We are looking for someone who understands audiences, messaging, creatives, targeting and performance — and can execute.

What You'll Own

1. Meta Ads & Audience Targeting

Own and execute Meta campaigns across Instagram and Facebook

Identify and continuously refine the right target audiences for different UniVisory programs

Build and test audience segments across geography, demographics, interests, behaviours and intent

Develop campaign hypotheses and systematically test audience × message × creative combinations

Optimize campaigns for lead quality, not simply low CPL

Build retargeting and lookalike strategies from high-quality lead and customer data

Identify why campaigns are attracting the wrong audience and fix them quickly

2. Organic Audience Building

Build UniVisory's organic presence across Instagram and LinkedIn

Identify the questions, concerns and aspirations that matter most to ambitious students and parents

Create content themes designed to reach and engage those audiences

Turn UniVisory's student outcomes, insights, testimonials, research and admissions expertise into high-value content

Experiment with formats, hooks, topics and distribution strategies to increase relevant reach

Build organic authority rather than simply increasing posting frequency

3. Messaging & Creative Testing

Understand different student and parent segments and what matters to each

Translate those insights into strong campaign angles, hooks and creative briefs

Work with designers/content teams to develop high-performing creatives

Continuously test messaging, offers, formats and calls-to-action

Use campaign and engagement data to determine what resonates with the right audience

4. Lead Quality & Growth Analytics

Track the complete journey from campaign → lead → qualified lead → strategy session/demo/application → enrolment

Work closely with the sales team to understand which campaigns are producing genuinely strong prospects

Identify patterns in high-quality versus low-quality leads

Recommend what to scale, change or stop

Maintain simple dashboards around audience, campaign, creative and lead-quality performance

Who We're Looking For

3–5 years of hands-on digital/growth marketing experience

Strong practical experience running Meta Ads

Experience with audience targeting, lead-generation campaigns and campaign optimization

Strong understanding of Instagram and organic social media growth

Ability to think about who we are trying to reach before deciding what to post or advertise

Strong creative and content judgment

Comfortable working with campaign and funnel data

Able to move quickly from hypothesis → campaign → data → learning → next experiment

Comfortable working directly with the Founder

High ownership and strong execution orientation

Willing to work from our Gurugram office

Experience in education, study abroad, premium services or another high-consideration B2C category is preferred but not mandatory.

What Success Looks Like

We will not judge this role primarily by followers, impressions or cheap leads.

Success means:

Are we consistently reaching the right students and parents?

Are the right people engaging with our content?

Are Meta campaigns producing increasingly high-quality leads?

Are those leads progressing to meaningful conversations, strategy sessions, demos or applications?

Are we learning every week which audiences, messages and creatives work best?

The goal is to build a repeatable engine:

Right Audience → Right Message → Relevant Content/Creative → Qualified Lead → Conversion

Why UniVisory

You'll work directly with the Founder and have significant ownership over how UniVisory reaches and engages its next generation of students and families.

You'll have the freedom to experiment, test ideas quickly and use real performance data to shape our growth strategy.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just ask:

"What should we post?"

but thinks:

"Who exactly are we trying to reach, what matters to them, and how do we get them to pay attention?"

title: Associate Manager Social Media
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Role: Social Media & Content Marketing**

About TBO

TBO is a global platform that aims to simplify all buying and selling travel needs of travel partners across the world. The proprietary technology platform aims to simplify the demands of the complex world of global travel by seamlessly connecting the highly distributed travel buyers and travel suppliers at scale.

The TBO journey began in 2006 with a simple goal – to address the evolving needs of travel buyers and suppliers, and what started off as a single product air ticketing company, has today become the leading B2A (Business to Agents) travel portal across the Americas, UK & Europe, Africa, Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific.

Today, TBO’s product range from air, hotels, rail, holiday packages, car rentals, transfers, sightseeing, cruise, and cargo. Apart from these products, our proprietary platform relies heavily on AI/ML to offer unique listings and products, meeting specific requirements put forth by customers, thus increasing conversions.

TBO’s approach has always been technology-first, and we continue to invest on new innovations and new offerings to make travel easy and simple. TBO’s travel APIs are serving large travel ecosystems across the world while the modular architecture of the platform enables new travel products while expanding across new geographies.

**Why TBO:**

• You will influence & contribute to “Building World Largest Technology Led Travel Distribution Network” for a $ 9 Trillion global travel business market.

• We are the emerging leaders in technology led end-to-end travel management, in the B2B space.

• Physical Presence in 47 countries with business in 110 countries.

• We are reputed for our-long lasting trusted relationships. We stand by our eco system of suppliers and buyers to service the end customer.

• An open & informal start-up environment which cares.

**What TBO offers to a Life Traveler in You:**

• Enhance Your Leadership Acumen. Join the journey to create global scale and ‘World Best’.

• Challenge Yourself to do something path breaking. Be Empowered. The only thing to stop you will be your imagination.

• Post pandemic: travel space is likely to see significant growth. Witness and shape this space. It will be one exciting journey.

• As a fastest growing B2B platform our priority is purpose-building scalable systems.

• Adopting industry leading technologies to support best-in-class business capabilities for high performing and scalable solutions.

• Fast response to the evolving regulatory environment and helping to meet the firm's regulatory commitments by addressing internal and external commitments.

Key Expectations

**1. Strategic Planning**

* Design short- and long-term content strategies across LinkedIn (Global) and Meta platforms, primarily Facebook and Instagram (Regional), aligned with enterprise-level and regional business goals, brand voice, and target audiences.
* Develop content around major travel and cultural moments in key markets, marketing campaigns, industry events, PR, trends, partnerships, and other relevant initiatives.
* Manage people- and values-focused content for the
  *Life at TBO*
  LinkedIn page to strengthen the employer brand and attract top talent globally.

**2. Content Creation & Curation**

* Develop compelling copy, prepare creative briefs, and manage content approvals in close collaboration with the Graphic Design team and relevant stakeholders.
* Oversee the creation of short-form videos, carousels, and other platform-specific formats in multiple languages.

**3. Community Management**

* Respond to comments, direct messages, and customer service inquiries across social media platforms.
* Escalate genuine customer issues to the appropriate teams and identify and report potential business leads to the relevant stakeholders.

**4. Scheduling & Publishing**

* Build and maintain content calendars, ensuring consistent and timely publishing across TBO and Jumbonline.
* Reshare relevant TBO Academy content with appropriate captions, tags, and mentions of relevant people and businesses.

**5. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management**

* Plan, budget, execute, and optimize targeted social media advertising campaigns, primarily on Meta, based on regional business objectives such as top-of-funnel awareness and new customer acquisition.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize activities to reduce Cost per Acquisition (CPA) and Cost per Result (CPR).
* Leverage relevant travel trade publications on a case-by-case basis to support regional marketing objectives.

**6. Analytics & Reporting**

* Track organic social media KPIs, including reach, engagement rates, and community growth, across relevant platforms.
* Benchmark performance against key competitors and prepare comprehensive organic social media performance reports twice a year.
* Measure paid campaign performance and report outcomes against defined objectives.

**7. Brand Custodianship**

description:
**Role and Responsibilities:**
We are looking for someone to be a part of

HealthKart – a leading online nutrition brand in India. This role will be a part of the brand team at HealthKart and will be reporting directly to the Brand Head. This role will have a team reporting to them and will need to have a balance of both left brain & right brain attributes. The person will be responsible for driving topline growth through new product development, GTM campaigns, category management & 0-1 scale up. The breakdown of the responsibilities is given below:

**P&L ownership**
:

* Own the brand’s P&L and drive revenue growth and profitability in line with the annual business plan.
* Monitor key business metrics and implement strategies to achieve topline and bottom-line targets.

**New Product Development:**

* Whitespace mapping: Identify new whitespaces to launch new products in collaboration with the R&D team. This includes deep diving into the science behind the product, understanding the formulation, working on sensory development crafting key USPs & packaging of the product.
* Exploring extensions for each product line
* Owning Launch pricing & GM% of the product
* Working closely with channel teams to launch trial packs, new packaging sizes, etc.

**Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy:**

* Plan & execute the GTM strategy for new product launched within the portfolio
* GTM includes determining pricing & channel SKU sizes, create awareness through influencer amplification & work on performance marketing narratives that resonate with the TG and drive higher ROIs
* Provide product briefs to the marketing team & collaborate with them to launch products across digital channels
* Own & execute product photoshoots for every new product launch within the portfolio
* Ideate on possible tie-ups partnerships to amplify the new product launch
* Work on influencer performance marketing creatives with the team to scale the product on D2C

**Category Management (D2C + Ecom/QCom):**

* Create listing images across D2C, Ecom & QCom platforms
* Collaborate with the supply chain teams to manage inventory levels for each SKU
* Work closely with the Ecom channel teams to provide static banners & videos to drive BTL ROIs
* Drive new combo creation & manage product lifecycle on marketplaces

**Create & monitor daily reports:**

* Monitor portfolio performance, identify growth opportunities, and track competitor activities.
* Develop and maintain daily business performance dashboards in collaboration with the analytics team.
* Analyse key business metrics to identify trends, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Track category performance and recommend strategies to improve revenue, profitability, and overall business growth.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Grest is one of India's leading full-stack recommerce brands, making premium renewed Apple devices more accessible through quality, technology and trust. With a growing D2C business and expanding offline retail presence, we're building a strong omnichannel brand in India's recommerce market.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to lead Grest's marketing function, drive brand growth and build a strong connection with consumers. This role requires someone who understands premium consumer brands, consumer psychology and the business of scaling a D2C brand.

***Roles and Responsibilities:***

**1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth**

* Own the overall marketing strategy, aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.
* Develop marketing plans, budgets, campaign calendars and growth roadmaps.
* Identify growth opportunities across customer segments, geographies and channels.
* Align marketing priorities with business performance, profitability and expansion goals.

**2. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Own Grest's brand positioning, value proposition, messaging and overall consumer perception.
* Build brand aspiration, trust and consideration in the premium renewed electronics category.
* Develop integrated campaigns that strengthen brand recall and differentiate Grest in the market.
* Ensure consistency in brand communication across digital platforms, the website and retail stores.

**3. Consumer Psychology & Insights**

* Develop a deep understanding of consumer behaviour, purchase motivations, aspirations and barriers.
* Translate consumer insights into effective positioning, messaging and campaign strategies.
* Understand what drives trust and purchase decisions when consumers consider premium, high-value products.
* Use customer feedback, market research and behavioural data to identify opportunities for growth.

**4. Growth & Revenue Management**

* Own marketing's contribution to revenue, customer acquisition and overall business growth.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition efficiency, conversion rates, average order value and retention.
* Work with performance, e-commerce and CRM teams to develop and execute growth strategies.
* Evaluate channel performance and allocate budgets based on business impact and profitability.

**5. Integrated Campaigns & Creative Direction**

* Lead the development of brand campaigns, product campaigns, seasonal promotions and major marketing initiatives.
* Set campaign objectives, briefs, target audiences, messaging and success metrics.
* Provide strategic direction to creative, content, performance and social media teams.
* Ensure campaigns balance brand building, consumer engagement and sales outcomes.

**6. Omnichannel & Offline Marketing**

* Develop marketing strategies that connect Grest's D2C website with its growing offline retail presence.
* Plan store launch campaigns, hyperlocal marketing, activations, events and strategic partnerships.
* Drive brand awareness, store footfall and sales through integrated online and offline initiatives.
* Measure the impact of offline marketing and identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives.

**7. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Management**

* Lead and coordinate specialist teams across performance marketing, SEO, content, creative, social media, CRM and other marketing functions.
* Set clear objectives, KPIs, priorities and accountability for each team.
* Translate business goals into actionable plans and ensure teams work towards common outcomes.
* Review performance, provide strategic direction and remove execution bottlenecks.
* Manage agencies, external partners and marketing budgets where required.
* Build a culture of ownership, experimentation, collaboration and performance.

**8. Marketing Analytics & Reporting**

* Own the overall marketing dashboard and performance review process.
* Track revenue contribution, marketing spend, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, customer retention and brand performance.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimisation.
* Use data and consumer insights to make informed decisions on budgets, channels and marketing priorities.
* Present marketing performance, key learnings and growth opportunities to the leadership team.

***What we're looking for :***

* **Experience scaling a D2C brand:**
   A strong understanding of how consumer businesses grow, acquire customers and build sustainable revenue.
* **Understanding of premium brands:**
   The ability to build aspiration, communicate value and establish trust beyond discount-led marketing.
* **Strong grasp of consumer psychology:**
   An understanding of what motivates consumers, shapes perceptions and influences purchase decisions.
* **Strategic marketing mindset:**
   The ability to connect brand positioning, customer acquisition and retention with larger business goals.
* **Team leadership experience:**
   The ability to lead specialist teams, set direction and drive accountability without being involved in every executional detail.
* **Commercial acumen:**
   Comfort with marketing budgets, revenue targets, acquisition costs, conversion metrics and profitability.
* **Creative and analytical thinking:**
   The ability to combine compelling brand narratives with data-backed decision-making.
* **Strong ownership:**
   The ability to independently lead the marketing function, prioritise effectively and work closely with business leadership.

***What success looks like :***

* Stronger brand positioning, aspiration and consumer trust.
* Consistent, profitable D2C growth and improved marketing efficiency.
* Clear strategic direction and alignment across all marketing teams.
* Effective integration of digital marketing and offline retail growth.
* A high-performing marketing function with measurable goals and accountability.



**To apply:**
 Share your resume along with a brief note on a D2C brand you have helped scale, your contribution and the business impact you created at 
**[hr@grest.in]**
.

title: Sales and Marketing Lead
description:
Sales and Marketing Lead

**Background:**

Enggrob and Singh (E&S) is an international consultancy with offices in Denmark, India and Sri Lanka. It has four business areas viz, Customised Water Risk Assessment & Management (CW-RAM), Development Cooperation, Smart Technologies and Urban Development. The firm mainly serves the South Asian market, with India being the most prominent one.

The ‘CW-RAM’ business aims to make water dependent industries, resilient against the future supply of suitable quality and quantity of water including threats from droughts and floods. As part of the ‘Smart Technologies’ business, E&S has partnered with a leading Danish robotics company to market its products and generate leads in India.

E&S is looking for a suitable Sales and Marketing Lead to join our team and contribute to grow the business.

**The Role:**

The Sales and Marketing Lead will assist the firm’s management to generate leads and drive top-line revenue growth, expand market share, and position our CW-RAM and Smart Technologies portfolio across key Indian industrial verticals. This hybrid role combines strategic B2B marketing, channel and partner development, and high-value technical solution selling.

The primary task will be to acquire new customers by cultivating, developing, and closing sales opportunities within specific segments of the Indian market. You will be mainly responsible for market analysis and qualified lead generation in the designated market area and industry segments. These leads will be passed onto the technical team for proposal preparation, negotiation and successful closing.

You will work closely with the designated partner to plan sales activities, follow up on leads, and actively develop the market to secure potential new customers.

**Key Tasks & Responsibilities**

**Sales & Business Development**

Drive annual sales targets for the CW-RAM and Smart Technologies businesses.

Partner directly with plant heads, chief sustainability officers (CSOs), project consultants, system integrators and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contractors to pitch complex, high-value tech solutions.

-      
Build, nurture, and track a robust sales pipeline from lead generation to negotiation, and contract closure using excel.

-      
Proactively build sales channels for the South Asian market and establish a clear, visible strategy—including identifying new markets and business opportunities, as well as building and maintaining relationships with customers, stakeholders, and partners in these areas.

Formulate and execute localized marketing campaigns,


product positioning, and value propositions tailored to India’s evolving needs including

identifying and engaging customers, proposing relevant campaigns, and participating in trade fairs.

-      
Oversee targeted B2B lead generation, technical webinars, whitepapers, case studies, and participation in premier Indian industrial and water expos.

-      
Conduct continuous market research on competitor pricing, automation tech adoption, and emerging industrial water risks across India.

**General**

-      
Stay continuously updated on new trends in the market and identify companies interested in our solutions.

-      
Any other task as required by the management.

**Qualifications and Experience**

-      
Ideally, a degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or MBA in Marketing or General Management is preferred.

-      
Between 6 – 10 years of proven B2B sales and marketing experience in technical solution (preferably within environmental and/ or industrial solutions)

-      
Proficiency in English

**Key Qualities (very important)**

We believe that the following personal qualities are essential to succeed in this role:

Self-driven, go-getter and result-oriented with strong commercial acumen

-      
Possesses a solid network in the industrial sector

Responsible, trustworthy and loyal

Structured, persistent, innovative and having a sales mindset

Sense of urgency

Must be able to work well both independently and in teams

-      

Good consulting & communication skills

Ability to multi-task

**Employment Type**

Full-Time

-      
Competitive base salary + performance-linked incentive/commission structure.

title: Performance Marketing Account Executive
description:
Company:       The Ad Hive

Location:          Udyog Vihar, Gurugram, Haryana

Work-Model:  Hybrid - 4 days in office (mandatory) + 1 day work from home

Type:                Full-time

Experience:    2–4 years, hands-on

Joining:            Immediate joiners preferred (notice period up to 15 days)

**About us**

The Ad Hive is a boutique performance marketing agency. We run Meta and Google Ads for D2C fashion and lifestyle brands in India and the US.

We keep our client list small on purpose, so every account gets real attention. Our founder brings 20+ years in e-commerce and paid media.

**The Role**

You will run the day-to-day work on our client meta, google and other paid media ad accounts and handle routine client communication. The founder owns strategy, automation and final sign-off.

Your job is to make sure the plan gets done: on time, without errors, and with clients kept informed.

**What you'll do**

**Campaign execution**

* Build, launch and update Meta and Google campaigns (PMax, Shopping, Search, Demand Gen, Advantage+) as per the agreed plan.
* Run daily account checks: spend pacing, errors, disapprovals, creative fatigue, budget changes.
* Fix product feed issues in Google Merchant Center and the Meta catalogue.
* Brief and produce ad creative variations using AI tools (Higgsfield).

**Client communication**

* Be the first point of contact for routine client requests on WhatsApp and email: creative swaps, offer updates, small fixes, status updates.
* Reply to clients the same working day.
* Escalate anything about strategy, budgets, results or complaints to the founder the same day.

**Reporting and process**

* Prepare weekly and monthly report data. Match ad-platform sales against Shopify.
* Log every task and campaign change in ClickUp.
* Use Claude and our in-house AI workflows daily to speed up audits, reports and builds.

**Must-have**

* 2–4 years of hands-on work in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. You did the work yourself, not just the reporting.
* Experience with D2C or e-commerce brands. Fashion or apparel is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of Shopify and Google Merchant Center.
* You can explain why a campaign won or failed, using numbers (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate).
* Clear, polite written English. Hindi helps for Indian clients.
* Strong in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable with AI tools, and quick to learn new ones.

**Good to have**

* Festive or sale-season campaign experience (Diwali, Black Friday).
* Exposure to US-market campaigns.
* Basic GA4, Google Tag Manager, or Meta pixel and Conversions API knowledge.

**This role is not for you if**

* Your experience is mostly boosting posts, or lead-gen only.
* You prefer making strategy decks over hands-on execution.
* You need step-by-step instructions for routine work.
* You can't commit to 4 days a week in the office.

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary plus a performance bonus, based on experience.
* Hybrid work: 4 days in office, 1 day from home.
* Mon–Fri working week.
* Direct learning from a founder with 20+ years in e-commerce and paid media.
* Exposure to Indian and international D2C brands.
* A modern, AI-first workflow with less manual grunt work.
* Paid certifications and learning support.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Role Overview
 
 As a
 **Social Media Strategist** 
 , you will be responsible for developing social media strategies and content directions for brands and campaigns.
 



 You will work closely with the Strategy, Creative, Influencer Marketing, Planning, and Revenue teams to develop ideas that are
 **platform\-native, culturally relevant, creator\-friendly, and aligned with brand objectives** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who spends a lot of time understanding social media, follows emerging trends closely, knows why certain content works, and can translate those observations into actionable strategies.
 



 This role requires a combination of
 **strategic thinking, cultural understanding, content expertise, platform knowledge, and strong execution skills** 
 .
 



  





  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Social Media Strategy
 * Develop comprehensive social media strategies based on brand objectives, target audiences, category dynamics, and platform behaviour.
* Translate business and communication objectives into clear social media strategies.
* Define the role of different social platforms within a campaign or brand ecosystem.
* Develop content pillars, themes, formats, and communication territories.
* Build social strategies for launches, campaigns, always\-on communication, and influencer\-led initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to make brand communication more relevant to current social conversations and cultural moments.
* Develop platform\-specific approaches rather than applying the same content strategy across all platforms.



  





  




 2\. Content Strategy \& Ideation
 * Develop content ideas that are relevant, engaging, and aligned with the brand's positioning.
* Create content frameworks and creative territories for social platforms.
* Develop campaign concepts that can be translated into creator\-led and social\-first content.
* Work closely with creative teams to convert strategic thinking into strong content ideas.
* Develop hooks, content angles, storytelling approaches, and formats for different platforms.
* Identify opportunities for short\-form video, reels, carousels, stories, memes, creator content, and other emerging formats.
* Ensure ideas are both strategically relevant and realistically executable.



  





  




 3\. Social \& Cultural Trends
 * Stay highly updated on Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Track emerging formats, memes, trends, creators, communities, conversations, and cultural moments.
* Identify trends that can be meaningfully connected to brands.
* Distinguish between short\-lived trends and trends with genuine strategic relevance.
* Build regular trend reports or trend\-led recommendations for internal and client teams.
* Identify opportunities for brands to participate in relevant conversations without appearing forced or disconnected.
* Maintain a strong understanding of changing social\-media behaviour and audience preferences.



  





  




 4\. Influencer \& Creator Strategy
 * Develop influencer strategies aligned with the overall social media and communication strategy.
* Recommend creator profiles based on audience, content style, credibility, relevance, and campaign objectives.
* Define the role creators should play within a campaign.
* Develop creator content directions, storytelling frameworks, and content territories.
* Identify opportunities for creators to create content that feels native to their communities rather than overly branded.
* Collaborate with Planning and Talent Management teams to identify relevant creators.
* Provide clear strategic direction to creators while allowing sufficient creative freedom.
* Evaluate creator content from a strategic and brand perspective.



  





  




 5\. Campaign Strategy
 * Develop strategic frameworks for influencer and social media campaigns.
* Understand the campaign brief and identify the core communication challenge.
* Define the campaign thought, communication territory, audience insight, and content approach.
* Develop campaign narratives that can be executed across multiple creators and platforms.
* Build campaign journeys from awareness to engagement and action where relevant.
* Develop strategic presentations and campaign proposals for internal and client\-facing discussions.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute strategic and creative thinking.
* Ensure campaign ideas are differentiated, relevant, and aligned with the brand.



  





  




 6\. Social Listening \& Audience Insights
 * Monitor social conversations and audience behaviour around relevant categories and brands.
* Identify audience pain points, interests, behaviours, and content preferences.
* Conduct social listening and competitor analysis.
* Identify gaps and opportunities in the brand's current social presence.
* Track competitor campaigns, creator partnerships, content formats, and communication approaches.
* Convert observations into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Use social and audience insights to continuously improve content strategy.

**Manager, CRM \& Marketing Technology** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 10–12 years of relevant experience preferred
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm known for entrepreneurial, action\-oriented and results\-focused professionals. The firm takes a hands\-on approach to solving client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. Its culture values independent thinkers and doers who create meaningful client and industry impact. A\&M operates with a commitment to Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, accelerate delivery, maintain competitive pricing and enable automation through digital and analytics capabilities. The Gurgaon\-based center partners with global business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. Unlike traditional back\-office models, it contributes to end\-to\-end case delivery and thought leadership across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources and Financial Services. The GCC is growing rapidly and already has more than 1,000 members.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role owns the CRM and Marketing Technologies strategy and roadmap for A\&M’s growing India Global Capability Center. Reporting to the CRM and Marketing Technologies Director, you will translate marketing priorities into scalable technology capabilities, operating models and delivery plans. The position is accountable for orchestrating projects and initiatives across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and broader MarTech ecosystems. Success requires strong MarTech/CRM expertise, marketing business and technology transformation experience, and proven project, change and stakeholder management. You will connect Marketing, IT, data teams and business units to improve integration, data quality, channel execution and decision\-making. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, adopted by users and aligned with compliance expectations. You will also act as a trusted subject matter expert, shaping investment choices and recommending innovations that improve marketing effectiveness, operational efficiency and measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the CRM and MarTech strategy and roadmap, converting marketing objectives into sequenced initiatives, investment priorities and capabilities that improve campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency and stakeholder outcomes.
* Lead delivery of CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and channel technology projects through structured governance, milestones, risk controls and benefits tracking that keep transformation initiatives on schedule.
* Translate business requirements into technical capabilities, solution designs and prioritized backlogs, ensuring platforms and processes support scalable, compliant and measurable multi\-channel marketing execution.
* Partner with data teams to improve infrastructure, data quality and integration across databases and MarTech components, enabling reliable customer insights, segmentation, activation and reporting.
* Establish and improve marketing operating models, processes and organization structures through technology\-enabled transformation, clarifying ownership and increasing consistency across business units and geographies.
* Analyze marketing performance data and convert findings into improvement initiatives, recommendations and executive\-ready insights that strengthen strategy, resource allocation and business decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across Marketing, IT, data teams, business units and vendors, resolving dependencies and building credibility through clear communication, negotiation and outcome\-focused governance.
* Monitor MarTech trends, compliance requirements and vendor capabilities, recommending innovations and managing integrations that improve effectiveness while addressing customer\-data obligations such as GDPR and CCPA.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong expertise across CRM, marketing automation, MarTech platforms, channels, AI and analytics tools, with the ability to connect business requirements to practical technical functionality and integrated solutions.
* Demonstrated marketing business and technology transformation experience, including operating\-model design, process improvement, product or project delivery and adoption of new capabilities across matrixed organizations.
* Advanced project, change and stakeholder management skills, supported by analytical thinking, vendor negotiation, troubleshooting, executive communication and customer\-data compliance awareness.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* PMP, CPM or comparable project and product management certification is an advantage, particularly where it demonstrates disciplined delivery, governance and benefits realization across complex transformation programs.
* Experience working with global marketing organizations, distributed stakeholders and cross\-regional CRM initiatives is beneficial, especially within consulting, professional services or other matrixed environments.
* Exposure to emerging MarTech, AI, analytics and automation trends is valuable when paired with sound judgment about adoption, integration effort, governance and measurable business impact.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 10–12 years of relevant experience managing marketing technology platforms and systems, with total professional experience typically ranging from 10 to 15 years. Your background demonstrates strong MarTech and CRM expertise, combined with marketing business and technology transformation experience. You have led complex projects or products from strategy through implementation, using structured governance, change management and stakeholder alignment to deliver adoption and measurable results. You understand how Marketing organizations operate, how processes and operating models shape performance, and how technical capabilities can solve business priorities. You are comfortable working across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI, channels, data infrastructure and platform integrations. You use data to diagnose performance, shape recommendations and guide decisions. You can negotiate with vendors, troubleshoot issues, manage deadlines and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and delivery teams. You understand customer\-data compliance considerations, including GDPR and CCPA, and can operate effectively in a matrix environment. A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Technology, Business Administration or a related field is required. You are organized, detail\-oriented, credible, collaborative and accountable for outcomes rather than activity.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At A\&M, you will own technology\-enabled marketing transformation within a rapidly growing Global Capability Center that works directly with global business units and case teams. Your decisions will influence how CRM, MarTech, data and automation capabilities scale across major markets and industries. The role offers the opportunity to shape strategy and roadmap while remaining close to implementation, adoption and measurable business impact. You will work alongside experienced consultants, technologists, data professionals and leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, gaining exposure to complex operating models and diverse client environments. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture rewards independent thinking, practical problem\-solving and professionals who create visible results. The organization supports continuous learning through formal training, on\-the\-job development and performance conversations that recognize contribution and encourage progression. You will join a center that is expanding its capabilities, strengthening its global delivery model and investing in specialized talent. This is an opportunity to build enduring platforms, improve how marketing operates and grow as a transformation leader in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A\&M supports continuous professional development through structured performance conversations, formal training and on\-the\-job learning that help employees build capabilities and progress through a meritocratic environment.
* Employees receive resources and support focused on personal well\-being, enabling sustainable performance while contributing to meaningful work in a collaborative and inclusive culture.
* The role offers exposure to global markets, senior stakeholders, multiple industries and cross\-functional transformation initiatives within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.

description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
   

  

 From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally. Double\-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **Your Mission:**
 Aftershoot is a leading AI\-powered post\-production software company with over 200,000 users and tens of thousands of customers. We are looking for a Content Writer to join our dynamic marketing team. As a Content Marketing Manager, you'll be responsible for executing the company's content strategy and driving engagement through various channels. We're seeking a creative individual with strong writing skills and the ability to produce content that resonates with our audience of professional photographers.
   

  

 🎯
 **What You Will Do:**
* Execute content strategies that drive measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition and conversions.
* Grow the Aftershoot blog into a valuable resource for photographers while optimising content for SEO and AI platforms
* Create diverse content assets (guides, ebooks, templates) that help us to build trust and generate results
* Identify, prioritise, and implement new content opportunities to drive organic growth
* Manage content production schedules, working with freelancers and agencies to scale output and optimise ROI
* Collaborate across teams (marketing, design, product, SEO) to ensure content aligns with brand messaging and performance goals
* Build and nurture relationships with partners and industry influencers to extend content reach
* Monitor content performance metrics and provide regular reports with insights for improvement
* Contribute to content planning for newsletters, social media, and video channels to ensure cohesive messaging
* Maintain consistent brand voice while adapting to different platforms and audience needs


 💪
 **What We're Looking For:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in content marketing, writing, editing, or a related field
* Strong storytelling abilities and writing skills, with a portfolio of published work
* Basic understanding of SEO principles and content optimisation techniques
* Experience using analytics tools to track content performance
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
* Experience in B2B content marketing preferred
* Familiarity with the photography industry a plus but not required


**What happens after you apply?**
* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task \- this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar\-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.


**You will work with:**
* Captain: Vrushti
* Team Members: Sriyanka, Vasundhara and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

title: Retention Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Retention Marketing Executive to drive customer engagement, repeat purchases, and retention for a growing healthcare and wellness brand.
 



 This role focuses on the complete customer lifecycle — lead → purchase → product experience → repeat purchase. You will be responsible for converting interested leads, reducing customer drop\-offs, and increasing repeat revenue through WhatsApp, email, CRM, and marketing automation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan and execute segmented WhatsApp and email campaigns for different customer lifecycle stages.
* Build lead nurture journeys for quiz\-takers, enquiries, checkout abandoners and other prospects.
* Create post\-purchase journeys covering onboarding, reminders, product experience, repeat purchase and win\-back.
* Develop and manage CRM and marketing automation workflows using triggers, timing and customer behaviour.
* Segment customers based on lifecycle stage, purchase history, engagement, recency/frequency, and other relevant data.
* Write clear, persuasive and customer\-focused WhatsApp and email communication.
* Analyse retention, repeat purchase, cohort and funnel data to identify customer drop\-offs and opportunities.
* Track campaign performance and continuously test messaging, timing, segmentation and CTAs.
* Monitor WhatsApp and email health, including opt\-outs, engagement, deliverability and compliance.
* Work closely with marketing, sales, and customer experience teams to improve the overall customer journey.
* Ensure all healthcare\-related communication follows responsible marketing and communication practices.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–3 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Email Marketing, WhatsApp Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Hands\-on experience managing WhatsApp and email campaigns.
* Experience with CRM/marketing automation tools and customer journey creation.
* Strong understanding of segmentation, customer lifecycle, retention, and repeat purchase marketing.
* Ability to analyse campaign and customer data and turn insights into actionable campaigns.
* Good copywriting skills with a strong understanding of customer psychology.
* Familiarity with cohort analysis, RFM, funnel metrics and retention KPIs is an advantage.
* Strong execution, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in healthcare, wellness, D2C or consumer brands is preferred but not mandatory.



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Your primary goal will be to convert more existing leads, reduce customer drop\-offs, increase repeat purchases, and grow retention revenue.
 



 We are looking for someone who can move beyond simply sending campaigns and understand who should receive what message, at what stage, through which channel, and why.

description:
**Social Media \& Content Creation Lead \|** 




**Full\-time \|** 




**Reporting to: Brand Manager \|** 




**Location: Faridabad (in\-office)** 




  





**TARGET CANDIDATE PROFILE 2–4 years in social media or content creation • Strong short\-form portfolio • Comfortable on camera • Beauty, lifestyle or D2C experience preferred** 




**About the opportunity** 




**fast\-growing beauty and personal\-care company with in\-house manufacturing and R\&D, and multiple consumer brands.** 




**We are building organic social as a repeatable content engine, not a posting calendar. Working under the Brand Manager, you will personally take ideas from hook to script to camera to edit to publish, then use the numbers to decide what deserves another iteration. This is a hands\-on creator role with real ownership, not an agency\-coordination position.** 




**The essentials** 



1. **Experience: 2–4 years in social media management, content creation, brand content or a closely related role.**
2. **Location: Faridabad, Haryana. In office, five days a week, with on\-site shoots when required.**
3. **On\-camera work: Mandatory. You should be confident presenting products, tutorials, demonstrations and brand stories on video.**
4. **Production: You must be able to script, shoot and edit Reels, Shorts and other platform\-native short\-form content yourself.**
5. **Role type: Strong individual contributor. You may coordinate designers or photographers when needed, but you remain personally accountable for output and quality.**
6. **Terms: Full time. Six\-month probation. No bond and no lock\-in. Statutory PF and gratuity apply.**
7. **Reporting: Brand Manager; working closely with Creative and Performance Marketing.**
8. **Start date: Immediate joining preferred.**
9. 



**What you will actually build** 




**The mandate is to create a durable organic\-content capability across our beauty brands:** 



1. **A platform\-first content system: clear content pillars, recurring series, formats and channel roles for each brand.**
2. **A reliable short\-form engine: a fast weekly rhythm from insight and hook to script, shoot, edit, caption and publish.**
3. **A recognisable on\-camera presence: credible demonstrations, tutorials, problem\-solution stories and product education that feel native to the platform.**
4. **A disciplined social operating rhythm: calendars, approvals, publishing, community responses and an organised content library.**
5. **A measurable learning loop: weekly reviews that identify winning hooks and formats, then turn them into repeatable series and stronger briefs.**



**What the job involves** 



1. **Turning the Brand Manager’s priorities into monthly calendars and weekly production plans with clear objectives for every piece.**
2. **Researching audience problems, product truths, trends, and cultural moments, then converting them into original content ideas.**
3. **Writing hooks, scripts, captions, calls to action and thumbnail text in a clear, distinctive brand voice.**
4. **Appearing on camera and directing your own performance until the delivery feels natural, credible and platform\-native.**
5. **Shooting clean footage with strong framing, lighting and audio, then editing for pace, retention, subtitles and mobile viewing.**
6. **Publishing consistently across Instagram and YouTube Shorts, and adapting content for other relevant channels when required.**
7. **Managing comments and community conversations, and feeding recurring questions or objections back to the Brand Manager.**
8. **Reviewing watch time, completion, shares, saves, profile visits and organic traffic; testing new hooks instead of defending weak content.**
9. **Handing proven organic assets to Performance Marketing for amplification. You will not own media buying or paid\-campaign optimisation.**



**What we are looking for** 



1. **A portfolio that proves personal contribution. We want to see content you conceived, scripted, presented, shot or edited, not only work produced by an agency.**
2. **Strong short\-form craft: hooks, structure, pacing, framing, lighting, audio, subtitles and a clear reason to keep watching.**
3. **Comfort with at least one practical editing workflow, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or an equivalent tool.**
4. **Good writing and visual judgment. You can recognise a weak hook, cluttered frame or generic caption before it goes live.**
5. **Speed with standards. You can publish at a steady cadence without letting brand voice, accuracy or finish collapse.**
6. **Analytical discipline. You understand that reach and followers are signals, while retention, shares, saves, profile visits and traffic reveal whether content worked.**
7. **High ownership and openness to direct feedback. You can reshoot, recut and improve without treating every revision as a creative disagreement.**

 * Manage and build strong, long\-term relationships with a portfolio of influencers and content creators.
* Act as the primary point of contact between Cloutflow and assigned creators/talent.
* Understand each creator's content style, audience profile, strengths, commercial positioning, and brand fit.
* Maintain regular communication with creators and ensure they are updated on relevant campaign opportunities.
* Understand creator expectations, preferences, commercial requirements, and long\-term career objectives.
* Build trust with creators and establish Cloutflow as a strategic partner rather than just a campaign intermediary.
* Identify opportunities to increase the creator's brand visibility, commercial value, and campaign participation.
* Proactively identify potential challenges with creators and resolve them before they impact campaign execution.



  




 2\. Campaign Opportunity \& Creator Monetisation
 * Work closely with internal teams to identify relevant brand opportunities for managed creators.
* Match creators with suitable brand campaigns based on audience, category, content style, performance, and brand requirements.
* Pitch relevant campaign opportunities to creators and drive creator participation.
* Ensure maximum utilisation of the creator portfolio across relevant campaigns.
* Track campaign opportunities and creator participation to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop a strong understanding of creator pricing, market benchmarks, deliverables, and commercial positioning.
* Support the growth of creator revenue through consistent campaign opportunities and strategic partnerships.



  




 3\. Commercial Negotiation
 * Lead or support commercial negotiations with creators, talent representatives, managers, and agencies.
* Negotiate creator commercials while balancing campaign budgets and creator expectations.
* Understand market pricing and maintain awareness of changing influencer rates across platforms and categories.
* Negotiate deliverables, timelines, usage rights, exclusivity, whitelisting/boosting requirements, and other commercial terms.
* Ensure all agreed commercial terms are clearly documented and communicated to the relevant internal teams.
* Work closely with the Pricing/Procurement and Operations teams wherever required to close commercials and campaign requirements.
* Escalate high\-value or sensitive negotiations to the reporting manager when required.



  




 4\. Campaign Execution
 * Own creator\-related execution for assigned campaigns from confirmation to completion.
* Coordinate with creators to ensure timely completion of briefs, content submissions, revisions, approvals, and publishing.
* Ensure creators understand campaign briefs, deliverables, timelines, mandatory brand mentions, hashtags, tags, CTAs, and other requirements.
* Follow up consistently with creators to ensure campaign milestones are met.
* Coordinate with internal Operations, Planning, Strategy, Creative, and Revenue teams for smooth campaign execution.
* Identify execution risks and proactively communicate them to relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure all creator deliverables are completed as per agreed campaign requirements.
* Support resolution of last\-minute changes, delays, cancellations, or creator\-related issues.



  




 5\. Creator Onboarding \& Portfolio Management
 * Identify and onboard relevant creators into the talent management ecosystem.
* Evaluate creators based on content quality, audience relevance, engagement, brand suitability, consistency, and commercial potential.
* Maintain accurate and updated creator profiles, commercials, audience information, deliverables, and other relevant details.
* Regularly review the performance and commercial potential of managed creators.
* Identify creators who have potential for long\-term brand partnerships and larger commercial opportunities.
* Maintain a structured database of creators and ensure information is updated regularly.



  




 6\. Brand \& Internal Stakeholder Management
 * Work closely with the Revenue, Planning, Procurement, Operations, Strategy, and Creative teams.
* Understand campaign requirements and translate them into clear creator\-level action points.
* Provide internal teams with relevant information about creator availability, commercials, deliverables, and requirements.
* Maintain strong coordination across multiple teams to ensure campaign timelines are met.
* Represent the Talent Management function in relevant internal discussions and campaign reviews.
* Build strong working relationships with brand\-facing teams to understand upcoming opportunities for managed creators.



  




 7\. Creator Performance \& Insights
 * Monitor creator performance across campaigns and platforms.
* Track campaign results, content performance, audience response, and other relevant metrics.
* Identify patterns and insights that can help improve creator selection and campaign performance.
* Maintain an understanding of platform trends, emerging creators, content formats, and influencer marketing trends.
* Share relevant insights with internal teams and creators.

title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
 



**Consumer Insight:** 
 Build a strong read on the Indian Gen Z and Millennial consumer — fashion trends, buying behaviour, and sentiment — to keep Meller's proposition sharp.
 



  





**4\. Global Coordination, Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 




**Global Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary interface between the Barcelona\-based Meller team and Lenskart's India leadership — aligning on strategy, brand consistency, and market learnings.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Category, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure the business runs as one integrated system.
 



**Team Building:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a lean, high\-performing India team capable of running Meller as an independent, founder\-led business within Lenskart.
 



**Leadership Reporting:** 
 Own business reviews and reporting cadences with Lenskart and Meller global leadership — covering performance, strategy, and course corrections.
 



  





**The Essentials** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 Proven experience in business leadership, general management, or P\&L ownership roles, with meaningful experience building or scaling a D2C brand; exposure to fashion/lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands is a strong plus, as is an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
* **P\&L \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven ability to own and grow a P\&L — balancing revenue growth, margin, and working capital while making sound commercial trade\-offs.
* **Brand \& Retail Understanding:** 
 Strong grounding in brand building, retail operations, and consumer behaviour, particularly within fashion, lifestyle, or eyewear categories.
* **Entrepreneurial Track Record:** 
 Experience building or scaling a business, brand, or new market with founder\-like ownership, ideally in a fast\-growing or category\-disrupting environment.
* **Cross\-Border Collaboration:** 
 Experience or strong aptitude for working with global teams, balancing brand consistency with local market relevance.
* **Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior leaders across commercial, retail, marketing, and finance functions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.



  





**🧠 The Mindset** 




  




* **Founder's Mentality:** 
 You think and act like you own the business — chasing outcomes, not just tasks, and taking full accountability for Meller's success in India.
* **Brand Storyteller:** 
 You understand how to turn a brand's design DNA into stories and experiences that resonate with a new generation of consumers.
* **Globally Minded, Locally Grounded:** 
 You carry a brand's global identity faithfully while adapting it with nuance for Indian consumers and platforms.
* **Commercially Grounded:** 
 You balance brand ambition with the discipline of running a healthy, profitable business.
* **Entrepreneurial Bent of Mind:** 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity, quick to take ownership, resourceful with limited support, and driven to make things happen rather than wait for a playbook.
* **Collaborative Operator** 
 : You move easily between strategic, creative, and commercial conversations, working across category, retail, and global brand teams to get things done.
* **Execution\-Focused:** 
 You don't just set strategy — you see it through, chase details, and hold the bar high at every touchpoint.

title: Manager - Content Strategy
description:
**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a Content Strategist to lead content planning and execution across its international markets. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — owning the content roadmap while also shaping creator briefs, performance creative, and e\-commerce storytelling across different markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**International Content Strategy** 



* Develop and own the annual and quarterly content strategy for Fast\&Up’s international markets.
* Build market\-specific content pillars based on consumer behaviour, cultural nuances, sporting calendars and business priorities.
* Identify content opportunities around sports, fitness, wellness, hydration, lifestyle and cultural moments.



**Social Media Content** 



* Own content strategy for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* Develop concepts for Reels, TikToks, static content, carousels, stories and other social formats.
* Identify trends, formats, sounds, conversations and cultural moments relevant to each market.
* Ensure content is optimized for engagement, reach and discovery.



**Creator \& Influencer Content** 



* Work closely with the creator/influencer team to develop briefs and content directions.
* Develop creative briefs for different creator cohorts and use cases.
* Identify opportunities to convert creator content into paid media assets.



**Performance Content** 



* Develop strategy for content specifically for Meta, TikTok and other paid platforms.
* Develop creative testing frameworks across hooks, formats, messaging, CTAs and audiences.
* Analyse performance data and feed learnings back into content strategy.



**E\-commerce Content** 



* Work with e\-commerce teams to ensure strong product storytelling and consistency across all platforms.
* Help Develop enhanced product content, A\+ content, banners, videos and platform\-specific assets.
* Ensure brand consistency across D2C and marketplace environments.



**Team \& Agency Management** 



* Manage internal content resources, copywriters, editors and external agencies/creators.
* Build efficient content workflows and approval processes across international markets.
* Brief creative teams and ensure timely delivery of assets.
* Maintain high standards of quality and brand consistency.



**Market \& Competitor Intelligence** 



* Track competitors and emerging brands across international markets.
* Monitor social and cultural trends in the Europe, GCC, South East Asia and other markets.



  





**Work Exp:** 




 5–8 years of experience in content strategy, brand marketing, or social media, ideally with exposure to international/global markets.
 



  





**Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) — their formats, algorithms, and what drives engagement in each.
* Proven experience briefing and directing creators/influencers, with an eye for what makes content authentic vs. branded.
* Familiarity with performance marketing content — understands how creative testing (hooks, formats, CTAs) ties back to paid media results.
* Cultural fluency or working experience across different international markets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write and evaluate briefs with clarity.
* Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or a small internal content team.
* Comfortable working with data — can read performance dashboards and translate numbers into content decisions.

title: Category Manager
description:

 Tulio is a premium window apparel brand with over three decades of experience designing and manufacturing high\-quality curtains and blinds. title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.
